blocks.en: On a 80 × 80 80\times 80 image with a single flat rectangle (raw size 6400 6400 bytes), RLE reconstructs the image exactly and compresses it to roughly 369 369 bytes — a 17.3 × 17.3\times reduction.
blocks.zh: 在80×80 80\times 80个有单平矩形(缩写为6400 6400字节)的图像上,RLE精确地重建了图像并压缩到大约369 369字节——17.3×17.3\times还原.

blocks.en: Huffman coding: fewer bits for common values
blocks.zh: Huffman 编码: 常见值的比特更少

blocks.en: A more sophisticated lossless method is Huffman coding , which takes advantage of the fact that some pixel values (e.g., a common background gray) occur far more often than others. It builds a variable-length code where frequent values get short codes and rare values get longer ones — which is provably optimal among prefix codes.
blocks.zh: 一个更复杂的无损法是Huffman编码(Huffman coding),它利用了一些像素值(例如常见的背景灰色)比其他值发生多得多的事实. 它构建了一个可变长代码,频繁值得到短代码而稀有值得到长代码——这在前缀代码中证明是最佳的.

blocks.en: Shannon’s entropy gives the theoretical floor on average bits/pixel for any code based only on the value distribution (ignoring spatial structure): H = − ∑ i p i log 2 p i , H=-\sum_{i}p_{i}\log_{2}p_{i}, (17.1) where p i p_{i} is the probability that a certain pixel value occurs in the image. On a synthetic noisy test image: naive fixed-width encoding costs 8.00 8.00 bits/pixel, the Shannon entropy floor is 5.17 5.17 , and the from-scratch Huffman coder achieves 5.20 5.20 — very close to the theoretical bound (it can only match it exactly when every probability happens to be a power of 2).

blocks.en: Real lossless formats like PNG combine an idea like this (Huffman/arithmetic coding) with a predictive filter first — predicting each pixel from its neighbors and encoding only the (usually small) prediction error, which has much lower entropy than the raw pixel values.
blocks.zh: 像PNG这样的真实的无损失格式首先会将这样的想法(Huffman/alithmetic coding)与一个预测过滤器结合——从邻居那里预测出每个像素,并且只编码出(通常是小的)预测错误,这比原始像素值要低得多.

blocks.en: 17.2 Lossy compression: the DCT
blocks.zh: 17.2 压缩损失:DCT

blocks.en: JPEG’s core idea is to take advantage of the human visual system’s tendency to overlook fine details. JPEG divides the image into small 8 × 8 8\times 8 blocks, then transforms each block into the frequency domain so that it can discard the high-frequency components that are barely noticeable to the human eye. JPEG uses the discrete cosine transform (DCT) , a close relative of the Fourier transform from Chapter 15 . Like the DFT, the DCT re-expresses a block as a sum of frequency components — but it uses only cosines (no imaginary part) to avoid boundary artifacts.
blocks.zh: JPEG的核心思想是利用人类视觉系统忽略细微细节的倾向. JPEG将图像分为8×8 8\times 8个小块,然后将每个块转换为频率域,这样它就可以丢弃对人类眼睛几乎不显眼的高频组件. JPEG使用离散的余弦变换(DCT),是Fourier变换自第15章的近亲. 与 DFT 一样,DCT 重新表达出一个块作为频率元件的总称——但它只使用余弦(没有想象中的部分)来避开边界文物.

blocks.en: On an 8 × 8 8\times 8 block straddling a sharp edge: 83.1 % 83.1\% of the block’s energy lands in just the top-left 2 × 2 2\times 2 DCT coefficients, and 92.4 % 92.4\% in the top-left 4 × 4 4\times 4 — the DCT concentrates most of a block’s information into a handful of low-frequency coefficients.
Quantization: throwing away the coefficients that matter least
blocks.zh: 量化:放弃最不重要的系数

blocks.en: Compression happens by quantizing the DCT coefficients — dividing by some value (from a quantization table designed around human visual sensitivity) and rounding. Many coefficients, especially high-frequency ones carrying the least energy, become exactly zero and take almost no space to store, as Figure 17.1 illustrates.
blocks.zh: 压缩方式是将DCT系数进行定量——除以一定值(取自围绕人类视觉敏感性而设计的定量表)和四舍五入. 如图17.1所示,许多系数,特别是能耗最小的高频系数,完全为零,几乎没有空间储存。

blocks.en: Figure 17.1: Reconstructing an 8 × 8 8\times 8 block from only the top-left n × n n\times n DCT coefficients, for n = 8 , 4 , 2 , 1 n=8,4,2,1 . Even keeping just the top-left 2 × 2 2\times 2 (4 of 64 coefficients — a 16 × 16\times reduction) preserves most of the block’s overall structure; only the finest detail is lost.
blocks.zh: 图17.1:从仅左上方的n=n=n=n=n=n=n=8、4、2、1n=8、4、2、1的DCT系数重构出8个区块。 即使只保留左上方的2×2 2.

blocks.en: 17.3 Real JPEG: the rate-distortion tradeoff
blocks.zh: 17.3 真正的JPEG:损耗率的权衡

blocks.en: Real JPEG encoding follows this same DCT-then-quantize recipe per block (with a carefully designed, frequency-dependent quantization table, plus run-length and Huffman coding of the resulting sparse coefficients — combining the lossy and lossless ideas from this chapter). Sweeping OpenCV’s JPEG quality setting on a synthetic color image and measuring both file size and PSNR (peak signal-to-noise ratio), plotted in Figure 17.2 :
blocks.zh: 真实的JPEG编码遵循的是这个相同的每块DCT-当时量化的配方(配有精心设计,频率依赖的量化表,加上所生成的稀有系数的跑长和Huffman编码——结合了本章中损失和无损失的想法). 在合成颜色图像上扫描 OpenCV 的 JPEG 质量设置, 并测量文件大小和 PSNR( 峰值信号对噪声比), 图17.2 中绘图 :

blocks.en: Figure 17.2: File size vs. JPEG quality (left), and the rate-distortion curve: PSNR vs. file size (right).
blocks.zh: 图17.2:文件大小对JPEG质量(左),和速率扭曲曲线:PSNR对文件大小(右).

blocks.en: This is the fundamental tradeoff of lossy compression: every extra byte you’re willing to spend buys diminishing returns in quality — the rate-distortion curve flattens out at high quality, and there is no free lunch, only a choice of where on the curve to sit. For a typical photograph, JPEG quality of 75 will not be noticeable unless you zoom in, and it will reduce the file size by 6–8 × \times .
blocks.zh: 这是损失压缩的根本取舍:你愿意花的每一个额外的字节都购买质量降低的回报 — — 价格扭曲曲线在质量上会变平,而且没有免费午餐,只能选择曲线上的位置。 对于一幅典型相片,JPEG的质量为75,除非你放大,否则不会显出,它会将文件大小减少6–8×\times.

blocks.en: 17.4 JPEG or PNG? Choosing the right format
blocks.zh: 17.4 JPEG还是PNG? 选择正确的格式

blocks.en: The trade-offs above translate into a practical rule: • Use JPEG for photographs . Photographs are dominated by smooth gradients — exactly what the DCT concentrates into a few low-frequency coefficients, so discarding the rest is barely visible and JPEG buys a large size reduction for a small perceptual loss. • Use PNG for graphics (screenshots, diagrams, text, icons, anything with flat regions or sharp edges). Graphics are the opposite case: a sharp edge spreads energy across all DCT frequencies, so the same quantization that photos tolerate shows up as visible ringing and blocking around edges and text. Lossless compression handles flat regions and sharp edges almost for free (that’s exactly what RLE and the predictive filter above are good at), so PNG is often both artifact-free and smaller than JPEG for this kind of content.
blocks.zh: 以上权衡转化为实用规则: • 照片使用 JPEG . 相片以平滑梯度为主——正是DCT集中到几个低频系数上,因此丢弃了其余的几乎不显眼,而JPEG为了一个小的知觉损失而购买了大尺寸的缩小. ^ 将PNG用于图形(屏幕截图,图表,文本,图标,任何有平地区域或尖地边缘的东西). 图形是相反的情况:尖锐的边缘会把能量分散到所有的DCT频率,所以同样地量化的照片可以容忍显示为明显的振铃并围住边缘和文字. 没有损失的压缩几乎可以免费处理平地和尖地(RLE和上面的预测滤波器正是如此),因此PNG对于这类内容来说往往都是没有文物的和小于JPEG的.

blocks.en: Use JPEG for photographs . Photographs are dominated by smooth gradients — exactly what the DCT concentrates into a few low-frequency coefficients, so discarding the rest is barely visible and JPEG buys a large size reduction for a small perceptual loss.

blocks.en: Use PNG for graphics (screenshots, diagrams, text, icons, anything with flat regions or sharp edges). Graphics are the opposite case: a sharp edge spreads energy across all DCT frequencies, so the same quantization that photos tolerate shows up as visible ringing and blocking around edges and text. Lossless compression handles flat regions and sharp edges almost for free (that’s exactly what RLE and the predictive filter above are good at), so PNG is often both artifact-free and smaller than JPEG for this kind of content.

blocks.en: 18.1 Grayscale is already a color-space choice
blocks.zh: 18.1 灰度已经是一个色彩空间选择

blocks.en: The simplest way to convert color to grayscale is to average the three channels, Y = ( R + G + B ) / 3 Y=(R+G+B)/3 . The human visual system is actually more sensitive to green than to the other colors, so it’s better to weight green more; a formula based on actual experiments on human subjects gives the weights used in cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY) : Y = 0.299 ​ R + 0.587 ​ G + 0.114 ​ B . Y=0.299R+0.587G+0.114B. (18.1) These weights come from human luminance sensitivity: the eye is far more sensitive to green than to blue, so equal-intensity green and blue should not map to the same gray level, even though a naive channel average would treat them identically. On pure green vs. pure blue patches: the naive average gives 85 85 for both (indistinguishable), while the perceptually weighted version correctly reports green as much brighter ( 150 150 ) than blue ( 29 29 ) at the same channel intensity.
blocks.zh: 将颜色转换为灰度最简单的方式是平均三个通道,Y=(R+G+B) / 3 Y=(R+G+B)/. 人类视觉系统实际上对绿色比对其他颜色更敏感,因此更适合以绿色为重;基于人类主体实际实验的公式给出了cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)中使用的权重: Y=0.299 R+0.587 G+0.114 B. Y=0.299R+0.587G+0.114B. (18.1) 这些重量出自人类发光敏感:眼睛对绿色比对蓝色敏感得多,因此等强度的绿色和蓝色不应该被映射到同等灰平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平 在纯绿色对纯蓝色补丁上:天真平均对两者都给予85个85分(不可识别),而感官加权版则在同一频道强度下正确报告绿色比蓝色更亮(150个150分)多(29个29分).

blocks.en: Why this formula is outdated (even though widely used, and still useful)
blocks.zh: 为什么这个公式已经过时(尽管被广泛使用,但仍然有用)

blocks.en: Two things are hiding in that formula worth knowing about: 1. Old primaries. The weights 0.299 , 0.587 , 0.114 0.299,0.587,0.114 come from the 1953 NTSC standard (Rec. 601), derived from the specific red/green/blue phosphors used in early color CRT televisions. Modern LED displays use more saturated primaries, so the colorimetrically correct weights for a modern screen are actually Y = 0.2126 ​ R + 0.7152 ​ G + 0.0722 ​ B Y=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B (Rec. 709/sRGB) — noticeably more green-weighted and less red-weighted. cv2.cvtColor still uses the old Rec. 601 weights, mainly for backward compatibility with decades of existing code. 2. Assumes linear light. The weighted-sum formula is only true luminance when R , G , B R,G,B are linear light values. But stored pixel values are gamma- encoded , not linear. cv2.cvtColor applies the weights directly to the raw encoded 8-bit values without decoding gamma first — fast, and close enough for most computer-vision purposes, but not the physically correct luminance a display-calibration or photometry application would need. (To see the problem: a pure blue image, RGB = ( 0 , 0 , 255 ) =(0,0,255) , converts to a gray value of 29 29 everywhere — which will incorrectly appear almost completely dark, even though a fully saturated blue is a fairly bright color to the eye.)
blocks.zh: 有两样东西藏在这个公式中 值得知道: 1. 旧初选。 重量为:0.299,0.587,0.114 来源于1953年NTSC标准(Rec. 601),取自早期彩色CRT电视机中使用的特定红/绿/蓝磷. 现代LED显示会使用更饱和的初选方式,因此现代屏幕所显示的等色正确重量实际上为Y=0.2126 R+0.7152 G+0.0722 B Y=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B (Rec. 709/sRGB)——明显地是更绿色的重量和较少红的重量. cv2.cvt Color仍然使用旧的Rec. 601权重,主要用于与几十年已存在的代码的后向兼容. 2. 假定线性光线。 加权和公式仅在R,G,B R,G,B为线性光值时才为真光. 但是所储存的像素值是伽玛编码的,而不是线性. cv2.cvtColor将权重直接应用到原始编码的8位值上,而不首先去解码伽马——速度快,而且对于大多数计算机视觉目的来说足够接近,但并非显示校正或光度测量应用所需的物理上正确的亮度. (看问题:一个纯蓝色的图像,RGB = (0, 0, 255)= (0, 0, 255),在各地转换成29个的灰色值——这将会错误地出现几乎完全黑暗,尽管一个完全饱和的蓝色是眼睛上相当明亮的颜色. )

blocks.en: 18.2 RGB channels are highly correlated
blocks.zh: 18.2 RGB频道高度相关

blocks.en: In most real images, lighting/shading variation dominates: a surface gets brighter or darker as a whole, scaling all three channels together. That means R, G, and B end up strongly correlated with each other — not a very efficient or convenient way to separate “what color is this” from “how brightly lit is this,” as the scatter plot in Figure 18.1 shows.
blocks.zh: 在大多数真实的图像中,照明/阴影变异占据了主导地位:一个表面整体变得更亮或更暗,将所有三个通道都缩放在一起. 这意味着R、G和B最终将彼此紧密地联系在一起——这不是一个非常有效或方便的方法,可以把“这种颜色是什么”与“这种颜色多么明亮地点亮”,如图18.1所显示的那样。

blocks.en: 18.3 HSV: separating color from brightness
blocks.zh: 18.3 HSV: 分色与亮度

blocks.en: HSV (Hue, Saturation, Value) reparametrizes color so that Hue captures which color (independent of how bright or washed-out it is), Saturation captures how vivid/pure it is, and Value captures brightness alone. This makes color-based segmentation dramatically more robust to lighting than thresholding directly in RGB.
blocks.zh: HSV (Hue, 饱和度, value) 重新校正颜色, 以便 Hue 捕捉到哪个颜色( 取决于它有多亮或被冲出), 饱和度捕捉到它有多生动/ 纯洁, 并且 value 单独捕捉亮度 。 这使得以色为基的分解比直接在RGB中阈值更能显著地增强到照明.

blocks.en: On a synthetic orange disk with a strong left-to-right lighting gradient: thresholding on HSV hue recovers the disk perfectly (IoU 1.000 1.000 against the true disk), while a fixed RGB color range misses the darkened side entirely (IoU 0.710 0.710 ), as Figure 18.2 shows.
blocks.zh: 在具有强烈的从左到右照明梯度的合成橙色磁盘上:HSV hue上的阈值能完美地恢复磁盘(IoU 1.000 1.000对正磁盘),而一个固定的RGB色域完全错过了被变暗的一面(IoU 0.710 0.710),如图18.2所示.

blocks.en: Figure 18.2: A shaded disk (dark on the left, bright on the right), an HSV hue threshold, and a fixed RGB range. Hue thresholding recovers the disk regardless of the lighting gradient; the RGB range misses the darkened side entirely.
blocks.zh: 图18.2:一个被遮蔽的磁盘(左边是暗地,右边是亮地),一个HSV发光阈值,以及一个固定的RGB范围. 色调阈值回收磁盘, 不论照明梯度如何; RGB 范围完全忽略了被暗化的一面 。

blocks.en: 18.4 YCbCr: luma and chroma, and why video compresses color more aggressively
blocks.zh: 18.4 YCbCr: 露马和染色体, 以及为什么视频压缩 更积极的颜色

blocks.en: YCbCr (used internally by JPEG and almost all video codecs) splits an image into luma ( Y Y , roughly brightness) and two chroma channels ( C b , C r C_{b},C_{r} , roughly “how blue” and “how red”). The human visual system resolves fine spatial detail in luma far better than in chroma — the biological basis for chroma subsampling (storing chroma at lower resolution than luma, e.g. video’s common “4:2:0” format), one of the free compression wins used throughout Chapter 17 ’s JPEG pipeline.
blocks.zh: YCbCr(由JPEG和几乎所有的视频解码器内部使用)将一幅图像分出为露马(Y Y,大致亮度)和两个染色体通道(Cb, Cr C_{b}, C_{r}),大致为"多蓝色"和"多红色". 人类视觉系统比铬更能解析出细细的空间细节——铬分样的生物基础(将铬分样储存在低于露出分辨度的地方,例如视频常见的"4:2:0"格式),是第17章整个JPEG管道中所使用的自由压缩取胜的一种.

blocks.en: Subsampling either channel 8 × 8\times and measuring reconstruction error against the original: degrading chroma costs a mean absolute error of 6.44 6.44 gray levels, while degrading luma by the same factor costs 10.15 10.15 — discarding the same amount of resolution costs noticeably less error in chroma than in luma, as Figure 18.3 shows.
blocks.zh: 对8×8个频道进行分样并对照原作衡量重建出错:降低铬的绝对误差为6.44 6.44灰度,降低润色值为同因子的误差为10.15-10.15-如图18.3所显示,在铬中丢弃同样数量的解析出错率明显低于润色值。

blocks.en: Figure 18.3: Original, chroma subsampled 8 × 8\times (barely visible loss), and luma subsampled 8 × 8\times (clearly visible loss) — the same detail loss is simply less objectionable when it happens to color rather than brightness.
blocks.zh: 图18.3:原生,染色体分样为8×8×8×时(几乎可见损失),而润色分样为8×8×时(明显可见损失)——同样的细节分样损失发生于颜色而非亮度时,根本就不那么令人反感了.

blocks.en: 18.5 L*a*b*: a perceptually uniform space
blocks.zh: 18.5 L*a*b*: 一个概念上统一的空间

blocks.en: RGB’s Euclidean distance is a poor stand-in for how different two colors actually look : equal RGB distances can correspond to wildly different perceived differences, depending on where in color space they fall. CIELAB was explicitly designed so that Euclidean distance between two L*a*b* colors approximates perceptual difference much more consistently — useful for color-based quality metrics, clustering, and matching.
blocks.zh: RGB 的 Euclidean 距离对于不同两种颜色的实际外观来说是一种差的站点: 相等的 RGB 距离可以对应野生的不同感知到的差异, 取决于它们在颜色空间中的位置. CIELAB是明确设计的,使欧几利得在两种L*a*b*颜色之间的相距远近相去相去甚远,更一致——对以颜色为基础的质量衡量标准、组合和匹配有用。

blocks.en: Generating 2000 random color pairs, each held at exactly the same RGB distance ( 30.0 30.0 ): the resulting L*a*b* distances range from a minimum of 3.0 3.0 to a maximum of 38.1 38.1 (median 17.3 17.3 ) — more than a 12 × 12\times spread, depending purely on where in color space the pair sits, as the histogram in Figure 18.4 shows.
blocks.zh: 生成2000个随机相色对,每个相相相持的RGB距离完全相同(30.0 30.0 ): 如图18.4所示,由此产生的L*a*b*距离从最小的3.0到最高的38.1 38.1(中位数17.3 17.3)——超过12×12相相差的时间,这完全取决于相配方在颜色空间中的位置。

blocks.en: Figure 18.4: Histogram of L*a*b* distances for 2000 color pairs all held at the same RGB distance. Any algorithm using raw RGB distance as a proxy for perceptual similarity (nearest-neighbor color matching, k-means color clustering, background-subtraction thresholds) inherits this same distortion; switching to Lab distance is a simple, standard fix.

blocks.en: 19.1 k-means on real color data
blocks.zh: 19.1 k 表示真实颜色数据

blocks.en: Chapter 18 built a perceptually meaningful color distance (L*a*b* Euclidean distance). Clustering is the natural next step: given a pile of pixel colors and no labels at all, group them into regions automatically.
blocks.zh: 第18章构建了感知有意义的颜色距离(L*a*b*欧几利得距离). 集群是自然的下一步:给一堆像素颜色,完全没有标签,将它们自动地组合成区域.

blocks.en: K-means, also known as Lloyd’s algorithm, is here unchanged from its textbook form: pick k k random points as initial centers, assign every point to its nearest center, recompute each center as the mean of its assigned points, repeat until nothing moves.
blocks.zh: K-意思(K-means),也叫劳埃德算法(Lloyd's A算法),从其教科书形式来看,这里没有变化:选择克克随机点作为初始中心,指定每个点到最近的中心,重新计算每个中心作为其指定点的平均值,重复到一无所动为止.

blocks.en: Figure 19.1: A synthetic noisy 4-region color image, the true regions, and the k-means segmentation on L*a*b* pixel colors — purity 1.000 1.000 against the true regions.
blocks.zh: 图19.1:合成吵闹的4个区域颜色图象,真实区域,和L*a*b*像素颜色上的克-指分化——纯度为1 000.000对真实区域.

blocks.en: With compact, roughly equal-sized, roughly round clusters in L*a*b* space (exactly what this synthetic image has), k-means recovers the true regions almost perfectly, as Figure 19.1 shows. Two real caveats worth flagging even in this success case: k k (the number of clusters) has to be chosen in advance — nothing in the algorithm discovers it — and different random initializations can converge to different, sometimes noticeably worse, local optima; k-means++ ( Arthur & Vassilvitskii, 2007 ) fixes this by seeding centers to be spread apart rather than purely at random.
blocks.zh: 由于L*a*b*空间的紧凑,大小大致相等,大致圆形的集群(这幅合成图像的准确性),K-意思几乎完全恢复了真实的区域,如图19.1所示。 两个真正值得注意的警告即使在这个成功的例子中也值得注意:k k(群数)必须事先选择——在算法中没有任何发现——不同的随机初始化可以汇合到不同的,有时是明显更糟糕的地方optima;k-指++ (Arthur & Vassilvitskii, 2007)通过种子中心来解决这个问题,从而分散,而不是纯粹随机地.

blocks.en: 19.2 Where k-means breaks: non-convex clusters
blocks.zh: 19.2 (中文(简体) ). K 表示断开之处: 非弧形集群

blocks.en: K-means’ update rule — assign to the nearest center — can only carve space into convex regions. A dataset that isn’t convex at all: two concentric rings. No placement of two centers can separate them correctly, no matter how many times the algorithm iterates. K-means lands right at chance ( 54.0 % 54.0\% , vs. 50 % 50\% for random guessing on this 2-class problem) — it splits the two rings radially, half of each ring going to each cluster, because that’s the only kind of boundary (a straight line, equidistant between two centers) the algorithm is capable of drawing, as Figure 19.2 shows.

Figure 19.2: True concentric rings vs. the k-means result (centers marked with × \times ). The clusters aren’t ambiguous to a human eye at all; the algorithm’s assumption (round, center-based clusters) is simply the wrong tool for this shape.
blocks.zh: 图19.2: 真正的同心环对 K 表示结果(中心标记为 ×\times )。 星团对人来说根本不含糊;算法的假设(圆的,以中心为基础的星团)仅仅是这个形状的错误工具.

blocks.en: 19.3 Gaussian mixture models: soft, elliptical clusters
blocks.zh: 19.3 高斯混合模型:柔软的,椭圆的集群

blocks.en: A Gaussian mixture model (GMM) generalizes k-means two ways: each cluster gets its own full covariance (so clusters can be elongated ellipses, not just circles), and assignment is soft — every point gets a probability of belonging to each cluster, not a hard label. Fit by expectation-maximization (EM) ( Dempster, Laird, & Rubin, 1977 ): the E-step computes each point’s responsibility (probability) under the current Gaussians; the M-step re-fits each Gaussian’s mean, covariance, and weight to its responsibility-weighted points.
blocks.zh: 一个高斯混合模型(GMM)概括出k-意指两种方式: 每一个集群得到自己的完全共变(因此集群可以被长椭圆而不只是圆形),分配是软的——每个点都得到属于每个集群的概率,而不是硬的标签. 适应预期-最大化(EM)(Dempster,Laird, & Rubin,1977年):E步计算了当前高斯人统治下的每个点的责任(概率);M步调整了每个高斯人的平分,共分,并重取其责任加权分数.

blocks.en: On the concentric rings, GMM does no better than k-means: 55.7 % 55.7\% accuracy, also near chance. That’s an important, easy-to-miss point: GMM fixes k-means’ round-only assumption, but it’s still a unimodal-per-cluster model — each cluster is described by one Gaussian bump. A ring isn’t elliptical any more than it’s circular; no single Gaussian, of any shape, fits an annulus well. GMM and k-means fail this dataset for the same underlying reason.
blocks.zh: 在同心环上,GMM不比克-指: 55.7%的精度,也接近概率. 这是一个重要且容易漏掉的点:GMMM修正了k-means的圆形假设,但它仍然是单倍组合模式 — — 每个组合由一个高斯凸起来描述。 一枚戒指并不比圆形更椭圆;没有任何一种形状的高斯琴适合废除。 GMM和k-意指由于同样的基本原因而失败了此数据集.

blocks.en: 19.4 DBSCAN: clusters defined by density, not shape
blocks.zh: 19.4 DBSCAN:由密度而不是形状定义的集群

blocks.en: DBSCAN (density-based spatial clustering, Ester et al., 1996 ) never fits a parametric shape at all. A point is a core point if at least min_samples other points lie within distance eps of it. Clusters are formed by chaining together core points that are within eps of each other (and their neighbors), so a cluster can be any shape — including a ring — as long as it’s a connected, sufficiently dense region of space. Points that end up in no core point’s neighborhood are labeled noise , not forced into the nearest cluster.
blocks.zh: DBSCAN(密度基于空间集群,Ester等人,1996年)根本不适合参数形状。 如果至少以分为样本的其他点位于它的相距 eps 内,则一分是核心点. 集群是通过将彼此(及其相邻)的eps内的核心点连在一起而形成的,因此一个集群只要是一个连接,足够密集的空间区域,就可以成为任何形状——包括环. 在任何核心点的邻里,

blocks.en: On the same rings: DBSCAN finds exactly 2 clusters, 0 noise points, and 100.0 % 100.0\% accuracy (Figure 19.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在同一环上:DBSCAN发现精确的2个集群,0个噪点,以及100.0%的100.0%的精度(图19.3).

blocks.en: Figure 19.3: True rings, the k-means result (fails), and the DBSCAN result (succeeds). DBSCAN never assumed a center or a shape, only that points within a ring are densely connected to their neighbors, while the gap between rings is not.
blocks.zh: 图19.3:真环,克-指结果(失败)和DBSCAN结果(成功). DBSCAN从没有设定出中心或形状,只有环内的指点与相邻者紧密相通,而相邻相接的相邻者则不相通.

blocks.en: This comes at a real cost: eps and min_samples have to be chosen by hand (a poor choice fragments each ring into dozens of tiny arcs), and DBSCAN struggles when different true clusters have very different densities, since one global eps can’t be simultaneously right for a sparse cluster and a dense one.
blocks.zh: 这要付出真正的代价:eps和min_samples必须用手来选择(一个糟糕的选择将每个环分解成几十个小弧),而DBSCAN则在不同的真正的集群密度非常相去甚远的情况下挣扎,因为一个全球eps不可能同时适合一个稀有和密集的集群。

blocks.en: 19.5 Noise robustness: a real advantage of “no forced assignment”
blocks.zh: 19.5 (中文(简体) ). 噪音强:“不强迫转让”的真正好处

blocks.en: Add clutter — points scattered uniformly across the whole region, belonging to neither ring — and compare how each algorithm handles them. k-means and GMM have no concept of “doesn’t belong to any cluster”: every point gets assigned somewhere, dragging cluster centers toward the clutter. DBSCAN can simply call clutter what it is: out of 60 clutter points added, k-means correctly flags 0 0 as anything other than “definitely part of a ring” (it has no vocabulary for that at all), while DBSCAN correctly isolates 8 8 of them as noise. The rest happen to land within eps of a real ring point (or of each other, forming a small cluster of their own) — a fair outcome, not a bug, since density-based clustering only calls a point noise if it’s genuinely isolated. The qualitative point stands regardless of the exact count: DBSCAN has a real, usable category for “this doesn’t fit anywhere,” whereas k-means structurally cannot.
blocks.zh: 添加杂乱无章的-分布在整个地区的分数,属于两个环的分数,并比较每个算法如何处理. K-意指和GMM没有“不属于任何集群”的概念:每个点都被分配到某个地方, DBSCAN可以简单地称它为"杂乱无章":在添加了60个杂乱点中,k-意为正确的标记为"0",除了"一个环的绝对部分"(它根本没有词汇)之外的其他任何内容,而DBSCAN正确地将其中的8个孤立为噪音. 其余的碰巧在真实环点(或彼此相通,形成它们自己的小群)的地平线内着陆——一个公平的结果,而不是一个虫子,因为基于密度的集群只有在真正孤立的情况下才叫点噪. 无论准确的计算结果如何, 定性点都是存在的: DBSCAN有一个真实的, 可用的类别, “这在任何地方都不合适 , ” 而 k- 意思是结构上的不能。

blocks.en: 19.6 Where this goes next
blocks.zh: 19.6 国家 接下来呢?

blocks.en: This is the end of Part 1. Many of the algorithms encountered so far operate directly on raw or hand-picked features — pixel color, ( x , y ) (x,y) coordinates, texture — and rely on human-chosen distance functions, such as those used here. Later chapters revisit many of these problems using deep learning to automatically discover the features and the rules for combining them: Chapter 43’s instance segmentation uses a similar clustering idea, and Chapter 48’s autoencoder learns the feature space itself, purely from reconstruction error, before any grouping is asked for at all. Where this chapter’s methods assume a shape and fit it, the deep-learning methods later in this course learn a representation and let structure emerge from it.
blocks.zh: 这是第一部分的结尾。 迄今所遭遇的许多算法直接在原始或人工选取的特征上运作——像素颜色,(x,y) (x,y)坐标,纹理——并依靠人类所选择的距离函数,如这里所使用. 后来的章节重温了其中的许多问题,利用深入的学习来自动地发现其特征和结合的规则: 第43章的例子分割使用类似的集群概念,第48章的自定义编码器完全从重建错误中学习特征空间本身,然后才要求任何集群。 如果本章的方法形成并适合它,则本课程稍后的深入学习方法将学习一种表述方式,并让结构从中产生。

blocks.en: 20.1 The structure tensor: what makes a good point to match?
blocks.zh: 20.1 国家 结构开关:什么是匹配的好点?.

blocks.en:
At each pixel, build the 2 × 2 2\times 2 structure tensor from the local window of gradients (Chapter 12 ): M = ∑ window [ I x 2 I x ​ I y I x ​ I y I y 2 ] . M=\sum_{\text{window}}\begin{bmatrix}I_{x}^{2}&I_{x}I_{y}\\
I_{x}I_{y}&I_{y}^{2}\end{bmatrix}. (20.1) This should look familiar: it’s exactly the moment covariance matrix from Chapter 6 , but built from gradients instead of pixel coordinates. Its eigenvalues λ 1 ≥ λ 2 \lambda_{1}\geq\lambda_{2} describe the local intensity structure: both small means a flat region (gradients weak in every direction), one large and one small means an edge (gradient strong perpendicular to it, weak along it), and both large means a corner (gradient strong in every direction — exactly the kind of point that can be precisely relocalized in another image), as illustrated on a test image in Figure 20.1 .
blocks.zh:
在每一个像素上,从地上梯度窗口(第12章)中构建出2×2 2\times 2结构的起角: M = + 窗口 [I x 2 I x I y I y y 2.]. M=\sum_{\text{window}}\begin{bmatrix}I_{x}^{2}&I_{x}I_{y}\\.
I_{x}i_{i_{i_{2}\end{bmatrix}. (20.1)这看起来应该很熟悉:它正是第六章的共变矩阵, 如图20.1的测试图像所显示的,其精度值为: λ 1 ≥ 2 \ (lambda 1 1 }\ ge ge ge ge ge lam ) 描述当地强度结构:小均指平地区域(每个方向的分级偏弱),大一和小均指边缘(与它相接的分级偏长,沿它相接的分级偏弱),而相接的大均指一角(每个方向的分级偏强——正是在另一个图像中可以精确地重新定位的那一类点).

blocks.zh: 图20.1:包含角、边缘和平地区域的测试图像。

blocks.en: 20.2 Harris corner detector
blocks.zh: 20.2 哈里斯角探测器

blocks.en: Directly computing eigenvalues everywhere is a bit expensive, so Harris and Stephens ( 1988 ) proposed a cheaper proxy using only det ( M ) \det(M) and trace ⁡ ( M ) \operatorname{trace}(M) (computable without ever finding eigenvalues): R = det ( M ) − k ⋅ trace ⁡ ( M ) 2 , k ≈ 0.04 . R=\det(M)-k\cdot\operatorname{trace}(M)^{2},\qquad k\approx 0.04. (20.2) R R is large and positive at corners, negative at edges, and near zero on flat regions. A from-scratch implementation correlates perfectly ( 1.0 1.0 ) with cv2.cornerHarris , shown in Figure 20.2 .
blocks.zh: 直接计算各地的eigenvalues有点昂贵,因此Harris和Stephens(1988年)提出了一个更便宜的代理,只使用 det(M)\det(M)和 track(M)\operatorname{trace}(M)(可计算而从未找到eigenvaluers): R= det(M)- k tracher (M) 2, k 0.04. R=\det(M)- k\cdot\operatorname{trace} (M)},\qquad k\ 0.04. (20.2) R是大而正的角,边缘是负的,平地地区接近零. 图20.2显示,从划线执行与cv2.corner Harris完全相关(1.0-1.0)。

blocks.en: Figure 20.2: The test image and its Harris response R R (red = corner, blue = edge).
blocks.zh: 图20.2:测试图像及其哈里斯反应R R(红色=角,蓝色=边缘).

blocks.en: 20.3 Shi-Tomasi: “Good Features to Track”
blocks.zh: 20.3 联合国 Shi-Tomasi:“良好地物进入轨道”

blocks.en: Shi and Tomasi ( 1994 ) argued for using the minimum eigenvalue of M M directly instead of Harris’s determinant/trace proxy: R ST = min ⁡ ( λ 1 , λ 2 ) . R_{\text{ST}}=\min(\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2}). (20.3) A point is only a strong corner if both eigenvalues are large — the minimum being large is exactly that condition, and (unlike Harris’s R R ) it has a direct, easily interpretable meaning: it’s proportional to the worst-case tracking precision in any direction. A from-scratch computation correlates perfectly ( 1.0 1.0 ) with cv2.cornerMinEigenVal , as Figure 20.3 shows.
blocks.zh: Shi和Tomasi(1994年)主张直接使用M M的最小eigen值,而不是Harris的决定因素/追踪代理:R ST = min ⁡ (λ 1,λ 2). (原始内容存档于2017-09-29). R_{\text{ST}}=\min (\lambda_{1}),\lambda_{2}. (20.3) 如果两个精度值都是大的,那么一个分点只是一个强角——最小值就是这个条件,(与哈里斯的RR不同)它具有直接,容易解释的意义:它与任何方向最坏的跟踪精度成正比. 如图20.3所示,从划线计算与cv2.cornerMinEigenVal 完美相联。

blocks.en: 20.4 The scale problem
blocks.zh: 20.4 (中文(简体) ). 尺度问题

blocks.en: Harris and Shi-Tomasi both operate at a single, fixed window size. Zoom the same corner in or out, and it may stop looking like a corner at that fixed scale (a sharp corner becomes a gentle curve when zoomed out enough) — these detectors are not scale-invariant. SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) ( Lowe, 1999/2004 ) fixes this by searching for keypoints across an entire scale-space, not just one window size.
blocks.zh: Harris和Shi-Tomasi都以单一固定的窗口大小运作. 将同一角放大出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 SIFT(Cale-Invariant Feature Transform)(Lowe,1999/2004)通过搜索整个比例空间的键位来修正这一点,而不仅仅是一个窗口大小.

blocks.en: 20.5 SIFT: scale-space extrema and descriptors
blocks.zh: 20.5 SIFT:比例尺-空间外观和描述符

blocks.en: SIFT’s pipeline, at a glance: 1. Build a Difference-of-Gaussians (DoG) scale-space — exactly the DoG approximation to the Laplacian from Chapter 13 , computed at many blur levels. 2. Find keypoints as local extrema of DoG response across both space and scale — a point that’s a maximum compared to its 26 neighbors (8 in the current scale, 9 in each scale level up and down). 3. Assign each keypoint a dominant orientation from the local gradient histogram, so descriptors can be made rotation-invariant. 4. Build a 128-dimensional descriptor from histograms of gradient orientations in a 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid of subregions around the keypoint. The result: a keypoint with a position, a scale, an orientation, and a descriptor vector designed to be very similar between two images even under moderate rotation, scaling, and illumination change. On a real photo, cv2.SIFT_create() finds 723 723 keypoints, each with a 128-dim descriptor, shown in Figure 20.4 .
blocks.zh: SIFT的管道, 1. 建立高斯人(DoG)的尺度空间——正是DOG从第13章到Laplacian的近似值,其计算方式很多模糊。 2. 在空间和尺度上查找作为DoG响应的局部极限的关键点,这个点与其26个邻接点相比是最大点(目前的尺度为8个,上下各为9个)。 3. 从本地梯度直方图中指定每个关键点为主取向,因此描述符可以被做为旋转-变相. 4. 在环绕关键点的4×4 4\times 4个次区域网格中,从梯度取向的直方图上建立128维描述符。 结果:一个键点,有一个位置,一个尺度,一个取向,以及一个描述矢量,设计成即使在中度旋转,缩放,和发光变化下两个图像之间非常相似. 在一幅真实相片上,cv2.SIFT_create () 找到723个723个键点,每个键点有128个刻度,如图20.4所示.

blocks.en: 20.6 Matching under rotation and scale
blocks.zh: 20.6 轮调和比额表下的匹配

blocks.en: Rotating and shrinking the image with a known transform ( 35 ∘ 35^{\circ} rotation, 0.7 × 0.7\times scale), detecting SIFT features independently in both, and matching descriptors with a nearest-neighbor search: 723 723 keypoints in the original, 365 365 in the rotated-and-scaled version. Lowe’s ratio test keeps a match only if the best candidate is meaningfully closer than the second -best candidate — a simple, effective way to reject ambiguous matches; here it keeps 191 191 of 723 723 candidate pairs.

blocks.en: 21.1 The brightness constancy assumption
blocks.zh: 21.1 联合国 亮度稳健的假设

blocks.en: Optical flow assumes a point’s intensity doesn’t change as it moves: I ⁡ ( x , y , t ) = I ⁡ ( x + u , y + v , t + 1 ) I(x,y,t)=I(x+u,y+v,t+1) . A first-order Taylor expansion of the right side gives the optical flow constraint equation : I x ​ u + I y ​ v + I t = 0 , I_{x}u+I_{y}v+I_{t}=0, (21.1) where I x , I y I_{x},I_{y} are the spatial gradients (Chapter 12 ) and I t I_{t} is the frame-to-frame intensity difference. This is one equation with two unknowns ( u u and v v ) at every single pixel — not enough information on its own to solve for the flow.
blocks.zh: 光学流假定一个点的强度不会随着移动而变化: I → (x, y, t) = I → (x + u, y + v, t + 1) I (x,y,t) = I (x + u,y + v,t+ 1). 右侧的一阶泰勒扩展 使光学流限制方程: I x u + I y v + I t = 0, I_{x}u+ I_{y}v_{t}=0, (21.1) 其中 I x, I y_{x}, I_{y} 是空间梯度( 第 12 章),而 It I_{t}t} 是帧-帧强度相差. 这是一个方程式,每个像素都有两个未知数(u u和v v)——没有足够的信息自己解决流量.

blocks.en: 21.2 The aperture problem
blocks.zh: 21.2 国家 孔径问题

blocks.en: Looking through a small window at a moving edge, only the motion perpendicular to the edge is visible; motion along the edge produces no visible change at all, as Figure 21.1 demonstrates. This is exactly why the flow constraint equation is underdetermined: it only ever constrains the component of ( u , v ) (u,v) along the gradient direction ( I x , I y ) (I_{x},I_{y}) , leaving the perpendicular component completely unconstrained.
blocks.zh: 在移动边上通过一扇小窗来查看,只有与边缘相垂直的运动是可见的;沿边缘的运动完全没有产生可见的变化,如图21.1所显示. 正因为如此,流量约束方程被低估了:它只会使(u, v) (u,v) 的组件沿着梯度方向被限制(Ix, Iy) (I_{x}, I_{y}),使得由位元组分完全不受限制.

blocks.en: Figure 21.1: Two different true motions (right + + down vs. down-only). Inside a small window straddling the rectangle’s top (horizontal) edge, the two motions look pixel-for-pixel identical — verified directly: a local measurement genuinely cannot tell them apart.
blocks.zh: 图21.1:两个不同的真实运动(右+下+下与下-只). 在一个横跨矩形顶端(横向)边缘的小窗口内,两个运动看起来像素换像素完全相同——直接核实:一个局部测量真的无法将它们区分开来.

blocks.en: 21.3 Lucas-Kanade: solving the aperture problem with a window
blocks.zh: 21.3 卢卡斯-卡纳德:用窗口解决孔径问题

blocks.en:
Lucas and Kanade’s fix ( 1981 ): assume the flow ( u , v ) (u,v) is constant over a small window , then combine the flow constraint equation from every pixel in that window into an overdetermined least-squares system: [ ∑ I x 2 ∑ I x ​ I y ∑ I x ​ I y ∑ I y 2 ] ⏟ M ​ [ u v ] = − [ ∑ I x ​ I t ∑ I y ​ I t ] . \underbrace{\begin{bmatrix}\sum I_{x}^{2}&\sum I_{x}I_{y}\\
\sum I_{x}I_{y}&\sum I_{y}^{2}\end{bmatrix}}_{M}\begin{bmatrix}u\\
v\end{bmatrix}=-\begin{bmatrix}\sum I_{x}I_{t}\\
\sum I_{y}I_{t}\end{bmatrix}. (21.2) M M is exactly the structure tensor from Chapter 20 ! This is not a coincidence: solving this system requires M M to be invertible, i.e. to have two large eigenvalues — precisely the Shi-Tomasi “good feature to track” condition. A flat region ( M M near zero) or an edge (one small eigenvalue — the aperture problem again) gives an ill-conditioned or singular system; a corner gives a well-conditioned one. Corners are trackable for exactly the same reason they’re good corners.

blocks.en: Larger motions need iteration
blocks.zh: 大动作需要重迭

blocks.en: The single-shot linear solve relies on the Taylor approximation, which only holds for small motions. For a larger true shift of ( 4.0 , 3.0 ) (4.0,3.0) : the single-shot manual solve degrades badly, averaging to ( 0.846 , 0.690 ) (0.846,0.690) , while cv2.calcOpticalFlowPyrLK recovers it essentially exactly at ( 4.000 , 3.000 ) (4.000,3.000) , as shown in Figure 21.3 .
blocks.zh: 单发线性溶解依赖于泰勒近似,仅能支撑小动作. 较大的正移( 4. 0, 3. 0) ( 4. 0, 3. 0) : 如图21.3所显示,单发手册的溶解率严重下降,平均为(0.846,0.690) (0.846,0.690),而cv2.calcoptical FlowPyrLK则基本完全恢复到(4.000,3.000) (4.000,3.000) (4.000,3.000) 。

blocks.en: Figure 21.3: Tracked corners with a larger true motion, using cv2.calcOpticalFlowPyrLK .
blocks.zh: 图21.3:采用cv2.calcOptical FlowPyrLK的有轨角正运动较大.

blocks.en: OpenCV’s calcOpticalFlowPyrLK handles large motions by running Lucas-Kanade iteratively (re-warping and re-linearizing until convergence) on an image pyramid (Chapter 11 ) — estimate coarsely on a small, blurry version of the image first, then refine level by level. This combination lets it recover large motions accurately even though the underlying linear approximation is only valid locally, one small step at a time.
blocks.zh: OpenCV的CalcOptical FlowPyrLK通过在图像金字塔上迭代地运行Lucas-Kanade(再拨和再线化到会合)来处理大型运动(第11章)——首先粗略地估计图像小而模糊的版本,再按级别细化. 这种组合使得它能够精确地恢复出巨大的运动,尽管基础的线性近似只在局部有效,一次一小步.

blocks.en: 21.4 Horn-Schunck: a global alternative to windowed flow
blocks.zh: 21.4 喇叭 - Schunck: 窗口流动的全球替代方案

blocks.en: Lucas-Kanade’s window is a local smoothness assumption: flow is constant over a small neighborhood, estimated independently at each point. The same year, Horn and Schunck ( 1981 ) proposed a global alternative: instead of many independent per-window solves, minimize a single energy over the whole image at once, trading off how well the flow satisfies the optical flow constraint equation against how smoothly it varies between neighboring pixels: E ⁡ ( u , v ) = ∑ x , y ( I x ​ u + I y ​ v + I t ) 2 ⏟ data term + α 2 ​ ( ‖ ∇ u ‖ 2 + ‖ ∇ v ‖ 2 ) ⏟ smoothness term . E(u,v)=\sum_{x,y}\underbrace{(I_{x}u+I_{y}v+I_{t})^{2}}_{\text{data term}}\;+\;\alpha^{2}\underbrace{\left(\|\nabla u\|^{2}+\|\nabla v\|^{2}\right)}_{\text{smoothness term}}. (21.3) The smoothness term is what makes this global: it couples every pixel’s flow to its neighbors’, so minimizing E E (e.g. by iterative Gauss-Seidel updates) lets reliable flow estimates near edges propagate into flat, textureless regions that have no local information of their own — exactly the failure mode the aperture problem produces at its worst, as Figure 21.4 shows.
blocks.zh: Lucas-Kanade的窗口是一个局部平滑的假设:流量在小的街区上是恒定的,每个点都独立估计. 同年,Horn和Schunck(1981年)提出了一个全球替代方案:而不是许多独立的每个窗口的解决方案,而是一次将整个图像上的单个能量最小化,将流量满足光学流量约束方程的程度与相邻像素之间的相差是否平和进行交换:E → (u,v) = → (i) (I x u + I v + I t) 2 → 数据术语 + α 2 (  u + + + + → + + + → + → → → → → 平滑度术语 。 E( u, v) { sum_{x, y}\nderbrace{( I_{x} u+ I_{y}v+ I_{t}}}}} {2}}_{\ 文本{数据 术语 QQ; Q;\ alpha QQ2\\ bederbrace\ left(\ nabla) u2}+\|\nabla v\|^{2}\right) }_{\text{smoothness term}}. (21.3) 平滑名词是这个全球的原因:它将每个像素的流量与相邻的相接,因此将E最小化(例如通过迭代高斯-赛义德更新),让接近边缘的可靠流量估计传播到没有本地信息的平坦而无纹理的地区——正是孔径问题产生的最糟糕的故障模式,如图21.4所示.

blocks.en: Figure 21.4: Flow magnitude spreading outward from a single textured square, after 1, 20, and 200 Gauss-Seidel iterations. After just 1 iteration, flow is only nonzero right at the square’s edges; by 200 iterations it has spread well beyond, though still far from every pixel — a real solver would run more iterations (or use a pyramid) to converge everywhere.
blocks.zh: 图21.4:流度从一个有纹理的单一平方向外扩散,经过了1,20和200个高斯-塞德尔迭代. 仅仅经过了1个迭代后,流在正方形边缘只有非零;通过200个迭代,流被远远地扩展到了更远的地方,尽管仍然远离每个像素——一个真正的解子会运行更多的迭代(或使用金字塔)来将各个地方汇合.

blocks.en: 21.5 Farnebäck’s method for dense optical flow
blocks.zh: 21.5 Farnebäck的致密光学流动方法

blocks.en: Horn-Schunck’s global optimization is elegant but expensive and slow to converge; for dense (every-pixel) flow, Farnebäck’s method ( 2003 ) — exposed as cv2.calcOpticalFlowFarneback — is a more popular method actually used in practice. It stays local, like Lucas-Kanade, but drops the constant-flow-in-a-window assumption in favor of locally approximating each neighborhood with a polynomial and comparing the polynomial expansions between frames.
blocks.zh: Horn-Schunck的全球优化是优雅而昂贵并缓慢地汇合;对于密集的(每个像素)流量,Farnebäck的方法(2003年)——作为cv2.calcoptical暴露. FlowFarneback——是一种实际使用的更受欢迎的方法. 它像Lucas-Kanade一样留在当地,但放弃了恒流-入-入-入-入-入-入的假设,有利于当地将每个街区都与多名相近,并比较了相框之间的多名相扩张.

blocks.en: On a synthetic scene with true motion ( 5.0 , − 3.0 ) (5.0,-3.0) : averaging the dense flow over all pixels gives a biased ( 2.25 , − 1.35 ) (2.25,-1.35) , but restricting to textured (high-gradient) pixels recovers ( 5.00 , − 3.00 ) (5.00,-3.00) almost exactly. This is the aperture problem again, at its most extreme: over flat, textureless background, there’s no local information at all to estimate motion from, dragging the whole-image average away from the true value. Figure 21.5 shows the resulting flow field.
blocks.zh: 在合成场景中,真实运动(5.0,-3.0) (5.0,-3.0): 平均所有像素上密集的流能产生偏差(2.25;-1.35;2.25;-1.35),但仅限于纹理(高梯度)像素恢复(5.00;-3.00;5.00;-3.00)几乎完全恢复. 这又是孔径问题,最极端的是:超平坦、无纹理的背景,根本没有局部信息来估计运动,把整个图像平均值拖出真实值。 图21.5显示了由此产生的流动领域。

blocks.en: Figure 21.5: A synthetic frame and its dense Farnebäck flow field, visualized with color = direction, brightness = speed. Every moving circle produces the same color here, since they all share the same true motion.
blocks.zh: 图21.5:一个合成框架及其密集的法尔内贝克流场,可视化为色=向,亮=快. 每个移动的圆圈在这里产生相同的颜色,因为它们都具有相同的真实运动.

blocks.en: A real video: the Army sequence
blocks.zh: 真实的视频:陆军序列

blocks.en: On a real video with independently moving objects, this color-coding immediately separates different motions at a glance (Figure 21.6 ) — exactly why it’s the standard way to visualize dense flow fields.
blocks.zh: 在一张有独立移动对象的真视频上,这种色彩编码会立即将不同的动作一一一地分出来(图21.6)——这正是为什么它是可视化密集流场的标准方法.

blocks.en: Figure 21.6: A frame from the Army sequence and its dense flow field. Image source: Middlebury Optical Flow .
blocks.zh: 图21.6:出自陆军序列及其密集流场的相框. 图片来源:Middlebury光学流.

blocks.en: 22.1 Rectified stereo: why the search is 1D
blocks.zh: 22.1 经更正的立体声:为什么搜索为1D

blocks.en: For a pair of cameras that are side-by-side, pointed the same direction, with parallel image planes (a rectified stereo pair — real camera rigs are calibrated and warped to approximate this), a fundamental fact of epipolar geometry applies: the corresponding point for any pixel in the left image lies on the same row in the right image. This collapses the search from a 2D image search down to a 1D scan along one row, and the horizontal offset between the two matching positions is the disparity d d .
blocks.zh: 对于一对相机相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相相接相相相相相相接相接相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 这导致搜索从2D图像搜索下到一行一D扫描,两个匹配位置之间的水平偏移是相差d d.

blocks.en: Disparity relates to depth by Z = f ⋅ B d , Z=\frac{f\cdot B}{d}, (22.1) where f f is the focal length and B B is the baseline (distance between the two camera centers). For a rectified pair, depth is inversely proportional to disparity : nearby objects have large disparity, distant objects have small disparity, and an object infinitely far away has zero disparity.
blocks.zh: 相差与深度相关,由Z=f → B d,Z=\frac{f\cdot B}{d}, (22.1)其中f为焦距,B为基线(两个相机中心之间的距离). 对于正对一对,深度与差异成反比:相邻物体有较大差异,相距遥远物体有小差异,相距无限的物体有零差异.

blocks.en: 22.2 A synthetic stereo pair with known ground truth
blocks.zh: 22.2 (中文(简体) ). 一个合成的立体对 已知的地面真理

blocks.en: A left image of pure random texture (so every patch is locally distinctive — no aperture-problem ambiguity), with a right image constructed by shifting each pixel left by its true disparity, set to three different constant values for three depth “planes”: a background and two nearer rectangles. Nearer surfaces uncover background pixels that have no corresponding pixel in the left image at all — an occlusion , patched with fresh random noise. Figure 22.1 shows the resulting stereo pair and ground truth.
blocks.zh: 一个纯随机纹理的左图像(因此每个补丁都具有本地特色——没有孔径-问题模糊),通过将每个像素由真实的相差所留下的相位移来构建出一个右图像,设定为三个深度"平面"的三个不同的常数:一个背景和一个更相近的矩形. 更相近的表面会发现背景像素,这些像素在左边的图像中根本没有相应的像素——一种被遮住,用新鲜的随机噪声来补上. 图22.1显示了由此产生的立体对和地面真相。

blocks.en: Figure 22.1: Left image, right image, and ground-truth disparity (three depth planes).
blocks.zh: 图22.1:左图、右图和地上-真实差距(三架深度平面)。

blocks.en: 22.3 Block matching along the scanline
blocks.zh: 22.3 沿扫描线进行区块匹配

blocks.en: For each pixel in the left image, slide a small window along the same row of the right image over a range of candidate disparities and keep the disparity with the lowest sum-of-squared-differences.
blocks.zh: 对于左边图像中的每个像素,在一系列候选相差上沿同一行右相差沿滑出一个小窗口,并保持相差与平分相差最小相差.

blocks.en: ⬇ for d in range ( max_disp + 1): xr = x - d right_patch = right_f [ y - half : y + half +1, xr - half : xr + half +1] cost = (( left_patch - right_patch )**2). sum () if cost < best_cost : best_cost , best_d = cost , d
blocks.zh: d在范围( 最大_ 磁盘+ 1): xr = x- d 右- patch = 右- f [y - 一半: y + 一半+ 1, xr - 一半: xr + 一半+ 1] 成本 = (( (左_ patch - 右- patch) **2). sm () 如果成本 < 最佳_ 成本: 最佳_ 成本, 最佳_ d = 成本, d

blocks.en: Figure 22.2: A 100 × 100 100\times 100 crop, its true disparity, and the recovered disparity from a from-scratch block matcher — the three depth planes are cleanly separated away from the border and depth-boundary regions.

As Figure 22.2 shows, within the interior of the rectangles, the recovered disparity matches the ground truth almost perfectly (mean disparity 5.03 5.03 , 15.03 15.03 , 25.04 25.04 against true values 5 5 , 15 15 , 25 25 ). The exception is the speckled band at each rectangle’s edge: a window straddling a depth boundary mixes pixels from two different true disparities, so no single candidate disparity fits the whole window well — a preview of the occlusion problem tackled next.
blocks.zh: 如图22.2所示,在矩形内部,所恢复的差距几乎完全符合地面真理(平均差距5.03 5.03、15.03 15.03、25.04 25.04与真实值5.5、15.15、25.25)。 例外是每个矩形边缘被斑点的带:一个跨越深度边界的窗口混合了两个不同真实差异的像素,因此没有单一候选差异与整个窗口完全吻合——这是下一个解决的隔离问题的预览.

blocks.en: 22.4 Catching bad matches: the left-right consistency check
blocks.zh: 22.4 国家 抓取错误匹配: 左- 右一致性检查

blocks.en: Occlusions and depth-boundary ambiguity produce wrong matches, like the speckle above. The fix: match both left-to-right and right-to-left, then keep only the pixels where the two results agree, discarding the rest as unreliable. Computing the right-to-left disparity needs no new code — flip both images left-right, swap which one plays “left,” run the exact same matcher, then flip the result back. Figure 22.3 shows both directions and the consistency result.
blocks.zh: 隐蔽和深度界限模糊会产生错误的匹配,如上面的相片. 定律:将左右相配,再将两个结果一致的像素只保留出相,将其余的都丢弃为不可靠. 计算出从右到左的相差不需要新的代码——将两个图像从左到右翻出,将一个玩出“左”的交换,运行一个完全相同的匹配器,然后将结果翻回。 图22.3显示双向和一致性结果。

blocks.en: Figure 22.3: Left-to-right disparity, right-to-left disparity, and the result after the consistency check (gray = rejected). On this crop, 1440 1440 of 10,000 10{,}000 pixels are marked inconsistent, concentrated at occlusions and depth-boundary windows.
blocks.zh: 图22.3:从左到右的差异,从右到左的差异,以及一致性检查后的结果(gray=拒绝)。 在这个作物上,一万个10{,}000像素中,有1440个1440个像素有明显的不一致,集中在被子和深界窗口上.

blocks.en: 22.5 The same thing, at full resolution, with OpenCV
blocks.zh: 22.5个 同样的东西,完全分辨率,与 OpenCV

blocks.en: cv2.StereoBM implements this same block-matching idea (with efficiency and post-processing refinements) fast enough to run on the whole image. StereoBM marks a pixel invalid wherever it isn’t confident in a unique match, e.g. too close to the image border to search the full disparity range, as Figure 22.4 shows.
blocks.zh: cv2.StereoBM执行这个相同的区块比对想法(高效和后处理改进)的速度足够快,可以运行在整个图像上. 立体声 BM 标记一个像素无效, 只要它不相信一个独特的匹配, 例如, 离图像边框太近, 无法搜索全部差异范围, 如图22.4所示 。

blocks.en: Figure 22.4: Ground truth vs. cv2.StereoBM output at full resolution (gray = invalid).
blocks.zh: 图22.4:地面真相与cv2.Stereo BM输出在完全分辨率(gray = 无效).

blocks.en: The left-right consistency check is also built into cv2.StereoBM — set disp12MaxDiff to a small positive number (typically 1) to enable it. On the full synthetic image: 21,706 21{,}706 valid pixels without the check, 21,442 21{,}442 with it — 264 264 pixels newly flagged invalid.
blocks.zh: 左-右一致性检查也包含在cv2. 立体声BM-将Disp12MaxDiff设定为小正数(典型为1)以启用. 在全合成图像上: 21,706 21{,}706 有效像素没有检查, 21,442 21{,}442 与之相接——264 264 264 像素新标记无效.

blocks.en: 22.6 Window size: detail vs. noise tradeoff
blocks.zh: 22.6 窗口大小:细节与噪声权衡

blocks.en: A larger matching window averages over more pixels, making the match more robust to noise but blurring across depth discontinuities. A smaller window preserves sharp depth boundaries but is more easily fooled by noise or repetitive texture, as Figure 22.5 shows.
blocks.zh: 更大的匹配窗口平均比像素的多,使得匹配更强于噪音,但模糊了深度不连续性。 如图22.5所示,较小的窗口保留了尖锐的深度界限,但更容易被噪音或重复的纹理所愚弄。

blocks.en: Figure 22.5: blockSize 5, 15, and 31 on the same stereo pair — small windows preserve sharp edges but are noisier; large windows are smoother but blur depth boundaries.
blocks.zh: 图22.5:同一立体对上块块Size 5,15,和31——小窗保存有尖锐的边缘但有噪声;大窗更平滑但深度界限模糊.

blocks.en: 22.7 A real stereo pair: Tsukuba
blocks.zh: 22.7 联合国 真正的立体声配对: Tukuba

blocks.en: Everything so far has used synthetic images, precisely so the ground truth is known. The same three passes (left-to-right, right-to-left, consistency check) apply exactly as before on an actual rectified stereo pair of photographs, shown in Figure 22.6 .
blocks.zh: 目前为止,所有的东西都使用了合成图像,正是这样,地面的真相才为人所知. 同三份通行证(从左到右、从右到左、从左到左、从左到右、从左到右、从左到右)完全适用于实际纠正的一对立体声照片,见图22.6。

blocks.en: Figure 22.6: Left-to-right, right-to-left, and consistency-checked disparity on the Tsukuba stereo pair. The lamp, the nearest object in the scene, stands out with the largest disparity; the bookshelves recede smoothly behind it. Only 1121 1121 of 110,592 110{,}592 pixels ( 1.0 % 1.0\% ) get flagged — concentrated exactly along depth discontinuities: book spines, shelf edges, the head’s silhouette. Image source: Middlebury Stereo Datasets (University of Tsukuba).
blocks.zh: 图22.6:Thukuba立体对上左向右,右向左相接和一致性检查差异. 灯是现场最接近的物体,以最大的差异而出;书架在后方平稳地退去. 110,592,110{,}592像素中只有1121,1121像素(1.0 % 1.0\%)被标出 — — 完全集中在深度断层上:书脊,书架边缘,头部的平面。 图片来源:Middlebury Stereo Datas (鹤巴大学).

blocks.en: 22.8 From disparity to depth map
blocks.zh: 22.8 从差异到深度地图

blocks.en: Given a focal length and baseline (in whatever consistent units), Z = f ​ B / d Z=fB/d converts a disparity map directly into a metric depth map (Figure 22.7 ), which can then be lifted into a 3D point cloud (Figure 22.8 ).
blocks.zh: 鉴于焦距和基线(无论用何种一致的单位),Z=f B /d Z=fB/d 将差分图直接转换为公尺深度图(图22.7),然后可以升起为3D点云(图22.8).

blocks.en: Figure 22.7: The synthetic scene’s disparity map converted to metric depth.
blocks.zh: 图22.7:合成场景的相差图转换为公尺深度.

blocks.en: Figure 22.8: The depth map lifted into 3D: three flat terraces at three different heights, with holes where StereoBM had no confident match cut cleanly out of each one.
blocks.zh: 图22.8:深地图升入3D:三个平地梯田,高地有3个平地梯田,其中有孔为立体. BM没有自信的比赛 每一次都干净地切出。

blocks.en: Exercises
blocks.zh: 练习

blocks.en: 1. Replace the random-texture left image with a flat gray region for the background (keeping the two rectangles textured). Run cv2.StereoBM again and describe what happens to the disparity estimate over the flat area — this is the aperture problem from Chapter 21 , now in a stereo-matching context. 2. Try cv2.StereoSGBM_create (semi-global block matching, which enforces smoothness across neighboring disparities rather than matching each pixel completely independently) in place of StereoBM . Compare the amount of speckle noise in flat/background regions between the two methods. 3. Increase the baseline in the depth conversion. blocks.en: 23.1 Ordinary vs. total least squares
blocks.zh: 23.1 普通对平方总和

blocks.en: Fitting y = m ​ x + b y=mx+b by minimizing ∑ ( y i − ( m ​ x i + b ) ) 2 \sum(y_{i}-(mx_{i}+b))^{2} — ordinary least squares (OLS) — measures error vertically . That’s the right choice when x x is known exactly and only y y is noisy, but not when both coordinates carry comparable noise, as they typically do for 2D image points: the fit gets biased toward whichever direction has less spread. Total least squares (TLS) instead minimizes the perpendicular distance from each point to the line, treating both coordinates symmetrically.
blocks.zh: 通过最小化将 Y = m x + b y = mx + b (y i − (m x i + b ) ) ) 2\ sum(y_{i}-(mx_{i}+b)))) } — 普通最小平方 (OLS) — 垂直度量错误. 这是正确的选择, 当xx被确切知道, 并且只有yy是吵闹的, 但当两个坐标都带有相似的噪音, 平方总和(TLS)取而代之的是将从每个点到线的垂直距离最小化,对两个坐标进行对称处理.

blocks.en: For a 2D line, TLS needs no new machinery: the best-fit line passes through the centroid, and its direction is the eigenvector of the (centered) points’ covariance matrix with the largest eigenvalue — exactly Chapter 6 ’s covariance-and-eigenvectors idea, just picking out the axis of maximum spread instead of describing a blob’s shape.
blocks.zh: 对于一款2D线,TLS不需要新的机械:最合适的线会穿过中间行星,它的取向是(以)点的共变矩阵的精度,其精度值最大——恰好是第6章的共变和精度概念,只是挑出最大分布的轴来,而不是描述出blob的形状.

blocks.en: On a steep true line y = 3.00 ​ x + 1.00 y=3.00x+1.00 with comparable noise on both axes: OLS fits y = 2.70 ​ x + 1.67 y=2.70x+1.67 (biased, since x x is noisy too), while TLS fits y = 2.97 ​ x + 0.98 y=2.97x+0.98 — noticeably closer to the true slope, as Figure 23.1 shows.
blocks.zh: 在陡峭的正线上y = 3.00 x + 1.00 y = 3.00 x + 1.00 两轴上具有可比较的噪声: OLS相配y = 2.70 x + 1.67 y = 2.70 x +1.67 (有偏见,因为xx也吵),而TLS相配y = 2.97 x + 0.98 y = 2.97x + 6.98 —明显地更接近正坡,如图23.1所示.

blocks.en: Figure 23.1: OLS (vertical error) vs. TLS (perpendicular error) when both x x and y y are noisy.

blocks.en: 23.2 Why least squares breaks under outliers
blocks.zh: 23.2 采购 为什么至少有平方在外出点下破裂

blocks.en: Least-squares fitting minimizes the sum of squared residuals. But squaring has a drawback: every outlier (point far from the model) contributes an enormous amount to the total error, causing the whole fit to move away from all the other, correct points. On data with 40 true inliers plus 15 unrelated outliers: the true line y = 2.00 ​ x + 5.00 y=2.00x+5.00 becomes an OLS fit of y = 1.02 ​ x + 9.81 y=1.02x+9.81 — badly dragged off course, as Figure 23.2 shows.
blocks.zh: 最小平方装配能将平方残基的总和最小化. 但squaring有一个缺点:每个出局者(距离模型很远的点)都为总误差贡献了巨大的分量,导致整个合身者远离了所有其他正确点. 在有40个正入射线外加15个不相干出射线的数据上:正出射线y= 2.00 x + 5.00 y= 2.00 x + 5.0 0 成为了 y 为 1.02 x + 9.81 y= 1.02 x + 9.81 – 如图23.2所示被严重拖出航线.

blocks.en: 23.3 RANSAC: fit from the inside out
blocks.zh: 23.3 RANSAC:从内向外安装

blocks.en: RANSAC (RANdom SAmple Consensus, Fischler & Bolles, 1981 ) flips the strategy: instead of using all the data and hoping outliers don’t matter, it repeatedly picks the smallest possible random subset needed to define a candidate model, counts how many of the remaining points agree with it (the consensus set ), and keeps whichever candidate has the most agreement. A final least-squares refit on the winning inlier set gives the polished result.
blocks.zh: RANSAC(RANdom Sample Consultion, Fischler & Bolles, 1981年)翻转策略:它不使用所有数据, 希望外线无关紧要, 最后的最小平方重置取胜的进取档 给出了被打磨的结果。

blocks.en: On the same contaminated data: RANSAC fits y = 2.05 ​ x + 4.94 y=2.05x+4.94 , finding 42 42 of 55 55 points as inliers (planted: 40 40 true inliers) — essentially recovering the true line despite 27 % 27\% outlier contamination, as Figure 23.3 shows.
blocks.zh: 在同一被污染的数据上:RANSAC = 2.05 x + 4.94 y = 2.05x + 4.94,发现55分中的42分为55分(植入:40分为40分)——基本上恢复了正线,尽管如图23.3所示,有27%的27分以上污染。

blocks.en: Figure 23.3: RANSAC’s found inliers (blue) vs. rejected outliers (red), and the resulting fit.
blocks.zh: 图23.3:RANSAC发现的出厂商(蓝色)与被拒绝出厂商(红色),以及由此产生的适中性。

blocks.en: How many iterations does RANSAC need?
blocks.zh: RANSAC需要多少迭代次数?.

blocks.en: If a fraction w w of the data are inliers, and the model needs a minimal sample of n n points, the probability that any one random sample is entirely inliers is w n w^{n} . To be at least p p confident of drawing an all-inlier sample at least once across N N independent tries: N = log ⁡ ( 1 − p ) log ⁡ ( 1 − w n ) . N=\frac{\log(1-p)}{\log(1-w^{n})}. (23.1)
blocks.zh: 如果一个分数 w w 的数据是更强的,而模型需要最小的 n n 分样本,那么任何一个随机样本是完全更强的概率是 w n w^{n}. 至少在 N 独立尝试中 p 自信地绘制出一个至少一次的全英寸样本 : N = log QQ (1–p) log QQ (1–w n). N = frac\ log (1-p)\ (1-w^{n})}. (23.1).

blocks.en: Fitting a line only needs 2 points, so even fairly heavy contamination ( 50 % 50\% outliers) needs just a few dozen iterations. Fitting a homography needs a minimal sample of 4 points, so the same inlier fraction needs an order of magnitude more iterations — the price of a more complex model. A fundamental matrix (minimal sample 8) is far more sensitive still: at 30 % 30\% inliers, over 70,000 70{,}000 iterations would be needed for the same confidence.
blocks.zh: 排出一条线只需要2分,所以即使相当严重的污染(50%的50分)也只需要几十个迭代。 拼接一对相机需要4分的最小样本,所以同样的更深的分数需要一个更迭相的数量级——一个更复杂的模型的价格. 基本矩阵(最小样本8)仍然更为敏感:同样的信心需要30 % 30%的升降机,70,000%以上的升降机。

blocks.en: 23.4 A gentler alternative: robust loss functions
blocks.zh: 23.4 联合国 更温和的选择:强大的损失功能

blocks.en: RANSAC makes a hard inlier/outlier decision. An alternative family, M-estimators , instead reweights every point’s contribution smoothly — e.g. the Huber loss behaves like ordinary squared error for small residuals but switches to linear (much less aggressive) growth beyond a threshold, so a single very-wrong point can no longer dominate the total cost. RANSAC and M-estimators are complementary in practice: RANSAC is excellent at rejecting gross outliers, while an M-estimator refinement afterward can down-weight smaller, more subtle deviations among the remaining inliers.
blocks.zh: RANSAC作出更硬/更严格的决定。 一个替代家庭,即M-估计者,却平稳地重新权衡每一点的贡献——例如,Huber的损失表现得像小残余物的普通平方差错,但转换成线性(相当少的激进)增长超过一个阈值,因此一个非常错误的点无法再主宰总成本。 RANSAC和M-估计器在实践中是互补的:RANSAC在拒绝粗略的外延器方面是出色的,而M-估计器在之后的改进可以降低剩余外延器中较小的更微妙的偏差.

blocks.en: On the same data: OLS gives y = 1.02 ​ x + 9.81 y=1.02x+9.81 , Huber-reweighting gives y = 1.90 ​ x + 5.58 y=1.90x+5.58 , and RANSAC gives y = 2.05 ​ x + 4.94 y=2.05x+4.94 — Huber lands between the two, much closer to the true line ( y = 2.00 ​ x + 5.00 y=2.00x+5.00 ) than OLS, though not quite as exact as RANSAC on data this heavily contaminated, since a handful of gross outliers still pull a little on every iteration rather than being cut out entirely. Figure 23.4 compares all three fits.

blocks.en: A homography exactly relates two photos in exactly two situations: photographing a flat surface from two different positions, or photographing any 3D scene, flat or not, from the same camera position while only rotating the camera between shots. That second case is what makes Chapter 25 ’s panorama stitching work on ordinary, non-planar scenes — a translating camera or a genuinely 3D scene viewed from two different positions has no single homography that relates the two images exactly.
blocks.zh: 一幅相片与两张相片完全相关:从两个不同位置拍摄平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平 第二起案件使得第25章的全景在普通的、非平面的场景上——从两个不同位置看到的翻译相机或真实的3D场景——缝合工作没有完全与这两个图像相关的单一的相片.

blocks.en: 24.4 Perspective correction: rectifying a photographed document
blocks.zh: 24.4 视角更正:纠正被拍照的文件

blocks.en: The most common practical use of a homography: given 4 point correspondences (e.g. the 4 corners of a document), cv2.getPerspectiveTransform solves for the unique homography mapping one set of 4 points to the other, and cv2.warpPerspective applies it. The trapezoid shape a photographed rectangle takes on — edges that were parallel in real life visibly converging in the photo — is called keystoning , and it’s exactly the vanishing-point effect above, now applied to a document, as Figure 24.2 shows.
blocks.zh: 交相图最常用的实用用法是:给定了4个分相图(如一个文档的4个角相图),cv2.getPerspective Transform为一集相图4个分相图,cv2.warpPerspective应用. 图24.2显示,照片上的矩形形状——在现实生活中明显一致的边缘——被称为按键定点,而这正是上面的消失点效应。

blocks.en: Figure 24.2: A document, a simulated photograph at an angle (strong keystoning), and the rectified result from 4 corner correspondences. Mean absolute pixel difference after the distort-then-rectify round trip is 4.59 4.59 — small resampling loss only.
blocks.zh: 图24.2: 一份文件、一个角度的模拟相片(强键盘),以及4个角相函的纠正结果。 扭曲后-当时-校正回程后的平均绝对像素差为4.59 4.59-只进行小回样损失.

blocks.en: 24.5 Solving for a homography from many correspondences
blocks.zh: 24.5 国家 解决许多信件的相传

blocks.en: 4 correspondences exactly determine a homography’s 8 degrees of freedom, with no slack for error. With more than 4 (typically from automatic feature matching, Chapter 20 ), the problem becomes an overdetermined least-squares fit — the Direct Linear Transform (DLT) algorithm that cv2.findHomography implements, optionally wrapped in RANSAC (Chapter 23 ) to reject bad correspondences as outliers.
blocks.zh: 4个函文精确地决定了一个图谱的8度自由度,不会因为出错而松懈. 有了超过4个(通常来自自发特性相配,第20章),问题就变成了一个被过分确定的最小方位相配——Cv2. findHomography results的直线变形(DLT)算法,可选地被RANSAC(第23章)包裹来拒绝将差错的函证作为外接.

blocks.en: With 30 clean synthetic correspondences: findHomography recovers the true homography to 4 decimal places, with all 30 points marked as inliers.
blocks.zh: 有了30个干净的合成函文: find Homography 将真实的同位素恢复到小数点后4个位子,所有30分被标记为更生.

blocks.en: RANSAC in practice: homography estimation with bad matches
blocks.zh: RANSAC在实际操作中:图谱估计与差匹配

blocks.en: With clean correspondences, passing cv2.RANSAC to findHomography makes no visible difference — there’s nothing to reject. Injecting 15 deliberately garbage correspondences alongside the 30 genuine ones shows the real effect: RANSAC finds exactly the 30 genuine correspondences (inliers: 30 / 45 30/45 ) and reconstructs the homography to a mean reprojection error of 1.49 × 10 − 6 1.49\times 10^{-6} pixels on the true inliers. A plain least-squares fit on the same contaminated data reaches a mean reprojection error of 1.06 × 10 4 1.06\times 10^{4} pixels — off by ten orders of magnitude more, effectively useless for anything requiring pixel-level accuracy, because 15 15 bad matches out of 45 45 ( 33 % 33\% ) was more than enough to corrupt an unweighted sum-of-squares fit.
blocks.zh: 有干净的通信,通过cv2。 寻找Homography的RANSAC没有明显区别, 将15个故意的垃圾信件和30个真信一起注射,显示了真实的效果:RANSAC找到30个真信(nliers:30/45 30/45),并将正信重塑为1.49×10-6 1.49\tims 10^{-6}正信回信的平面像素. 符合同一被污染数据的平地最小平方块达到1.06×10 4 1.06\times 10^{4}像素的平均再投射误差——减少10个数量级,对需要像素水平精确度的任何东西实际上无济于事,因为45个中15个差的比对(33%为33\%)已经超过破坏一个未加权的平方块相接误差.

blocks.en: 24.6 Looking ahead: projective geometry in 3D
blocks.zh: 24.6 展望未来:以3D为单位的投影几何

blocks.en: Everything in this chapter has been 2D-to-2D: a homography relates two planes (images or flat surfaces in the world). Later chapters extend the same projective machinery one dimension further, deriving the camera’s projection matrix that maps a 3D scene onto a 2D image in the first place.
blocks.zh: 本章中的一切都是由2D到2D:一对相机相接相接有两对相机(相机或平面相接于世界). 之后的章节将同一个投影机械进一步延伸了一个维度,衍生出摄影机的投影矩阵,将一幅三维相片映射到一幅二维相片上.

blocks.en: Step 1: feature matching
blocks.zh: 步骤1:特征匹配

blocks.en: SIFT finds 938 938 keypoints in view 1 and 708 708 in view 2; Lowe’s ratio test keeps 315 315 good matches, shown in Figure 25.2 .
blocks.zh: SIFT在1号观点和708 708号观点中发现了938 938个关键点;Lowe的比例测试保持了315 315个好匹配,如图25.2所示.

blocks.en: Step 2: robust homography
blocks.zh: 第2步:稳健的相貌

blocks.en: Solve for the homography that maps points in view 2 into view 1’s coordinate frame, so warping view 2 through it lands it in the right place on a shared canvas: cv2.findHomography with RANSAC finds 263 263 of 315 315 matches as inliers.
blocks.zh: 解决将第2个视图指向第1个视图的坐标框的同名图谱问题,因此,第2个视图通过它落在一个共享的画布上的正确位置:cv2. FindHomography with RANSAC发现315个匹配的263个263个比分是更强的.

blocks.en: Steps 3-4: warp, composite, and blend
blocks.zh: 步骤3-4:曲率、复合和混合

blocks.en: First, figure out how big the output canvas needs to be, by mapping both images’ corners through H H (Chapter 24 ) and taking the bounding box — unlike a synthetic case, these photos aren’t simple axis-aligned crops of a shared frame, so the canvas size and the offset of view 1 within it both have to be computed rather than assumed. Warp view 2 onto that canvas, then blend the overlap region with a simple feather : a linear alpha ramp from “fully view 1” to “fully view 2” across the overlap, the same weighted-sum blending as cv2.addWeighted in Chapter 2 , just with a spatially-varying weight instead of a constant one. Figure 25.3 shows the resulting panorama.
blocks.zh: 首先,通过H(第24章)绘制两个图像的角并取取出捆绑的相框(与合成的相框不同),这些相框并不是共用相框的简单轴相接相接的相框,所以相框的相框大小和相抵消相片1必须同时计算而不是假设。 将重叠区域与简单的羽毛相混合:从“完全视图1”到“完全视图2”的线性阿尔法坡道重叠,与第2章中cv2.addWighted的加权和相混合,仅以空间变化的重量而不是恒定的重量。 图25.3显示了由此产生的全景。

blocks.en: Figure 25.3: The stitched panorama. The roof (top, fully visible only in view 2) and the bush (bottom, fully visible only in view 1) both appear in the mosaic, confirming that the composite genuinely draws from both source images.
blocks.zh: 图25.3:被缝合的全景. 屋顶(顶部,完全可见只见于2)和灌木(下部,完全可见只见于1)都出现在镶嵌图上,证实复合材料真实地取自两个出处的图像.

blocks.en: How good is the fit?
blocks.zh: 合适吗?

blocks.en: There’s no synthetic ground truth to compare against with a real photograph, but we don’t need one: the RANSAC inliers themselves give a direct measure of geometric fit. For each inlier correspondence, project the point from view 2 through H H and measure the distance to its matched point in view 1 — the reprojection error . Here: mean reprojection error 0.520 0.520 px, max 2.919 2.919 px — sub-pixel-scale error, well under the RANSAC inlier threshold of 3 px, confirming H H is a good geometric fit, consistent with the clean seam visible in the stitched panorama. Figure 25.4 histograms the reprojection error across all inliers.
blocks.zh: 与真实照片相比, 没有合成地面的真相, 但我们不需要: RANSAC穿透器本身给出了几何相配的直接度量。 对于每一个更强烈的函证,从第2到H到H的投影点,并测量距离到第1到它的相匹配点——再投影错误. 这里: 平均值再预测错误 0.520 0.520 px, 最大 2.919 2.919 px——分像素级误差, 远在 RANSAC 的更生阈值 3 px 下, 证实 H 是一个很好的几何相合体, 符合被缝合的全景所可见的干净接合. 图25.4 所有喷出器的再投射误差。

blocks.en: Figure 25.4: Reprojection error of the RANSAC inliers, histogrammed.
blocks.zh: 图25.4:RANSAC穿透器的再预测错误,直方图。

blocks.en: 25.3 In practice: cv2.Stitcher
blocks.zh: 25.3 国家 实际操作中: cv2. Stitcher.

blocks.en: OpenCV bundles this entire pipeline (plus more robust blending, exposure compensation, and support for many images at once) behind a single high-level call. Its default PANORAMA mode assumes the images come from a camera rotating about its optical center, and warps each image onto a sphere before compositing — great for wide panoramas, but it bows straight lines when the scene is dominated by flat, rectilinear structure (like a building facade) and the camera translated rather than purely rotated. SCANS mode instead composites with the planar homographies directly, matching the approach used above, as confirmed by the successful Stitcher run in Figure 25.5 .
blocks.zh: OpenCV将整个管道(加上更坚固地混合,曝光补偿,同时支持许多图像)捆绑在单一高层呼叫的背后. 其默认的PANORAMA模式假设图像来自一个相机围绕其光学中心旋转而来,将每个相机在堆肥前向一个球体扭曲——对于宽度全景来说是巨大的,但是当场景以平整,直线结构(像建筑外观)和相机翻译而不是纯粹旋转为主时,它会弯曲直线. SCANS模式取而代之的是直接与平面同构相配的复合材料,与上面使用的方法相匹配,图25.5中成功的斯德切运行证实了这一点.

blocks.en: Figure 25.5: cv2.Stitcher in SCANS mode: status OK .
blocks.zh: 图25.5: cv2. SCANS模式下stitcher:状态确定.

blocks.en: 26.2 Real lenses: focus and defocus blur
blocks.zh: 26.2 真实镜头:焦点和去焦点模糊

blocks.en: A pinhole camera lets in so little light that it needs absurdly long exposures. Real cameras use a lens to gather much more light, but lenses focus sharply only for objects at a particular distance (the focal plane ). Points nearer or farther than that spread their light over a small disk on the sensor (the circle of confusion ) instead of at a point — exactly the blurring convolution kernels from Chapters 9 – 10 , just applied with a kernel size that depends on depth. Focusing at 5 5 m: a near object (depth 2 2 m) gets kernel size 19 19 , the object at the focal plane gets kernel size 1 1 (unblurred), and a far object (depth 9 9 m) gets kernel size 25 25 (Figure 26.2 ).
blocks.zh: 针孔相机的光线太少 以至于需要荒谬的长时间曝光 真正的相机使用镜头来收集更多的光线,但镜头只为特定距离的物体(焦平面. )尖锐地聚焦. 更接近或更远的点将其光线分散在传感器上的一个小圆盘上(混乱的圆圈),而不是在某一点上——正是从第9章到第10章的模糊的演化内核,刚刚应用的内核大小取决于深度. 聚焦于5个5米:一个近物体(深度为2个2米)得到内核大小为19个19个,焦平面上的对象得到内核大小为1个1个(unblured),而一个远物体(深度为9个9米)得到内核大小为25个25个(图26.2.

blocks.en: Figure 26.2: All in focus (pinhole idealization) vs. focused at 5 5 m — near and far objects blur, the mid-depth object stays sharp.
blocks.zh: 图26.2:所有焦距(平洞理想化)对焦距为5相5米——近相和相距物体模糊,中深物体保持锐度.

blocks.en: This explains why a wider aperture gathers more light (at the expense of a shallower depth of field), while a narrow aperture produces a sharp image (but lets in less light) — the classic photographic aperture/depth-of-field tradeoff, and the reason portrait photos often blur the background while keeping the subject sharp.
blocks.zh: 这解释了为什么一个更宽的孔径能收集到更多的光线(牺牲了更浅的地段深度),而狭长的孔径能产生出一个尖锐的图像(但以更轻的光线)——经典的相片孔径/深地取舍,而正因肖像照片往往会模糊背景,同时保持主题的清晰.

blocks.en: 26.3 The Bayer color filter array: one color per pixel
blocks.zh: 26.3 联合国 Bayer 色彩过滤器阵列: 每个像素一个颜色

blocks.en: To keep costs down, most camera sensors don’t measure red, green, and blue separately at every pixel. Instead, a single monochrome photosensor array sits under a mosaic of tiny color filters, so each individual pixel physically records only one of the three colors. The most common arrangement (RGGB) — the Bayer filter ( Bayer, 1976 ) — repeats in a 2 × 2 2\times 2 tile pattern: one red, one blue, and two green filters, since the human eye is most sensitive to green. Every pixel in the raw sensor output is therefore missing two-thirds of its color information by construction, as Figure 26.3 shows.
blocks.zh: 为了降低成本,大多数相机传感器并不在每个像素上分别测量红、绿和蓝等分量。 取而代之的是,一个单色相光传感器阵列坐落在由细小的颜色过滤器组成的镶嵌下,因此每个像素物理上只记录出三种颜色中的一种. 最常见的安排(RGGB)——拜耳滤波器(Bayer,1976年)——以2×2相2相2相2相2相相2相平平瓦图案重复:一为红色,一为蓝色,二为绿色滤波器,因为人眼对绿色最敏感. 因此,如图26.3所示,原始传感器输出中的每个像素都缺少三分之二的构造颜色信息。

blocks.en: Figure 26.3: A true-color scene, a 16 × 16 16\times 16 crop of the raw Bayer mosaic (grayscale readout, no color visible), and the same crop colorized by filter, revealing the RGGB pattern.
blocks.zh: 图26.3:真彩色场景,16×16 16\时生活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活

blocks.en: Demosaicking: reconstructing RGB from the mosaic
blocks.zh: 解迷:从相模重建 RGB

blocks.en: Demosaicking fills in each pixel’s two missing colors by interpolating from same-color neighbors — the simplest version is bilinear: average the nearby known samples of a color, weighted by distance, exactly Chapter 9 ’s bilinear interpolation, just interpolating across a sparse, patterned grid of known samples. A from-scratch bilinear demosaicker reaches a mean absolute error of 3.37 3.37 against ground truth; cv2.cvtColor(..., cv2.COLOR_BayerBG2BGR) reaches 3.43 3.43 — both land within a fraction of a pixel value of each other, the residual mostly just sensor noise already present in the mosaic (Figure 26.4 ).
blocks.zh: Demosaicking通过从同色相邻的相邻上插入来填入每个像素所缺少的两种颜色——最简单的版本是双线性: 以相距加权的相邻已知颜色样本平均值,恰好是第9章的双线性插入,只是插入了少数,模式化的已知样本网格. 一个从scratch bilinear demosacker 到达了3.37 3.37对地真理的中绝对误差;cv2.cvt Color (., cv2.COLOR_BayerBG2BGR) 达到3.43 3.43——两者都位于相向像素值的一小部分以内,所剩的大多只是已经存在于马赛克的传感器噪音(图26.4).

blocks.en: Figure 26.4: Ground truth, manual bilinear demosaick, and cv2 demosaick — nearly indistinguishable.
blocks.zh: 图26.4:地面真理、手动双线性演示和Cv2演示——几乎无法区分。

blocks.en: The pitfall: getting the mosaic pattern wrong
blocks.zh: 陷阱:把镶嵌图案弄错了

blocks.en: The R/G/B arrangement matters, and there’s more than one convention (RGGB, BGGR, GRBG, GBRG, depending on the sensor). Demosaicking with the wrong assumed pattern doesn’t fail gracefully — it silently produces a plausible-looking but badly wrong-colored image, since every pixel gets a value, just the wrong one: the correct pattern gives MAE 3.43 3.43 , the wrong pattern jumps to MAE 64.69 64.69 — nearly a 19 × 19\times increase, from every red sample being treated as blue and vice versa, as Figure 26.5 shows.
blocks.zh: R/G/B安排很重要,而且有一个以上的公约(RGGB、BGGR、GRBG、GBRG,取决于传感器)。 以错误的假设模式解析并不优雅地失败——它静悄悄地产生一个貌相似但严重错误的图像,因为每个像素都得到一个值,只是一个错误的:正确的模式给了MAE 3.43 3.43,错误的模式跳到MAE 64.69 64.69 —几乎增加了19×19分,从每个红色样本都被当作蓝色,反之亦然,如图26.5所示。

blocks.en: Figure 26.5: Correct vs. wrong Bayer pattern assumption — a strongly color-shifted image.
blocks.zh: 图26.5:对错的拜耳图案假设——强烈的色彩相变图像.

blocks.en: 26.4 Gamma correction: pixel values are not linear light
blocks.zh: 26.4 伽玛校正:像素值不是线性光.

blocks.en: Cameras and displays don’t store brightness proportionally to physical light intensity ( linear radiance ). Instead, values are gamma-encoded : encoded = linear ** (1/gamma) (typically gamma ≈ 2.2 \approx 2.2 , close to the sRGB standard), which allocates more encoded levels to darker tones — matching human vision’s greater sensitivity to shadows than highlights. Decoding reverses it: linear = encoded ** gamma .
blocks.zh: 相机和显示器不会按照物理光度(线性光度)的比例存储亮度。 取而代之的是伽玛-编码:编码=线性** (1/gamma) (典型的伽玛-≈ 2.2相近2.2相相近,接近于 sRGB 标准),它分配出更深色的编码等分数——匹配人类视觉对阴影的敏感度比突出. 解码倒置:线性=编码为**γ.

blocks.en: The pitfall: averaging encoded pixels is not averaging light
blocks.zh: 陷阱:平均编码像素不是平均光线

blocks.en: Blending, resizing, and blurring (Chapters 8 – 10 ) all implicitly assume a linear quantity is being averaged. Pixel values usually aren’t linear — they’re gamma-encoded — so naively averaging two encoded pixel values gives the wrong physical brightness . Averaging encoded black and white directly gives 0.500 0.500 ; the physically correct 50%-linear-light gray, properly decoded/averaged/re-encoded, is 0.730 0.730 — the naive result represents only 21.8 % 21.8\% of the true linear brightness, not 50 % 50\% , visibly so in Figure 26.6 .
blocks.zh: 混合、再大小化和模糊化(第8-10章)都含蓄地假定一个线性数量正在被平均。 像素值通常不是线性——它们是伽玛编码的——如此天真地平均两个被编码的像素值会给错误的物理亮度。 活化编码黑白直接给出了0.500 0.500;物理上正确的50%-线性-光灰色,正确解码/平均/再编码,为0.730 0.730 ——天真结果仅代表真实线性亮度的21.8% 21.8.%,而非50%-50%,在图26.6中明显如此.

blocks.en: Figure 26.6: Naive blend of encoded black/white (left) vs. the physically correct blend (middle) vs. encoded 0.5 0.5 for reference (right) — the naive blend is visibly, dramatically darker.
blocks.zh: 图26.6:编码为黑/白(左)与物理正确(中)相接的纳瓦混合法,编码为0.5 0.5作为参考(右)——天真混合法明显地,明显地更暗.

blocks.en: This is a real and common bug when image-processing code (blurring, mipmap generation, alpha blending) operates directly on gamma-encoded pixel values instead of linearizing first.
blocks.zh: 当图像处理码(blurring, mipmap生成,alpha brixing)直接运行在伽玛编码像素值上而不是先线性化时,这是一个真实而常见的bug.

blocks.en: 26.5 White balance: color depends on the light source
blocks.zh: 第26.5条 白色平衡:颜色取决于光源

blocks.en: A camera records the product of a surface’s reflectance and the illuminant’s color, not the surface’s “true” color alone — a white sheet of paper looks orange under warm tungsten light and blue-ish under overcast sky, even though our visual system usually compensates for this automatically (color constancy). Cameras have to do the same correction deliberately: white balancing .
blocks.zh: 相机记录出表面反射物的产物和照明剂的颜色,而不是表面的"真"色本身——一张白相片在温暖的钨光下看上去是橙色的,在被覆盖的天空下则是蓝色的,尽管我们的视觉系统通常会自动地补偿(颜色凝固). 相机必须进行同样的修正:白色平衡。

blocks.en: The gray-world assumption
blocks.zh: 灰色世界的假设

blocks.en: A simple, classic white-balancing algorithm assumes that, averaged over an entire real-world scene, colors roughly cancel out to neutral gray. Under that assumption, any systematic difference between a photo’s per-channel averages reveals the illuminant’s color cast, so rescaling each channel to equalize the averages should approximately undo it, as Figure 26.7 demonstrates.
blocks.zh: 一个简单而经典的白平平算法假设, 平均在一个真实世界的场景上, 颜色大致被取消为中性灰色。 根据这一假设,照片的每道平均值之间的任何系统性差异都揭示出闪光剂的颜色,因此,如图26.7所显示的,将每一道的大小调整以平分平均值大约应当抵消。

blocks.en: Figure 26.7: True colors, under a warm tungsten cast, and gray-world corrected. Mean absolute pixel error drops from 18.98 18.98 to 7.43 7.43 after correction — substantial, though not to zero, since this small scene (dominated by a colored circle) isn’t perfectly neutral on average.
blocks.zh: 图26.7:真彩色,在温暖的钨铸造下,灰色世界被纠正. 平均绝对像素误差从18.98 18.98降至7.43 7.43 — — 很大,但并非为零,因为这个小场景(以有色圆为主)平均并非完全中立。

blocks.en: That residual error is exactly why real cameras often combine gray-world with other cues (an actual detected gray/white reference patch, learned scene statistics, or user-specified presets) rather than relying on the assumption alone.
blocks.zh: 这一剩余错误恰恰是真相机经常将灰色-世界与其他指针(实际被检测出灰/白色的参考补丁,所学的场景统计,或用户指定的预设)结合而不是仅仅依靠假设的原因.

blocks.en: Exercises
blocks.zh: 练习

blocks.en: 1. Change the defocus strength parameter to make the depth-of-field effect much shallower (larger strength ) or much deeper (smaller strength ). At strength=0 , what should happen, and does the code produce that? 2. Build and decode a BGGR mosaic instead of RGGB (swap which corner is red vs. blue). Find the matching OpenCV code by trying each of cv2.COLOR_BayerBG2BGR , cv2.COLOR_BayerGB2BGR , cv2.COLOR_BayerGR2BGR , cv2.COLOR_BayerRG2BGR and checking which one drops the MAE back down to the noise floor — OpenCV’s naming convention for these codes is notoriously easy to get backwards, itself a small demonstration of this chapter’s point about silent pattern-mismatch errors. 3. blocks.en: 27.1 What calibration recovers
blocks.zh: 27.1 国家 什么样的校正能恢复

blocks.en:
Camera calibration recovers two separate things: 1. Intrinsics K = [ f x s c x 0 f y c y 0 0 1 ] K=\begin{bmatrix}f_{x}&s&c_{x}\\
0&f_{y}&c_{y}\\
0&0&1\end{bmatrix} : focal lengths, principal point, and skew — the ideal pinhole part of the camera model used throughout the next two chapters. Skew can safely be assumed zero for real cameras. 2. Distortion coefficients ( k 1 , k 2 , p 1 , p 2 , k 3 , … ) (k_{1},k_{2},p_{1},p_{2},k_{3},\ldots) : real lenses aren’t perfect pinholes. blocks.en: 27.2 A synthetic calibration rig
blocks.zh: 27.2 (中文(简体) ). 合成校正装置

blocks.en: Create synthetic images of a camera viewing a checkerboard: define a ground-truth K K and distortion, define a flat checkerboard’s 3D corner positions, and generate several “photos” of it from different poses by projecting the corners with cv2.projectPoints (which applies distortion exactly as a real lens would). This gives the same kind of input cv2.calibrateCamera expects from real detected checkerboard corners, while also providing ground truth to check against. Of 40 attempted random poses, 11 11 land fully inside the frame and are usable.
blocks.zh: 创建相机查看检查板的合成图像:定义地面真实 K K 并扭曲,定义平面检查板的3D角位置,通过用cv2. projectPoints投影来从不同的姿势中生成数个"相"(它应用了完全像真实镜头那样的扭曲). 这给出了同样种类的输入cv2. 校正Camera从真实被检测到的棋盘角所期望的,同时也提供了地面真理来核对. 在40个试图随意摆放的姿势中,有11个完全在构架内并可以使用。

blocks.en: Detecting the target
blocks.zh: 检测目标

blocks.en: A real calibration pipeline knows the checkerboard’s own flat 2D layout, but not the board’s pose in each shot, and not where its corners land in each photo — so the first step is finding those 2D positions with cv2.findChessboardCorners , exactly as on a real photograph. Corners are detected in 8 8 of the 11 11 synthetic photos, with a mean per-view corner error of 1.83 1.83 px (max 2.37 2.37 px) against the ground truth — realistic detector noise, not a bug. Figure 27.1 shows the target and one view’s detections.
blocks.zh: 真正的校正管道知道棋盘本身的平面2D布局,但不能知道棋盘的姿势,也不能知道棋盘的角在每一张照片中落地的地方——所以第一步是找到带有Cv2.find Chessboard Corners的2D位置,这与真实照片上完全一样。 在11张合成相片中的8相8中检测出角,每相片中平均有1.83个1.83个px(最大2.372.37个px)与地上真相对应-现实的探测器噪声,而非一虫. 图27.1显示了目标和一景的探测情况。

blocks.en: Figure 27.1: The flat checkerboard target, and cv2.findChessboardCorners ’ detections on one synthetic photo.
blocks.zh: 图27.1:一幅合成相片上的Chessboard Corners的平板目标及Cv2.

blocks.en: 27.3 Running calibration
blocks.zh: 27.3 运行校正

blocks.en: Zhang’s calibration algorithm ( cv2.calibrateCamera ) takes the known corner positions on the checkerboard and their detected 2D image positions across all views, and jointly solves for K K , distortion, and each view’s own pose. With only 8 noisy views: the RMS reprojection error comes to 0.264 0.264 px, and K K is recovered reasonably close ( f x = 822.6 f_{x}=822.6 , f y = 826.3 f_{y}=826.3 vs. true 800,800 800,800 ) — but the distortion coefficients drift much further from the true values ( k 1 k_{1} estimated at 0.0054 0.0054 vs. true − 0.3 -0.3 ). Using noisy corner detections, calibration does not recover the ground truth parameters exactly; this is why in practice you’d use as many views, from as wide a variety of angles, as practical — more (and more diverse) constraints average out detector noise and better constrain the estimation, especially for distortion.

blocks.en: 27.5 Undoing distortion with the estimated parameters
blocks.zh: 第27.5条 取消与估计参数的扭曲

blocks.en: cv2.undistortPoints inverts the distortion model, converting distorted pixel coordinates back to normalized undistorted coordinates. Applying it to the bent grid lines, using the estimated (not the true) calibration, straightens them back out, with a max recovery error of 3.4 × 10 − 2 3.4\times 10^{-2} in normalized coordinates (Figure 27.3 ).
