blocks.en: This process of calibrating a real camera should be performed, if possible, before handing real photos to any of the geometric machinery from the next two chapters, all of which implicitly assumes an ideal, distortion-free pinhole model. Keep in mind, however, that many modern pipelines perform auto-calibration without checkerboard images, using simplified camera models (typically just one focal length parameter — ignoring aspect ratio, non-central principal point, and lens distortion).
blocks.zh: 如果可能的话,在将真实的照片交给从下两章起的任何几何机械之前,应该进行这种校正真实相机的过程,所有这一切都隐含地假设了一个理想的,无扭曲的针孔模型. 然而,要记住,许多现代管线在没有检查板图像的情况下进行自动校正,使用简化相机模型(通常只有一个焦距参数——忽略了相距比,非中央主点,和镜头扭曲).

blocks.en: Exercises
blocks.zh: 练习

blocks.en: 1. Add extra synthetic pixel noise (e.g. std 0.5 0.5 ) on top of the real detector noise, to each view’s detected corners before calibrating. How much does the RMS reprojection error grow, and how does the estimated K K drift further from the true one? 2. This setup ends with only a handful of successfully-detected views. Try reducing that down to just 3 views before calibrating. Does the estimate noticeably degrade, especially for the distortion coefficients (which need corners spread widely across the frame, including near the edges, to be well constrained)? 3. Set the true distortion to all zeros (a perfect pinhole) and rerun. Confirm the “distorted” and “ideal” grids become identical, and that calibration still recovers the true K K reasonably well even with zero distortion to estimate.

blocks.en: 28.1 The epipolar constraint
blocks.zh: 28.1 国家 极地的制约

blocks.en: For a point x 1 x_{1} in image 1 and its true match x 2 x_{2} in image 2 (both in homogeneous pixel coordinates), there’s a 3 × 3 3\times 3 rank-deficient matrix F F — the fundamental matrix — such that x 2 ⊤ ​ F ​ x 1 = 0 x_{2}^{\top}Fx_{1}=0 (28.1) for every corresponding pair, regardless of scene geometry. F F depends only on the two cameras’ relative pose and (uncalibrated) intrinsics. Rearranged, l 2 = F ​ x 1 l_{2}=Fx_{1} is the epipolar line in image 2: the 1D line along which x 1 x_{1} ’s match is guaranteed to lie. This is exactly the mechanism that made Chapter 22 ’s row-restricted search valid — rectification is just the special camera arrangement where every epipolar line happens to be horizontal, which collapses the 1D search to a single row.

blocks.en: Why a line? A geometric picture
blocks.zh: 为什么是一条线? 几何图形

blocks.en: Camera 1 knows only the direction to a point, not its depth: the true 3D point X X could be anywhere along the ray from C 1 C_{1} through x 1 x_{1} . But every point on that ray, together with C 1 C_{1} and C 2 C_{2} , lies in a single plane — the epipolar plane . Camera 2 sees this plane edge-on, as a single line: wherever X X actually sits along the ray, its projection into image 2 always falls on that one line, the epipolar line, as Figure 28.1 illustrates.

blocks.en: 28.3 SVD: singular value decomposition
blocks.zh: 28.3 SVD:单值分解

blocks.en: In Chapter 23 , we saw that a real symmetric positive-semidefinite matrix A A can be written as A = P ​ Λ ​ P ⊤ A=P\Lambda P^{\top} , with P P the eigenvectors and Λ \Lambda the (non-negative, diagonal) eigenvalues. The singular value decomposition (SVD) generalizes this: any matrix A A — symmetric or not, square or not — can be written as A = U ​ Σ ​ V ⊤ A=U\Sigma V^{\top} , with U , V U,V orthogonal (the singular vectors ) and Σ \Sigma diagonal and non-negative (the singular values , sorted largest to smallest). Two facts matter here:
blocks.zh: 在23章中,我们看到一个真实的对称正-半正方形矩阵A可以被写为A=P\'P\'A=Lambda P^{\top},其中P为正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正正 单相值分解(SVD)概括了这一点:任意矩阵A——对称与否,平方与否——可以被写为A=U Σ V ⊤ A=U\ Sigma V^{\top},有U,V U,V正向分解(单相向量)和\ Sigma 二相值和非负相值(单相值,排序最大到最小). 这里有两个事实很重要:

blocks.en: Solving A ​ x = 0 Ax=0 as closely as possible, subject to ‖ x ‖ = 1 \|x\|=1 . The answer is V V ’s last column — the right singular vector for the smallest singular value. This is Chapter 23 ’s total-least-squares trick, generalized: V V ’s columns are the eigenvectors of A ⊤ ​ A A^{\top}A , sorted by eigenvalue.

blocks.en: Enforcing a rank constraint. Zeroing the smallest singular value(s) and reconstructing gives the closest lower-rank matrix (in a least-squares sense) to the original — exactly what’s needed to force the estimated F F , which must be exactly rank 2, back onto that constraint after an unconstrained solve drifts off it slightly.

blocks.en: 28.4 The 8-point algorithm
blocks.zh: 28.4 (中文(简体) ). 8分算法

blocks.en: Each correspondence gives one linear equation in the 9 unknown entries of F F (expanding x 2 ⊤ ​ F ​ x 1 = 0 x_{2}^{\top}Fx_{1}=0 ). F F is only defined up to scale (like the homography in Chapter 24 ), so it really has just 8 independent unknowns, solvable as a homogeneous least-squares problem via SVD — the same DLT machinery used for the homography fit. Since F F must be exactly rank 2, project the 9-parameter solution back onto the nearest rank-2 matrix using the SVD trick above.

F F actually has only 7 true degrees of freedom, since the rank-2 constraint removes one more; a 7-point algorithm exists but is nonlinear, which is why the linear 8-point algorithm (with its separate rank-2 cleanup step) remains popular. Raw pixel coordinates (in the hundreds) also make the linear system badly conditioned, so points are first rescaled to be centered at the origin with average distance 2 \sqrt{2} , solved in normalized coordinates, then the rescaling is undone on the resulting F F — the normalized 8-point algorithm ( Hartley, 1997 ), the version used here and worth reaching for in practice.
blocks.zh: 法语 F实际上只有7个真正的自由度,因为等级-2限制又移除了1个;一个7分算法存在但非线性,这就是线性8分算法(及其单独的等级-2清理步骤)仍然流行的原因. 原始像素坐标(以上百为单位)也使线性系统条件恶劣,因此各点首先被调整以平均相距为2\sqrt{2}的来由为中心,在正态坐标中被解开,然后在由此而来的F F——正态的8分算法(Hartley, 1997)上取消回缩,此版本在此被使用并值得在实践中达到.

blocks.en: cv2.recoverPose decomposes E E into a rotation and a translation direction — not a full translation vector, since the magnitude is fundamentally unrecoverable from two views alone (a scene twice as large, viewed by cameras with twice the baseline, produces identical images — the same scale ambiguity familiar from monocular vision). blocks.en: 29.1 The classic pipeline, at a glance
blocks.zh: 第29.1条 经典的管道,一看

blocks.en: 1. Match features between two images (Chapter 20 : SIFT + + ratio test). 2. Estimate the essential matrix E E from those correspondences, robustly (Chapter 23 : RANSAC), using known intrinsics K K (Chapter 27 : calibration). 3. Recover relative pose ( R , t ) (R,t) from E E (Chapter 28 : cv2.recoverPose ) — up to an unknown scale on t t . 4. Triangulate : for every matched pair, intersect the two corresponding rays in 3D to recover a 3D point. Two realistic synthetic photos of a bronze sculpture from the BlendedMVS dataset ( Yao et al., 2020 ) are used — unlike a photo pair shot casually, these images come with ground-truth camera poses, calibration, and geometry for checking the entire pipeline. Figure 29.1 shows the pair.

blocks.en: Cheirality: a free sanity check
blocks.zh: 贞操:免费的疗养检查

blocks.en: Decomposing E E into ( R , t ) (R,t) actually yields four mathematically valid sign combinations; only one places the observed points in front of both cameras, and cv2.recoverPose uses exactly this cheirality constraint to pick the right one internally. The epipolar constraint alone doesn’t rule out a correspondence that triangulates behind a camera, so a mismatched point can still pass RANSAC’s inlier test; requiring positive depth in both views is a free extra filter — it drops the reconstruction from 48 48 to 47 47 inliers here. Triangulating those 47 points with the true camera poses gives a mean reprojection error of just 0.169 0.169 px (max 1.680 1.680 px).
blocks.zh: 将 E 分解为 (R, t) (R, t) 实际生成四个数学上有效的符号组合;只有一个将观测到的点放在两个相机前, cv2. recover Pose正用这种俗气的束缚 来选择正确的内部。 单是极地限制并不排除一个三相相机后面的通信,因此一个不匹配的点仍然可以通过RANSAC的更强测试;在两种观点中要求正深度是免费的额外过滤器——它将重建从48个48个减到47个47个。 用真相相机所构成的三角这47个点,给出了只有0.169 0169 px(最大为1.680 1.680 px)的平均值再预测错误.

blocks.en: 29.3 Putting it together: reconstruction using estimated pose
blocks.zh: 29.3 联合国 组合起来:利用估计的姿势重建

blocks.en: The real test: triangulate using the camera matrix built from recoverPose ’s estimated ( R , t ) (R,t) , not the dataset’s true pose. Because t t was only recovered up to scale, so is the reconstruction — every 3D point comes out a fixed factor smaller than reality. Multiplying by the true baseline length ( 0.788 0.788 , a bit of cheating, just for evaluation) recovers the correct metric scene: mean 3D reconstruction error (vs. triangulation from the true poses) is just 0.058 0.058 , max 0.096 0.096 — a small fraction of the baseline.
blocks.zh: 真正的测试:使用从Pose回收(R,t)的估计(R,t)中构建的相机矩阵进行三角测量,而不是数据集的真实姿势. 因为t t只是被恢复到规模上,重建也是如此——每个3D点都会产生一个比现实小的固定因素. 乘以真实基线长度(0.788 0.788,略作作作弊,仅作评价)恢复了正确的公制场景:指3D重建出错(从真实的外形进行三角化)仅为0.058 0.058,最大为0.096 0.096——是基线的一小部分.

blocks.en: With real (imperfect) correspondences, the entire pipeline — essential matrix, pose, triangulation — reconstructs the scene to within a small fraction of the camera baseline, using nothing but 2D pixel correspondences and known intrinsics, plus one external number (the true baseline) to fix the scale ambiguity. In practice, that scale reference might come from a known object size in the scene, a second sensor (GPS, IMU, LiDAR), or a calibrated stereo rig (Chapter 22 ) instead of two arbitrary independent cameras.
blocks.zh: 随着真实的(不完善的)通信,整个管道——基本矩阵,姿势,三角化——将场景重建到相机基线的一小部分范围内,只使用2D像素的通信和已知的内在内容,外加一个外部数字(真正的基线)来固定尺度模糊. 在实践中,这种尺度参照可能来自已知的场景物体大小,第二个传感器(GPS,IMU,LiDAR),或被校准的立体架(第22章),而不是两个任意的独立相机.

blocks.en: Visualizing the reconstruction
blocks.zh: 设想重建

blocks.en: Loosening the feature-matching thresholds pulls in more (slightly noisier) correspondences for a denser cloud: 112 112 points, colored by their pixel color from view 1, shown in Figure 29.3 .
blocks.zh: 松动地物比对阈值为更稠密的云层拉出更多(略为噪声)的相函:112 112分,以图29.3所示出第1景的相像素颜色为色.

blocks.en: Figure 29.3: The recovered 3D points (colored, estimated pose) alongside points triangulated with the true poses (gray), plus both camera centers.
blocks.zh: 图29.3:回收的三维点(彩色,估计姿势)与三角点相接,外加两个相机中心。

blocks.en: From sparse to dense, and from two views to many
blocks.zh: 从稀疏到稠密 从两个观点到很多

blocks.en: Even with loosened thresholds, feature matching only yields a sparse cloud — one 3D point per distinctive keypoint. With camera poses known, multi-view stereo (MVS) estimates a depth for every pixel in every view (a generalization of Chapter 22 ’s stereo matching to arbitrarily-posed calibrated cameras), and those per-view depth maps are fused into the dense colored point cloud or mesh that toolkits like COLMAP ( Schönberger & Frahm, 2016 ) produce.
blocks.zh: 即使有了被松动的阈值,特征相匹配也只能产生一团稀疏的云——每个有特色的键点一个3D点. 多视图立体声(MVS)在已知相机的姿势下,估计每个相片在每个相片中的深度(将第22章的立体声与任意放置的校准相机相匹配的通称),而那些相片的深度图被接入了像COLMAP(Schönberger & Frahm,2016年)这样的工具包所生成的密集的有色点云或网点云.

blocks.en: Real reconstructions rarely stop at two views. The standard recipe sequentially incorporates new images: match features against existing images, compute the new camera’s pose relative to the existing 3D point cloud (Perspective-n-Point, cv2.solvePnP ), then update the cloud by triangulation. As views accumulate, errors compound — pose corrupts triangulated points, which corrupt the next recovered pose, and so on. Bundle adjustment fixes this by refining all camera poses and 3D points together in one large nonlinear least-squares optimization that minimizes total reprojection error across every point in every view at once — arguably the single most important step separating a simple two-view pipeline like this chapter’s from a real SfM system.
blocks.zh: 真正的重建很少停留在两种观点上. 标准食谱相继地收录了新的图像:与已存在的图像相匹配特征,计算出新相机相对于已存在的3D点云(Perspective-n-Point,cv2.solvePnP)的外观,再通过三角相接来更新云. 随着观点的积累,出错复合——构成腐败的三角点,腐化了后被恢复的姿势等. Bundle 调整通过精炼所有相机和3D点一起在一幅大非线性最小平方优化中来修正这一点,该优化可以同时将每个视点的总再投射误差减少到最小程度——可以说是将像本章这样的简单的双视管与真正的SfM系统分开的最重要的一步.

blocks.en: 30.1 Two projections you’ve already built
blocks.zh: 30.1 国家 你已经做了两个预测

blocks.en: PCA (Chapter 6 ). Given a cloud of points, the eigenvectors of their covariance matrix gave directions to project onto. Projecting onto the top eigenvector, y = v ⊤ ​ x y=v^{\top}x , collapses each 2D point to a single number — the coordinate along the direction of greatest spread, as Figure 30.1 shows.
blocks.zh: 常设仲裁法院(第6章.) 由于积分多云,它们的共变矩阵的精度者给出了投影方向. 如图30.1所示,投影到顶部的eigenvector,y = v = ⊤ x y = v^{\top}x,倒塌的每个2D会指向一个单一的数字——坐标沿着最大分布的方向.

blocks.en: Figure 30.1: A 2D cloud with its principal direction, and the same points projected onto that direction (1D).
blocks.zh: 图30.1:带有主要方向的二维云,以及该方向预测的相同点(1D)。

blocks.en: Camera projection (Chapters 24 – 25 ). P = K ⁡ [ R | t ] P=K[R|t] maps a 3D world point to a 2D pixel. Every row of that matrix, before the final homogeneous divide, is itself a linear projection: a dot product between the point’s coordinates and a fixed direction, plus an offset.
blocks.zh: 相机投影 (第24章 – 25章). P = K ⁡ [R | t] P = K [R|t] 将一个3D世界指向一个2D像素. 该矩阵的每一行,在最后的同位分数之前,本身都是线性预测:点坐标和固定方向之间的点出产物,外加相抵.

blocks.en: Both examples share the same mechanics: pick a direction w w (and maybe an offset b b ), then compute y = w ⊤ ​ x + b y=w^{\top}x+b . What differs is why the direction was chosen: PCA picks w w to maximize the spread of the projected data (an unsupervised, purely geometric objective); a camera’s rows are fixed by its physical geometry. Neither is chosen to solve a classification or recognition problem — but nothing stops us from choosing w w for exactly that purpose.
blocks.zh: 这两个例子都具有相同的力学:选择一个方向w w (和也许一个相向的b b),然后计算y = w → x + b → w → top}x + b. 不同之处在于为什么选择了方向: PCA选择 w w 来使预测数据(一个不受监督的纯粹几何目标)的传播最大化;相机的行由物理几何固定. 也没有选择解决一个分类或识别问题——但没有任何东西阻止我们为此目的选择ww。

blocks.en: 30.2 Matrix multiplication: many projections at once
blocks.zh: 30.2 矩阵乘法:多次同时预测

blocks.en: Everything above computed one number y = w ⊤ ​ x y=w^{\top}x from one direction w w . Stack m m different directions as the rows of a matrix W W (shape m × n m\times n ), and y = W ​ x y=Wx computes all m m projections at once — one dot product per row. This is exactly what matrix multiplication is : a bank of simultaneous projections. Several seemingly different linear operations from earlier in this course are secretly the same operation, just with a different, structured choice of W W : • Convolution (Chapter 10 ): each output value is a dot product between a small neighborhood and a kernel — a projection. Sliding the kernel across the whole signal is a matrix multiply by a sparse matrix whose rows are shifted copies of the kernel (a Toeplitz matrix). • The Fourier transform (Chapter 15 ): each output value is a dot product between the whole signal and one sinusoid at a fixed frequency — a projection onto that frequency. The full transform is a matrix multiply by a fixed matrix of sines and cosines. • A homography or camera projection matrix (Chapters 24 – 25 ): each output coordinate is a dot product between a homogeneous point and one row of H H or P P . Verified directly: a hand-built Toeplitz matrix reproduces np.convolve to within 5.6 × 10 − 17 5.6\times 10^{-17} , and a hand-built matrix of sinusoids reproduces np.fft.fft to within 2.9 × 10 − 15 2.9\times 10^{-15} — both effectively exact, floating-point roundoff only.
blocks.zh: 上面所有东西都从一个方向计算出一个数字y=w \ xy=w \\\ x\\\ x从一个方向计算出 w w 。 堆积 m m 不同方向作为矩阵 W W (形状为 m × n m\times n)的行,而 y = W x y = W 一次计算所有 m m 的预测——每行一个点出产. 这就是矩阵乘法:一个同时预测的库。 与本课程前作相比,有些看似不同的线性操作是暗地里相同的操作,只是用不同的,结构化的W W 选择: —— Convolution(第十章):每个输出值是一个小邻居和一个内核之间的点出产物——一个预测. 将内核横穿整个信号,是一个由一个稀疏的矩阵相乘而成的矩阵,其行被内核的相移复制(一个托埃普利茨矩阵). 二. 支助 傅里叶变换(第15章):每个输出值都是整个信号和固定频率下的一个辛苏克之间的点出产物——一个投影到该频率上. 由正弦和相弦组成的固定矩阵相乘的矩阵。 相机或相机投影矩阵(第24章-第25章):每个输出坐标是一个同位点和一行H或P-之间的点出产物. 直接验证:一个手工制造的Toeplitz矩阵复制了np.convive到5.6×10−17 5.6\times 10^{-17},一个手工制造的sinusoids矩阵复制了np.fft.fft到2.9×10−15 2.9\times 10^{-15}——两者都有效准确,只以浮点为圆.

blocks.en: Convolution (Chapter 10 ): each output value is a dot product between a small neighborhood and a kernel — a projection. Sliding the kernel across the whole signal is a matrix multiply by a sparse matrix whose rows are shifted copies of the kernel (a Toeplitz matrix).
blocks.zh: Cirvolution(第十章):每个输出值是一个小相邻和内核之间的点出产物——一个投影. 将内核横穿整个信号,是一个由一行被内核(一个托埃普利茨矩阵)的相移复制的稀有矩阵所乘以的矩阵.

blocks.en: The Fourier transform (Chapter 15 ): each output value is a dot product between the whole signal and one sinusoid at a fixed frequency — a projection onto that frequency. The full transform is a matrix multiply by a fixed matrix of sines and cosines.
blocks.zh: 傅里叶变换(第15章):每个输出值都是整个信号和固定频率下的一个辛活体之间的点出产物——一个投影到该频率上. 整变为正弦和相弦的固定矩阵相乘的矩阵.

blocks.en: A homography or camera projection matrix (Chapters 24 – 25 ): each output coordinate is a dot product between a homogeneous point and one row of H H or P P .
blocks.zh: 相机或相机投影矩阵(第24章-第25章):每个输出坐标是一个同位点和一行H或P-之间的点出产物.

blocks.en: A fully-connected neural network layer is nothing more than this same y = W ​ x + b y=Wx+b , with W W ’s rows learned to solve a task instead of fixed by hand-derived structure (a kernel shape, a bank of sinusoids, a camera’s geometry).
blocks.zh: 一个完全连接的神经网络层就是这个y = W x + b y = Wx + b → Wx + b, W W 的行学会了解决一个任务而不是由手生结构固定(一个内核形状,一个sinusoids的库,一个相机的几何).

blocks.en: 30.3 A projection for classification
blocks.zh: 30.3 (中文(简体) ). 分类预测

blocks.en: Suppose instead of “maximize spread,” the goal is “separate two classes.” The same formula y = w ⊤ ​ x + b y=w^{\top}x+b still applies — project each point onto a direction w w , and classify by the sign of the resulting score. This is, in its entirety, a single artificial neuron with no activation function: the linear core that every neural network layer is built from.
blocks.zh: 目标不是“最大化传播”,而是“分离两类”。 相同的公式y = w = x + b = w = x + y = x + b = x + b 仍然适用——项目每个点到一个方向w w ,并按产生的分数来分类. 这整个是一个没有活化功能的单一人工神经元:每个神经网络层所构建的线性核心.

blocks.en: A principled hand-picked direction — pointing from one class’s mean toward the other’s, with the threshold at the midpoint — reaches 100.0 % 100.0\% classification accuracy on two well-separated synthetic classes (Figure 30.2 ).
blocks.zh: 一个原则性的手取方向 — — 从一个等级的平均值指向另一个等级,中间点的门槛 — — 在两个分隔良好的合成类上达到100.0%的100.0%的分类精度(图30.2)。

blocks.en: Figure 30.2: Left: the decision boundary in the original 2D space, perpendicular to w w . Right: the same points projected down onto w w , with classification reduced to thresholding a single number at zero. The 2D picture is more intuitive, but the 1D picture is what actually generalizes — in 100 dimensions there’s no picture to draw of the “boundary,” but “project to a single number, then threshold” still works exactly the same way.
blocks.zh: 图30.2:左:原2D空间中的决定边界,垂直为ww. 右: 投射到 ww 的相同分数, 分类被降低到一个零的阈值 。 2D图片更直观,但1D图片实际上是概括的——在100个维度中,没有图画出"边界",而"项目到一个数字,然后门槛"仍然完全一样.

blocks.en: 30.4 What a single projection cannot do
blocks.zh: 30.4 联合国 单一的投影不能做什么

blocks.en: A single linear projection can only produce a straight-line decision boundary (a hyperplane, in higher dimensions). Some datasets have no straight-line separator at all — the classic example is one class surrounding the other. Searching 2000 random directions and 61 thresholds each for the best possible linear separator between a ring and a surrounded disk finds a best achievable accuracy of just 74.2 % 74.2\% , as Figure 30.3 shows.
blocks.zh: 单线投影只能产生直线决定边界(超平面,高维度). 一些数据集根本没有直线分隔符——经典例子是一个围绕另一个的类. 如图30.3所示,在搜索2000个随机方向和61个阈值时,在环与被包围的圆盘之间找到尽可能最好的线性分隔符时,发现最佳的可实现精度仅为74.2% 74.2%。

blocks.en: Figure 30.3: The best possible linear boundary between a disk and a surrounding ring — no rotation or shift of a single straight line can separate them, so the best any linear projection can manage is a mediocre compromise.
blocks.zh: 图30.3:磁盘与周围环相接的最佳线性边界——单条直线的任何旋转或转移都不能将它们分离出来,因此任何线性投影都能管理的最佳是平庸的折中.

blocks.en: This is the wall every purely linear method runs into, and it’s exactly what motivates the next two chapters: first, learning w w and b b automatically instead of hand-picking them, and then, more importantly, composing several projections with nonlinearities in between , which, given enough capacity, can separate regions of essentially any shape.
blocks.zh: 这是每个纯粹线性方法所走入的墙壁,正是它促使下两章的动因:第一,学习w w 和b b 而不是人工挑取它们,而更重要的是,用非线性在两者之间组合几个预测,只要有足够的能力,这些预测可以将基本上任何形状的区域分开。

blocks.en: 31.1 A new library: PyTorch and tensors
blocks.zh: 31.1 联合国 一个新库: PyTorch 和 百分数

blocks.en: From here on, most chapters lean on PyTorch rather than OpenCV, because training neural networks needs two things OpenCV was never designed for: automatic differentiation (computing gradients of arbitrarily complex functions) and GPU acceleration for large matrix multiplications. A tensor is simply the general term for a grid of numbers of any dimensionality — every array used so far in this course has really been a tensor all along; PyTorch’s torch.Tensor is NumPy’s ndarray with two extras: it can track a .grad for automatic differentiation, and it can live on a GPU.
blocks.zh: 从这里开始,大多数章节都倚靠了PyTorch而不是OpenCV,因为训练神经网络需要两个OpenCV从未设计过的东西:自动分化(计算任意复杂函数的梯度)和GPU加速来进行大矩阵相乘. 一个变压器只是任何维度数字网格的通称——到目前为止这个课程中所用的每个阵列实际上都是变压器;PyTorch的火炬。 Tensor是NumPy的ndaray,带有两个外加:它可以跟踪一个.grad以自动分化,它可以活在一个GPU上.

blocks.en: Two PyTorch conventions worth flagging up front: it stores color images channel-first , as (channel, height, width) rather than NumPy/OpenCV’s (height, width, channel) from Chapter 1 ; and its layers almost always expect a batch dimension first, even for a single example.
blocks.zh: 两种PyTorch常规值得标出正面:它将彩色图像通道-第一,作为(通道、高度、宽度)而不是第1章的NumPy/OpenCV(高度、宽度、通道)存储;它的分层几乎总是期望先有批量的维度,即使是单一的例子。

blocks.en: 31.3 From a raw score to a probability
blocks.zh: 31.3 联合国 从原始得分到概率

blocks.en: Recall the projection from Chapter 30 : a single neuron computes a raw score z = w ⊤ ​ x + b z=w^{\top}x+b , then classifies by that score’s sign. The goal of training is to find a w w and b b that make z z come out positive for class B and negative for class A — but instead of hand-picking them, gradient descent should find them automatically.
blocks.zh: 回顾第30章的投影:单神经元计算出生分数z=w××××××××××××××××××××分数后再以该分数的分数来分出. 训练的目标是找到一个w w和b b,使z出来对B级有利,对A级不利——但是,与其亲手挑取它们,梯度下降应该自动发现它们.

blocks.en: The trouble is that classification accuracy (right or wrong) is flat almost everywhere and jumps discontinuously at the decision boundary — it has no useful gradient to follow. The fix: squash the raw score through the sigmoid function, which maps any real number to a smooth value between 0 and 1, read as “how confident is the model that this point is class B?” σ ⁡ ( z ) = 1 1 + e − z . \sigma(z)=\frac{1}{1+e^{-z}}. (31.1) A large positive z z maps close to 1, a large negative z z close to 0, and z = 0 z=0 maps to exactly 0.5, right on the fence (Figure 31.2 ).
blocks.zh: 问题在于分类精度(对或错)几乎处处都平平并不停地跳到决定边界上——它没有有用的梯度来遵循. 固定值:通过 sigmoid 函数将原始分数压平,该函数将任何真实数字映射到0到1之间的平滑值上,读作“这个分数是B级的模型有多么自信?” ======================================================================================================================== =============================================================================================== (============================== (===== (= (31.1)一幅相近于1的大型正子图,一幅相近于0的大型正子图,一幅相近于0的相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

blocks.en: 31.4 Binary cross-entropy: turning probability into a trainable loss
blocks.zh: 31.4 国家 二进制横切:将概率变为可受训练的损失

blocks.en: A probability alone isn’t yet something to optimize. Training needs a single number — loss — that’s small when the model’s probabilities are good and large when they’re bad. Binary cross-entropy penalizes each prediction according to how confident it was, and whether that confidence was justified: if the true label is 1, the penalty is − log ⁡ ( p ) -\log(p) (near zero when p p is close to 1, exploding as p → 0 p\to 0 ); if the true label is 0, the mirror image, − log ⁡ ( 1 − p ) -\log(1-p) (Figure 31.3 ).
blocks.zh: 光是概率还不是最佳的。 训练需要单个数字——损失——当模型的概率好,当模型坏时大,这个数字就很小了. 二进制横冲直撞会根据每一次预测的自信程度,以及这种信心是否合理而进行惩罚:如果真实的标签是1,那么惩罚是-对数-(p)-\log(p)(当p接近1,爆炸时接近0);如果真实的标签是0,镜像是-对数-(p)-\log(1-p)-\log(p) (图31.3).

blocks.en: Figure 31.3: Binary cross-entropy: the penalty for one prediction, as a function of the predicted probability.
blocks.zh: 图31.3 二进制横切:一个预测的罚分,作为预测概率的函数.

blocks.en: Averaging that per-example penalty over the whole dataset gives the full loss: L = − 1 n ∑ i [ y i log σ ( z i ) + ( 1 − y i ) log ( 1 − σ ( z i ) ) ] . L=-\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i}\big[y_{i}\log\sigma(z_{i})+(1-y_{i})\log(1-\sigma(z_{i}))\big]. (31.2) This is exactly the two curves above, selected by y i y_{i} (only one term is ever nonzero, since y i y_{i} is 0 or 1) and averaged over every point. Because both the sigmoid and the logarithm are smooth, L L has a well-defined gradient everywhere — the loss decreases smoothly as predictions get closer to being correct, instead of only changing at the decision boundary.

blocks.en: 31.5 Backpropagation: the chain rule, applied
blocks.zh: 31.5 反扩散: 链式规则,适用

blocks.en: “Backprop” is just the chain rule from Chapters 12 – 13 , applied to a composed function: L L depends on σ ⁡ ( z ) \sigma(z) , which depends on z = w ⊤ ​ x + b z=w^{\top}x+b , which depends on w w and b b . Working backward through that chain (skipping the algebra) gives a remarkably clean result: ∂ L ∂ z i = σ ⁡ ( z i ) − y i , ∂ L ∂ w = 1 n ​ X ⊤ ​ ( σ ⁡ ( z ) − y ) , ∂ L ∂ b = 1 n ​ ∑ i ( σ ⁡ ( z i ) − y i ) . \frac{\partial L}{\partial z_{i}}=\sigma(z_{i})-y_{i},\qquad\frac{\partial L}{\partial w}=\frac{1}{n}X^{\top}(\sigma(z)-y),\qquad\frac{\partial L}{\partial b}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i}(\sigma(z_{i})-y_{i}). (31.3) In words: the gradient is just the prediction error , averaged (weighted by x x for w w ’s gradient). Wildly wrong predictions push the weights hard; correct ones barely move them at all.

blocks.en: Sanity checks: numerical gradient and PyTorch autograd
blocks.zh: 安全性检查: 数值梯度和 PyTorch 自动校正

blocks.en: Before trusting any hand-derived gradient, it’s standard practice to check it two independent ways. First, numerically: perturb each parameter by a tiny amount and see how much the loss actually changes, compared to the analytical formula — the finite-difference and analytic gradients agree to a max discrepancy of 1.01 × 10 − 9 1.01\times 10^{-9} . Second, via PyTorch’s automatic differentiation ( .backward() , using its built-in binary_cross_entropy_with_logits ) — agreeing with the hand-derived gradient to 5.55 × 10 − 17 5.55\times 10^{-17} . This kind of double-checking is standard practice whenever a gradient is derived by hand.
blocks.zh: 在相信任何人工生成梯度之前, 首先,从数字上看:用微小的量来扰动每个参数,看看与分析公式相比,损失的实际变化有多大——有限偏差和分析梯度同意最大相差1.01×10-9 1.01\times 10×9}。 第二,通过 PyTorch 的自动分化(. backward (),使用它的内置二进制_cross_entropy_ with_logits)——同意由手取梯度为5.55×10-17 5.55\tims 10^{-17}. 这种重复检查是手取出梯度时的标准做法.

blocks.en: Compare to Chapter 30 ’s hand-picked direction
blocks.zh: 与第30章的手取方向相比

blocks.en: Normalizing both directions to unit length: the hand-picked direction is [ 0.838 , 0.546 ] [0.838,0.546] , the learned direction is [ 0.816 , 0.577 ] [0.816,0.577] — an angle of just 2.2 ∘ 2.2^{\circ} apart. Gradient descent, starting from nothing but random noise, rediscovers essentially the same direction a human picked by reasoning about class means — reassuring, but also a preview of the limits of a single neuron: it can only ever rediscover what a single linear projection is capable of.
blocks.zh: 将双向均匀化为单位长度:手取方向为[0.838,0.546] [0.838,0.546],所学方向为[0.816,0.577] [0.816,0.577]——相距只有2.2 ∘ 2.2 ^{\ Circ}. 渐入地(Gradient slow),从无到有随机的噪声开始,重新发现人类通过推理所选择的关于阶级含义的大致相同方向——令人放心,但也预览了单个神经元的极限:它只能重新发现单个线性投影所能达到的.

blocks.en: 31.7 Training on the unsolvable problem
blocks.zh: 31.7 关于无法解决的问题的培训

blocks.en: Chapter 30 showed that no linear projection separates a ring from the disk it surrounds — the best exhaustive search over directions and thresholds found was 74 % 74\% accuracy. What happens when gradient descent, rather than brute-force search, tries to solve the same problem? Trained for 2000 epochs: the learned weight vector shrinks to near-zero ( ‖ w ‖ = 0.0824 \|w\|=0.0824 ), and accuracy lands at 50.0 % 50.0\% — chance level, worse than the brute-force search’s 74 % 74\% .
blocks.zh: 第30章显示,没有线性投影将一个环从它所包围的圆盘中分离出来——在方向和阈值上进行最详尽的搜索是74%的74分精度. 当梯度下降,而不是野蛮力量搜索,试图解决同样的问题时,会发生什么? 训练了2000年的时代:学习到的重量向量缩小到近零( -w = 0.0824-w-0.0824),精确度为50.0%-50.0%-机会水平,比野蛮力量搜索的74.74-%更差。

blocks.en: Gradient descent actually does worse here than brute-force search — it converges to a near-zero weight vector instead of finding the small, lopsided arc that let a brute-force search eke out 74 % 74\% . The dataset is (approximately) symmetric around the origin, so the average gradient pull from all the training points nearly cancels out in every direction, and the optimizer settles near w ≈ 0 w\approx 0 rather than hunting for an asymmetric corner-case solution. Different failure mode, same underlying truth: a single linear projection cannot solve this problem, no matter how it’s found. Chapter 32 fixes this — not by using a smarter optimizer, but by giving the model more than one projection to work with.
blocks.zh: 渐渐的下降其实比野蛮力量搜索更糟糕 —— 它与近乎零的重量矢量相会合, 而不是找到一个小的,斜向的弧 让野蛮力量搜索达到74%的74。 数据集在起源地周围是(约)对称的,因此所有训练点的平均梯度拉出在每个方向都几乎取消,而最优化者定居在\\\\\ 0左右,而不是去寻找不对称的角格解. 不同的失败模式, 相同的内在真理: 单一的线性投影无法解决这个问题, 第32章纠正了这一点——不是使用更聪明的优化器,而是给模型一个以上的投影来配合.

blocks.en: 32.1 Two projections, one nonlinearity
blocks.zh: 第32.1条 两项预测,一项非线性

blocks.en: A multi-layer perceptron (MLP) chains a hidden projection into a new space, a nonlinear activation applied elementwise, and then a final linear projection (exactly Chapter 31 ’s neuron) on top of the transformed coordinates: h = ReLU ​ ( W 1 ​ x + b 1 ) , z = w 2 ⊤ ​ h + b 2 , p = σ ⁡ ( z ) . h=\text{ReLU}(W_{1}x+b_{1}),\qquad z=w_{2}^{\top}h+b_{2},\qquad p=\sigma(z). (32.1) ReLU ​ ( u ) = max ⁡ ( 0 , u ) \text{ReLU}(u)=\max(0,u) is the simplest common activation: linear everywhere except a single kink at zero. That one kink, applied independently to every unit of h h , is enough — the hidden layer can bend, fold, and stretch the input space so a linear boundary in the transformed space corresponds to a highly nonlinear boundary back in the original coordinates.
blocks.zh: 多层受体(MLP)会将隐藏投影带链入新空间,非线性活化应用元素,再在变形坐标上方进行最终线性投影(确切地说是第31章的神经元):h = ReLU (W 1 x + b 1),z = w 2 → h + b 2,p = σ (z). h=\text{ reLU}(W_{ 1}x +b_{ 1}),\qquad z = w_{2}^{\top → h+b_{2},\qquad p=\sigma (z). (32.1)ReLU (u) = max → (0, u)\text{ reLU} (u) → max (0,u) 是最简单的常见活化:除一个单克克在0外,无所不在. 这个独立应用到h的每个单位h的克已足够了——隐藏的地层可以弯曲,折叠,并拉伸输入空间,所以被改变的空间中的线性边界与原坐标中高度非线性边界相对应.

blocks.en: Why the nonlinearity is essential
blocks.zh: 为何非线性至关重要

blocks.en: Without ReLU — if the hidden layer were left as plain h = W 1 ​ x + b 1 h=W_{1}x+b_{1} — the two layers would collapse into a single linear projection: z = w 2 ⊤ ​ ( W 1 ​ x + b 1 ) + b 2 = ( w 2 ⊤ ​ W 1 ) ⏟ w ′ ⁣ ⊤ ​ x + ( w 2 ⊤ ​ b 1 + b 2 ) ⏟ b ′ . z=w_{2}^{\top}(W_{1}x+b_{1})+b_{2}=\underbrace{(w_{2}^{\top}W_{1})}_{w^{\prime\top}}x+\underbrace{(w_{2}^{\top}b_{1}+b_{2})}_{b^{\prime}}. (32.2) That’s exactly Chapter 31 ’s single neuron again, just with the two layers’ weights multiplied together into one w ′ w^{\prime} and b ′ b^{\prime} . This is the flip side of Chapter 30 ’s observation that matrix multiplication is projection, stacked: composing two matrix multiplications is still just one matrix multiplication, so stacking purely linear layers buys nothing, no matter how many are chained. ReLU’s kink is what breaks that collapse — because it isn’t a linear function, w 2 ⊤ ​ ReLU ​ ( W 1 ​ x + b 1 ) + b 2 w_{2}^{\top}\text{ReLU}(W_{1}x+b_{1})+b_{2} can no longer be rewritten as any single w ′ ⁣ ⊤ ​ x + b ′ w^{\prime\top}x+b^{\prime} . Verified directly: passing the same random data through two linear layers matches the single combined layer W 1 ​ W 2 W_{1}W_{2} , b 1 ​ W 2 + b 2 b_{1}W_{2}+b_{2} to within 1.78 × 10 − 15 1.78\times 10^{-15} .
blocks.zh: 没有ReLU——如果隐藏的地层被留作平原h=W 1 x + b 1 h=W_{1}x + b_{1}——两地层会倒塌成单一的线性投影:z=W 2 → (W 1 x + b 1) + b → (W 2 → W 1) → + (W 2 → B 1 + b 2) → b'. Z=w_{2}^{\top}(W_{1}x+b_{1})+b_{2}=\nderbrace{(W_{2}^{\top}W_{1})}_{w^{\prime\top}}x+\nderbrace{(W_{2}^{\top}b_{1}+b_{2})}_{b^{\p^{\prime}}. (32.2) 恰好是第31章的单神经元, 这是第30章关于矩阵乘法是投影的反面观察,堆叠: 组合出两个矩阵乘法仍然是一个矩阵乘法,所以堆叠纯线性地层买不到任何东西,不管有多少个是被连锁的. ReLU的坏事就是打破崩溃的状态——因为它不是一个线性函数,w 2 → RELU (W 1 x + b 1) + b 2 → → 2-top → text{ RELU} (W_{1}x + b_{1}) + b_{2} 不能再被改写为任何单一的w′ + + + + b′prime\ x + b^{\prime} 了. 直接验证:通过两个线性地层将相同的随机数据传递给在1.78×10−15 1.78\times 10×15)以内的单一合并地层W 1W 2_{1},b 1W 2 + b 2 b_{1}W_{2}+b_{2}.

blocks.en: 32.2 Backprop through two layers
blocks.zh: 32.2 通过两层背推

blocks.en: The chain rule extends cleanly: propagate the error signal ∂ L / ∂ z \partial L/\partial z from Chapter 31 backward through the output projection to get ∂ L / ∂ h \partial L/\partial h , then backward through the ReLU and the hidden projection to get ∂ L / ∂ W 1 , ∂ L / ∂ b 1 \partial L/\partial W_{1},\partial L/\partial b_{1} . Every step is either “multiply by a weight matrix’s transpose” or “multiply elementwise by an activation’s derivative” — this is all backpropagation ever is, no matter how many layers are stacked. A from-scratch implementation of forward and backward passes through a 2-layer MLP matches PyTorch’s autograd gradients to within 3 × 10 − 17 3\times 10^{-17} on every parameter.

blocks.en: On its own, each cut is just a straight line — no single one of them separates the ring from the disk. But the output layer combines all H H of their (ReLU’d) results together, and a handful of straight cuts arranged around the ring, combined with the right weights, can approximate a closed curve well enough to enclose it.
blocks.zh: 单靠自己,每个切口只是一条直线——没有一个单线将环从磁盘上分出. 但输出层结合了它们(RELU'd)的所有H结果,环周围安排了几道直切,加上正确的分量,可以很好地将一个封闭的曲线相接而成。

blocks.en: What the hidden layer actually did
blocks.zh: 隐藏的地层到底做了什么

blocks.en: The output layer is just a linear projection (Chapter 31 ’s neuron) — but it acts on h h , the hidden layer’s output, not on the original x x . If the hidden layer did its job, the transformed points should already be much easier to separate with a straight line. Since h h lives in ℝ 4 \mathbb{R}^{4} here, PCA (Chapter 6 ) visualizes it in 2D, shown alongside the original space in Figure 32.4 .
blocks.zh: 输出层只是线性投影(第31章的神经元)——但作用于hhh,即隐藏层的输出,而不是原xx. 如果隐藏层完成了它的工作,变换的分数就应该已经用一行直线分开了. 由于hh住在R 4\ mathbb{R}^{4}这里,PCA (第6章)将其可视化为2D,与图32.4中的原始空间一并显示。

blocks.en: Figure 32.4: Original input space vs. the hidden representation (top 2 PCA directions of a 4D space).
blocks.zh: 图32.4:原始输入空间与隐藏显示(4D空间上2个PA方向)相对.

blocks.en: Even this lossy 2D snapshot of the full 4D hidden space shows the two classes pulled apart into something close to linearly separable — a big improvement over the 74 % 74\% ceiling that was the best any line could do in the original space (Chapter 30 ). The actual output neuron works in the full 4D hidden space, where it achieves 100% accuracy exactly. This is the entire mechanism of deep learning in miniature: each layer reshapes the space so that the next layer’s job gets easier, until the final layer’s job is trivial — a single linear projection.
blocks.zh: 连这整个4D隐藏空间的2D快照也显示,这两类被拉入近于线性分隔的事物中——比74%的74分之天花板大有改进,这是任何一行在原空间所能做的最好(第30章). 实际输出的神经元在全4D隐藏空间中工作,在那里精确地实现了100%的精度. 这就是在微型中深层学习的整个机制:每一层都重塑了空间,这样下一层的工作就更容易了,直到最后一层的工作微不足道——一个单一的线性预测.

blocks.en: 32.5 Model capacity: how many hidden units are enough?
blocks.zh: 32.5 模型容量:有多少隐藏单元足够?

blocks.en: A model’s capacity is how rich a family of functions it can represent. Here that’s set directly by H H , the hidden layer’s width: each hidden unit contributes one straight cut, and the output layer combines these units. Too few units, and the model simply cannot represent the boundary needed by the dataset — no amount of training can find a solution that doesn’t exist. Sweeping H H and retraining from scratch at each width, across 5 random initializations each:
blocks.zh: 一个模型的能力在于它能代表一个功能的丰富性。 隐藏层的宽度是HH直接设定的:每个隐藏单元都贡献一个直截了当的切口,输出层将这些单元结合在一起。 太多的单位, 模型根本无法代表数据集所需的边界, 从头到尾从头抽出H,每个宽度5个随机初始化:

blocks.en: Figure 32.5: Accuracy vs. capacity, across 5 random seeds at each width.
blocks.zh: 图32.5:准确度与容量,每个宽度横跨5个随机种子.

blocks.en: H = 1 H=1 (Figure 32.5 ) caps out well below 100% no matter how long it trains or which seed it starts from — that’s not an optimization failure, it’s a representational ceiling: one hidden unit is just a single cut, so it inherits Chapter 30 ’s ∼ 74 % \sim 74\% linear limit almost exactly. H = 2 H=2 is better, but still capacity-limited — none of the five seeds reach 100%. H = 3 H=3 is the actual knife’s edge: the capacity to represent a perfect solution is there (one seed reaches exactly 100%), but whether training finds it depends on which seed it starts from (a preview of Chapter 33 ’s optimization landscape problems).
blocks.zh: H = 1 H = 1(图32.5 ) , 无论训练时间有多长或从哪根种子开始, 上限都远远低于100% — — 这不是优化失败,而是代表上限:一个隐藏的单位只是一个切口, 所以它继承了第30章的- 74 %\ sim 74\\\\\ 线性限制。 H = 2 H = 2更好,但容量仍然有限——5个种子都没有达到100%. H = 3 H = 3 是实际刀的边缘:代表完美解决方案的能力就在那里(一个种子完全达到100%),但训练是否发现它取决于它从哪一个种子开始(第33章优化地貌问题的预览).

blocks.en: By H = 4 H=4 , every seed reaches 100% reliably: there’s enough capacity that the network stops being the bottleneck, and training reliably finds a solution within that capacity. This is the general shape of a capacity curve — a hard floor set by what the model can represent, with optimization difficulty riding on top of it near the floor’s edge. This same curve is revisited in Chapter 35 from the opposite direction: there, capacity is held generously high and data is scarce, which turns “enough capacity to represent the right answer” into “also enough capacity to memorize the wrong one.”
blocks.zh: H = 4 H = 4, 每个种子都达到了100%的可靠水平: 足够的能力让网络不再成为瓶颈, 训练也可靠地在这个能力范围内找到解决方案。 这是容量曲线的一般外形——由模型能够代表的硬地层所设置,最优化难度被骑在地板边缘附近. 第35章从相反的方向重新审视了同样的曲线:在这方面,能力被慷慨地保持了高水平,而且缺乏数据,这把“足够代表正确答案的能力”变成了“足够能够记住错误答案的能力”。 “

blocks.en: Width isn’t the only knob. Depth — stacking more layers instead of making a layer wider — is the other axis, and it isn’t just “width in disguise”: a deep, narrow network can represent some functions far more compactly than a shallow, wide one needs to, but it introduces its own failure mode instead. Chapter 37 picks this up directly: stacking enough layers can make gradients vanish before they ever reach the earliest ones, a problem not encountered by this chapter’s shallow 2-layer network.
blocks.zh: Width并不是唯一的把手。 深度——堆放更多的地层而不是使地层更宽——是另一个轴线,它不仅仅是"变相地":一个深而狭的网络可以比浅而宽的网络需要更精确地代表一些功能,但它引入了自己的失败模式. 第37章直接提到这一点:堆放足够多的地层可以让梯度在到达最早的地层之前消失,这是本章浅的二层网络没有遇到的问题.

blocks.en: 33.2 Momentum: remember where you were heading
blocks.zh: 33.2 时刻:记住你正往哪里去

blocks.en: Instead of stepping purely along the current gradient, accumulate a running velocity — a weighted average of past gradients — and step along that instead: v ← β v − η ∇ f ( p ) , p ← p + v . v\leftarrow\beta v-\eta\nabla f(p),\qquad p\leftarrow p+v. (33.1) Momentum’s real benefit is acceleration, not damping. Along a consistent direction (the shallow x x axis here), every gradient points the same way, so the running velocity keeps growing step after step — the effective step size along that axis becomes much larger than η \eta alone would give, exactly like a ball picking up speed rolling downhill. Along an oscillating direction (the steep y y axis, flipping sign every step), consecutive gradients partially cancel in that same running average — but only partially : a single momentum coefficient β \beta is shared across every direction, so that cancellation isn’t tuned to any one direction’s curvature, and the steep axis can still swing substantially before it decays. The net effect, over a full run, is usually still a win: with β = 0.9 \beta=0.9 , 30 steps land at loss 0.2785 0.2785 — better than plain SGD, but by acceleration plus a rough, untuned brake, not a clean fix for oscillation. A from-scratch implementation matches torch.optim.SGD(..., momentum=0.9) to 2.22 × 10 − 16 2.22\times 10^{-16} .
blocks.zh: 而不是完全沿着目前的梯度走,而是累积跑步速度——过去梯度的加权平均值——然后沿着这个梯度走:v β v → ∇ f (p),p + ← p + v. v\leftarrow\beta v-\eta\nabla f (p),\qquad p\ leftarrow p+v (33.1) 动向的真正好处是加速,而不是加压。 沿着一个一致的方向(这里的浅xx轴),每一个梯度都指向相同的方向,所以跑步速度会接连地不断地递增——沿着那条轴线的有效步长会比"\eta"要大得多,就像一个接起速度的球向下滚去一样. 沿着一个斜向(陡起的y轴,每一步翻转的标志),连续的梯度在相同的运行平均值中部分被取消 — — 但只有部分:每个方向共享一个单一的正向系数β\β,这样取消就不会被调和到任何一个方向的曲率,而陡起的轴在衰减前仍然可以大幅回旋. 净效应在全跑道上,通常仍是取胜:用β=0.9\β=0.9,30步地以亏损0.27850.2785-优于平地SGD,但通过加速度加粗而未调节的制动,不是振荡的清洁固定. 一个从擦出的执行匹配火炬. opime.SGD(.,正率=0.9)到2.22 × 10 - 16 2.22\times 10-16}.

Momentum’s accumulated velocity clearly accelerates progress along that shallow direction, and it ends with a lower loss than plain SGD — but notice its path actually swings wider in y y than plain SGD’s own, not narrower, since a single shared momentum coefficient can’t damp each axis to the degree that axis specifically needs. blocks.en: 33.4 Weight initialization: why zero doesn’t work
blocks.zh: 33.4 联合国 重量初始化:为什么零不起作用

blocks.en: It’s tempting to initialize all weights to zero. Although this seems like the most “neutral” starting point, it’s actually catastrophic for any layer with more than one unit: every hidden unit computes the exact same function of the input, gets the exact same gradient, and gets updated by the exact same amount, forever. This symmetry never breaks on its own: training a 4-hidden-unit MLP on the ring-and-disk dataset from zero initialization for 3000 epochs reaches only 50.0 % 50.0\% accuracy, with all four hidden units still identical (all zero); randomly initialized weights reach 100.0 % 100.0\% . Small random initialization breaks the symmetry: every unit starts out computing something slightly different, so gradient descent can push them apart and let them specialize. This is why every framework’s default layer initialization uses small random values, never zeros.
blocks.zh: 将所有重量初始化为零, 虽然这似乎是最“中立”的起点,但对于任何一个以上单位的地层来说,这实际上都是灾难性的:每个隐藏的单位计算输入的完全相同的功能,得到完全相同的梯度,并且永远得到完全相同的量的更新。 这种对称性从不自行突破:在环与盘数据集上从0初始化到3000个纪元的4个隐藏单元的MLP训练只达到50.0%的50.0QQ精度,所有四个隐藏单元仍然相同(全部为零);随机初始化加权为100.0%的1000.0QQ. 小的随机初始化打破了对称性:每个单元开始计算一些稍有不同的东西,因此梯度下降可以将它们推开,让它们专门化. 这就是为什么每个框架的默认层初始化都使用小的随机值,从零开始.

blocks.en: 33.5 Weight initialization schemes: how large should “small random” be?
blocks.zh: 33.5 重量初始化计划: " 小随机 " 应有多大?

blocks.en: Zero-init fails completely; “small random” fixes it. But how small? Pick a fixed standard deviation and it works for one layer width, then quietly fails at another. Tracking the variance of activations after passing random data through a deep stack of tanh -activated linear layers, using a fixed weight std of 0.05 0.05 at every width:
blocks.zh: 0-init完全失效;“小随机”处理。 但有多小? 多少个? 选择一个固定的标准偏差, 它工作在一个层宽, 然后悄悄地失败在另一个层宽。 使用每道宽度0.05平方公尺的固定重量,通过深层的tanh-活化线性地层通过随机数据后,跟踪激活的差异:

blocks.en: A fixed std of 0.05 0.05 vanishes to essentially zero after 20 layers — and the amount it vanishes depends heavily on layer width. Each layer’s pre-activation variance scales as fan_in × std 2 \text{fan\_in}\times\text{std}^{2} , where fan-in is the layer’s number of inputs: at width 16, that’s 16 × 0.05 2 ≈ 0.04 16\times 0.05^{2}\approx 0.04 , so each layer keeps only about 4% of the previous layer’s variance, and 20 compounding layers erase the signal almost completely. At width 256, the same fixed std keeps 256 × 0.05 2 ≈ 0.64 256\times 0.05^{2}\approx 0.64 of the variance per layer — still shrinking, but far more slowly. A fixed std’s effect depends entirely on fan-in, so the same number that badly vanishes a narrow layer would, at a wide enough layer, push fan_in × std 2 \text{fan\_in}\times\text{std}^{2} past 1 and start exploding instead.
blocks.zh: 20层之后,0.05 0.05平方公尺的固定数字消失到基本上为零,其消失量在很大程度上取决于地层宽度。 每层的活化前相差尺度作为扇_ in_ std 2\text{fan\_in}\times\text{std}^{2},其中扇入是层的输入数:宽度为16:16×0.05 2. 0.04 16\times 0.05^{2}\ 0.04,因此每层只保留了上层相差的4%左右,20个复合层几乎完全抹去信号. 在宽度为256时,相同的固定std保持了256×0.05 2×0.64 256\times 0.05××2×0.64每层相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相相差相差相差相 固定的std效果完全取决于扇入, 因此, 与严重消失的狭长地层相同的数字会在足够宽的地层中, 推出扇入到xstd 2\text{fan\_in\times\text{std}^{2} 1 后开始爆炸。

blocks.en: Xavier initialization ( Glorot & Bengio, 2010 ), also known as Glorot initialization , fixes this by scaling the std with the layer’s fan-in: std = 1 / fan_in \text{std}=\sqrt{1/\text{fan\_in}} , which keeps fan_in × std 2 \text{fan\_in}\times\text{std}^{2} pinned at exactly 1 regardless of width. Repeating the experiment with Xavier-scaled weights keeps variance in the same ballpark at every width ( 0.026 0.026 , 0.023 0.023 , 0.027 0.027 at widths 16, 64, 256), instead of vanishing catastrophically — and nn.init.xavier_normal_ ’s empirical weight std ( 0.0627 0.0627 ) matches the formula’s prediction ( 0.0625 0.0625 ) closely.

blocks.en: But Xavier’s derivation assumes a symmetric activation like tanh . Kaiming initialization ( He et al., 2015 ), also known as He initialization , is the same idea adjusted for ReLU , which zeros out roughly half its inputs and so needs twice the variance to compensate: std = 2 / fan_in \text{std}=\sqrt{2/\text{fan\_in}} . Using Xavier’s tanh -derived scale on a ReLU network still vanishes: at width 256, Xavier scale gives a variance of 3.06 × 10 − 7 3.06\times 10^{-7} after 20 layers, while Kaiming scale keeps it at 1.324 1.324 — and nn.init.kaiming_normal_ ’s empirical std ( 0.0887 0.0887 ) again matches the formula ( 0.0884 0.0884 ).
blocks.zh: 但Xavier的推论假设像tanh一样的对称活化。 Kaiming初始化(He等,2015年),又名He初始化,是ReLU所调整的同一种想法,它将大约一半的输入输出为零,因此需要两倍的相差来补偿:std=2/扇_in\text{std}=\sqrt{2/\text{fan\_in}. 在ReLU网络上使用Xavier的tanh-衍生尺度仍然消失:宽度为256,Xavier尺度在20层之后的相差为3.06×10-7 3.06\times 10-7;而Kaiming尺度则保持为1.324 1.324-和nn.init.kaiming_normal_'s expert std (0.0887 0.0887)再次与公式相匹配(0.0884 0.0884)。

blocks.en: Rule of thumb: use Kaiming init for ReLU -family networks (the default for nn.Conv2d / nn.Linear is actually already a variant of this), and Xavier for tanh / sigmoid . Both are strictly better than picking a fixed std and hoping. They’re derived, not tuned, from a simple requirement: keep activation variance roughly constant from layer to layer, so a network can be made arbitrarily deep without silently losing its signal before training even starts.
blocks.zh: 拇指规则:使用 Kaiming init for ReLU - family network(n.Conv2d / nn.Linear的默认值实际上已经是一个变体),而Xavier为tanh / sigmoid . 两者严格来说都比选一个固定的Std和希望要好. 由简单的要求衍生而来,而不是调制:使激活差异在层间保持大致平稳,因此网络可以在训练开始前被任意打入深处,而不会默默失去信号。

blocks.en: 33.6 Learning rate schedules
blocks.zh: 33.6 学习率表

blocks.en: A single fixed learning rate for the whole training run is tempting, but it’s often the wrong choice: a rate large enough for fast early progress is usually too large to settle precisely once training nears a minimum. Learning rate schedules change the rate over time. Three common ones, each validated against torch.optim.lr_scheduler to within numerical roundoff (Figure 33.3 ): • Step decay : multiply the rate by a fixed factor every N N steps. • Cosine annealing : smoothly decay along a cosine curve from the initial rate down to (near) zero — the name is borrowed directly from simulated annealing , the classical optimization technique of starting “hot” (free to explore, even accepting worse moves) and gradually “cooling” toward a fixed solution. • Linear warmup : ramp up from zero over the first few steps, before applying the main schedule — used because early updates, before a model’s gradient statistics have stabilized, can be unreliable enough that a large rate from step one causes damage a few steps of gradual ramp-up would have avoided.
blocks.zh: 整个培训阶段的单一固定学习率很诱人,但往往是错误的选择:一个足够快的早期进步的学习率通常太高,无法在培训接近最低限度时准确解决。 学习率时间表随时间变化。 3个常见的,每个经验证的火炬.oppim.lr_排程器在数值圆形内(图33.3): 步衰:每N分步乘以固定系数。 余弦反射:从初始速率下至(接近)0的余弦曲线上平稳地衰变——这个名字直接取自模拟的"余弦",即从"热"(可以自由探索,甚至可以接受更糟糕的动作)开始的经典优化技术,并逐渐地"冷"到固定的解决方案. 二. 支助 线性暖和:在应用主要时间表之前,从零向上爬,因为早期更新,在模型梯度统计稳定之前,可能不可靠,以至于步骤一的一高速率会造成几分渐进坡度的破坏。

blocks.en: Cosine annealing : smoothly decay along a cosine curve from the initial rate down to (near) zero — the name is borrowed directly from simulated annealing , the classical optimization technique of starting “hot” (free to explore, even accepting worse moves) and gradually “cooling” toward a fixed solution.
blocks.zh: 余弦反射:从初始速率下至(接近)0的余弦曲线上平稳地衰变——这个名字直接取自模拟的"余弦",即从"热"(可以自由探索,甚至可以接受更糟糕的动作)开始的经典优化技术,并逐渐地"冷"到固定的解决方案.

blocks.en: Linear warmup : ramp up from zero over the first few steps, before applying the main schedule — used because early updates, before a model’s gradient statistics have stabilized, can be unreliable enough that a large rate from step one causes damage a few steps of gradual ramp-up would have avoided.

blocks.zh: 图33.3:三个学习速率表:步衰减,余弦取出,线性取暖.

blocks.en: Why decay actually helps: noisy gradients
blocks.zh: 为什么衰变实际上有帮助: 吵闹的梯度

blocks.en: On the exact, noise-free narrow bowl from the top of this chapter, a well-chosen constant learning rate converges just fine — there’s nothing to decay away from. Real training almost never sees the exact gradient, though: each step uses a mini-batch estimate, which is noisy. Simulating that by adding random noise to the gradient every step, and comparing a constant rate against step decay: constant learning rate leaves a mean loss over the final 50 steps of 0.2142 0.2142 , while step decay reaches 0.0025 0.0025 — nearly two orders of magnitude lower (Figure 33.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在准确的,无噪声的狭小碗 从本章的顶部,一个精心选择的恒定学习率 汇合在一起——没有什么可以消失的。 真正的训练几乎从来没有看到精确的梯度,虽然:每一步都使用一个小批量的估计,这很吵. 模拟通过将随机噪声加到梯度上每个步骤,并比较恒定速率与步衰变:恒定学习速率在最后的50步0.21420.2142上留下了平均损失,而步衰变则达到0.0025.0025-相差近两个等分级(图33.4).

blocks.en: Figure 33.4: Noisy gradients: constant learning rate vs. step decay, loss on a log scale.
blocks.zh: 图33.4:噪音梯度:恒定学习率与步衰减相比,在日志尺度上丢失.

blocks.en: With noisy gradients, a constant learning rate large enough to make fast early progress never actually settles — it keeps bouncing around the minimum by an amount proportional to the learning rate itself, forever. Step decay makes the same fast early progress, then shrinks the rate as training continues, tightening that bounce and landing far closer to the true minimum. This is the real justification for learning rate schedules: not that a fixed rate is “wrong” on some idealized noise-free problem, but that it can’t simultaneously be large (for speed) and small (for precision) when every gradient is a noisy estimate, which is the normal situation for real mini-batch training.
blocks.zh: 有了吵闹的梯度,一个恒定的学习率足够大,可以实现快速的早期进步,但实际上从来没有解决——它一直以与学习率本身成正比的金额来绕过最低点,永远地. 步道衰变使得同样快的早期进步,然后随着训练的继续收缩速度,收紧了回弹和起降距离更接近于真正的最小. 这是学习速度表的真正理由:并不是说固定速度对于一些理想化的无噪声问题来说是“错误的”,而是不能同时是大(对于速度)和小(对于精确性),因为每个梯度都是一个吵闹的估计,这是真正的小批量训练的正常情况。

blocks.en: 34.1 A conv layer is a projection, restricted and shared
blocks.zh: 34.1 (中文(简体) ). 凸起层是一种投影, 限制和共享

blocks.en: Recall Chapter 30 ’s central idea: y = w ⊤ ​ x + b y=w^{\top}x+b , a projection. A convolutional layer computes exactly this , but for x x , it only looks at a small local patch (say 3 × 3 3\times 3 ) instead of the whole image — and, crucially, it reuses the same w w at every patch location. Two consequences: • Vastly fewer parameters. A 3 × 3 3\times 3 filter over a single input channel has 9 weights, no matter how big the image is — a fully-connected layer over a 16 × 16 16\times 16 image needs 256 weights per output unit . • Translation equivariance. Because the same filter slides everywhere, a feature learned at one position is automatically detected at every other position too, for free. Equivariant means the output shifts along with the input, rather than staying fixed — shift the image by 2 pixels and the feature map’s detections shift by exactly 2 pixels too. That’s a distinct, weaker property than invariance (an unchanged output despite a shifted input), which pooling adds a bit of, later in this chapter.
blocks.zh: 回顾第30章的中心思想:y = w = x + b = y = w = top}x + b,一种投影. 一个演化层完全计算这个,但是对于xx,它只看一个小的局部补丁(说3×3相3相3相3相3相),而不是整个图像——关键是在每个补丁位置重复使用相同的ww. 两个后果: • 参数大为减少。 3×3 3\times 3滤波器在单个输入通道上的滤波器有9个重量,无论图像有多大——16×16个16个16个时段的全接层需要每个输出单元256个重量. • 翻译平等。 因为同一过滤幻灯片随处可见,在一个位置上学习到的特性也会在其它位置上自动被检测到,免费使用. Equivariant指输出随输入而变化,而不是保持固定——将图像相移为2像素,特征映射的检测相移也相移为2像素. 比起无所事事(尽管投入有变化,但产出没有变化),这是一个独特的、更弱的地产,在本章的后面,集合会增加一点。

blocks.en: A conv layer kernel is 3D
blocks.zh: 凸轮层内核为 3D

blocks.en: A “ 3 × 3 3\times 3 filter” in a CNN is really 3 × 3 × C i ​ n 3\times 3\times C_{in} , not just 3 × 3 3\times 3 . Chapter 10 ’s kernels were flat 2D grids, because they slid over a single grayscale channel. A conv layer’s filter has to reach across every input channel at once — a 3 × 3 3\times 3 filter on a 3-channel RGB image has 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 3\times 3\times 3=27 weights, one full depth-slice per input channel, summed together into a single output value at each position. Stack C o ​ u ​ t C_{out} of these 3 × 3 × C i ​ n 3\times 3\times C_{in} filters side by side (one per output channel) and the full weight tensor is 4D: (C_out, C_in, 3, 3) .

blocks.en: 34.2 Conv2d, forward and backward, from scratch
blocks.zh: 34.2 从头到尾的Conv2d

blocks.en: This is the same sliding-window computation as Chapter 10 ’s convolution, just with the kernel now a set of learnable weights instead of a fixed, hand-designed one — which means it needs a backward pass too.
blocks.zh: 这与第十章的演化过程一样是滑入窗口的计算方式,现在的内核只是一套可以学习的权重,而不是固定的,手工设计的权重,这意味着它也需要落后的通关口.

A from-scratch forward pass matches F.conv2d to 8.88 × 10 − 16 8.88\times 10^{-16} ; the from-scratch backward pass matches PyTorch autograd’s gradients on the input, kernel, and bias to 8.88 × 10 − 16 8.88\times 10^{-16} , 7.99 × 10 − 15 7.99\times 10^{-15} , and 1.78 × 10 − 15 1.78\times 10^{-15} respectively.

blocks.en: Filters you already know: Chapter 12 ’s edge detectors
blocks.zh: 筛选您已经知道的 : 第12章的边缘探测器

blocks.en: The output of a conv layer before training is nonsense; the point is that gradient descent will find useful filters. To see what a useful filter’s output already looks like, apply a filter designed by hand back in Chapter 12 : Sobel’s edge kernel. As it turns out, trained CNNs’ first-layer filters often converge to something visually similar to this — oriented edge and blob detectors — regardless of what the network was trained to do (Figure 34.1 ).
blocks.zh: 收缩层在训练前的输出是无稽之谈;要点是梯度下行会找到有用的过滤器. 要了解有用的过滤器输出已经是什么样子,请在"第12章:索贝尔的边缘内核"中应用手动设计的过滤器. 事实上,训练有素的CNN的第一层过滤器往往与这种面向边缘和blob探测器相会合,而不管网络受过什么训练(图34.1)。

blocks.en: Figure 34.1: Sobel’s edge kernel, applied as a conv layer, on a simple square.
blocks.zh: 图34.1:索贝尔的边缘内核,作为凸起层被应用在一个简单的正方形上.

blocks.en: 34.3 Pooling: downsampling with a purpose
blocks.zh: 34.3 集合:目的下取样

blocks.en: Max pooling slides a window over the feature map and keeps only the maximum value in each window, shrinking the spatial size (like the pyramids of Chapter 11 ) while adding a small amount of local translation invariance — a feature detected at slightly different positions within one pooling window still produces the same output. A from-scratch 2 × 2 2\times 2 max pool matches F.max_pool2d exactly (max diff 0.00 × 10 0 0.00\times 10^{0} ).
blocks.zh: Max Collection将一扇窗口滑过地物映射图,只保留每个窗口的最大值,缩小了空间大小(同第11章的金字塔一样),同时添加了少量的局部翻译不常态——在一个Collection窗口内稍有不同位置检测到的特征仍然产生相同的输出. 一个从-scratch 2×2 2\times 2 最大泳池匹配 F.max_pool2d 准确(最大 diff 0. 0× 10 0\times 10=0}).

blocks.en: 34.4 Putting them together: convolution and pooling, interleaved
blocks.zh: 34.4 联合国 把它们拼凑在一起:相接相接相接相接相接

blocks.en: A real CNN is neither all convolution nor all pooling — it’s the two stacked in alternation: convolution, pooling, convolution, pooling, and so on. Each pooling step roughly halves the spatial size ( H H and W W ), and the rule of thumb is to roughly double the number of channels in the conv layer that follows. That’s not a coincidence: pooling throws away spatial resolution, so doubling the channel count right after keeps the total amount of information ( C × H × W C\times H\times W ) roughly constant from stage to stage, even as the representation trades “a little detail at many positions” for “more detail at fewer positions.”
blocks.zh: 真正的有线电视新闻网既不是全部的演化,也不是全部的集合,而是两个交替堆放的:演化、集合、集合、集合等等。 每个集合步骤大致将空间大小(H H和W W )减半,而拇指规则是大致将接踵而至的凸起层的通道数增加一倍. 这并非巧合:集合会抛出空间分辨率,所以在将信息总量(C × H × W C\times H\times W )从阶段到阶段都保持大致不变之后,将频道数翻一番,即使表述用“许多位置的细微细节”来表示“较少位置的更详细细节 ” 。 “

blocks.en: 34.5 Why translation equivariance actually matters: a generalization test
blocks.zh: 34.5 国家 为什么翻译等同性实际上很重要:概括测试

blocks.en: Build a small classification task: a 16 × 16 16\times 16 image contains either a plus sign or a circle, at a random position . Train on shapes placed only near the center; test on shapes placed only near the corners — positions the model never saw during training (Figure 34.2 ). A network that has genuinely learned “what a plus looks like,” rather than “which pixels tend to be on for a plus at these particular training positions,” should have no trouble with this.
blocks.zh: 构建一个小的分类任务:一个16×16 16\times 16图像包含一个加号或一个圆,在随机位置上. . 仅在中心附近放置外形的列车;仅在角落附近放置外形的试验——将模型在训练期间从未见到过的位置(图34.2). 一个真正了解“什么是附加”而不是“这些特定训练职位上哪一个像素往往是一个附加”的网络,对此不应有异议。

blocks.en: Figure 34.2: Train examples (centered positions) vs. test examples (unseen, corner positions).
blocks.zh: 图34.2:列车实例(以位置为中心)与测试实例(未见位置,角位置)相对.

MaxPool2d (2), nn . Conv2d (8, 16, 5, padding =2), nn . ReLU (), nn . AdaptiveMaxPool2d (1), # global max pool: collapses ALL spatial position info ) self . fc = nn . Linear (16, 1)
Training a flatten-based MLP and this CNN on the same data:
blocks.zh: 在同样的数据上培训一个平地的MLP和这个CNN:

blocks.en: model train acc test acc (unseen positions) MLP 100.0% 73.3% CNN 100.0% 100.0%

Both models fit the training data perfectly. On positions neither has ever seen, the flatten-based MLP does little better than a coin flip — it memorized which pixels tend to be on for each class at the training positions, and that knowledge doesn’t transfer. The CNN, whose global max pooling forces the final decision to depend only on what filters fired somewhere , not where , generalizes to the new positions with no loss in accuracy at all.

blocks.en: 35.1 A deliberately hard, small dataset
blocks.zh: 35.1 国家 一个刻意硬化的小数据集

blocks.en: The same plus-vs-circle task as Chapter 34 , but now with only 12 training images and pixel noise added to every image (Figure 35.1 ), while the validation set stays large (150 images) so its accuracy is a reliable estimate.
blocks.zh: 和"第34章"一样的加-vs-circle任务,但现在每个图像中只增加了12个训练图像和像素噪声(图35.1),而验证集保持了大(150个图像),因此它的准确性是一个可靠的估计.

blocks.en: Figure 35.1: The entire training set is only 12 noisy images like these.
blocks.zh: 图35.1:整个训练集只有12个像这样吵闹的画面.

blocks.en: 35.2 Watching it overfit
blocks.zh: 35.2 看着它超合身

blocks.en: Train a reasonably large CNN (Chapter 34 ’s architecture) on just these 12 images, and track both training loss and validation loss (on the held-out 150 images) at every epoch:
blocks.zh: 就这12个图像培训一个规模合理的CNN(第34章的架构),并追踪每个时代的培训损失和验证损失(关于被搁置的150个图像):

blocks.en: Final train accuracy reaches 100.0 % 100.0\% , but final validation accuracy is only 72.7 % 72.7\% ; validation loss bottoms out at 0.456 0.456 at epoch 277 (of 400), then climbs back up to 0.573 0.573 by the end (Figure 35.2 ).
Figure 35.2: The classic overfitting curve: training loss falls monotonically while validation loss bottoms out and rises again.
blocks.zh: 图35.2:经典超整齐曲线:训练损失单调下降,而验证损失下出并再起.

blocks.en: Training loss marches steadily to zero — the network perfectly memorizes all 12 images, noise included. Validation loss, meanwhile, bottoms out part-way through training and then climbs back up: past that point, every further epoch makes the model more confidently wrong about data it hasn’t seen. Final validation accuracy lands well short of the training set’s perfect score, despite the training set being fit exactly.
blocks.zh: 训练损失稳步到零——网络完全记住了所有12个图像,包括噪音. 校验损失通过训练从半边向外延伸, 最终验证准确性远远低于训练组的完美分数,

blocks.en: 35.3 Fix 1: data augmentation
blocks.zh: 35.3 步骤1:数据增强

blocks.en: If there isn’t enough real data, manufacture more from what’s there. Apply random transformations from Chapter 8 (flips, small rotations) to each training image — the label doesn’t change, but the pixels do, so the network sees a much wider variety of “what a plus/circle can look like” instead of memorizing 12 exact images (Figure 35.3 ). With 20 augmented copies of each of the 12 base images: train accuracy stays at 100.0 % 100.0\% , but validation accuracy jumps from 72.7 % 72.7\% to 95.3 % 95.3\% .
blocks.zh: 如果没有足够的真实数据, 将第8章(flips,小旋转)的随机变换应用到每个训练图像上——标签不会改变,但像素会改变,所以网络看到的是"一个加/圆可以看起来像什么"的更宽广的种类,而不是记起12个精确的图像(图35.3). 12个基本图像中每个都增加了20个拷贝:列车精度保持在100.0%-100.0%-%-%,但验证精度从72.7%-72.7%-到95.3%-%.

blocks.en: Figure 35.3: 6 of 240 augmented copies, all still “the same 12 base images.”
blocks.zh: 图35.3:240份增版中的6份,均“仍为12个基本图像。 “

blocks.en: 35.4 Fix 2: weight decay
blocks.zh: 35.4 修正2:重量衰减

blocks.en: Weight decay adds a penalty proportional to the squared weight magnitudes directly into the loss (equivalently, it shrinks every weight slightly toward zero on every update). Large, highly-tuned weights are exactly what a network needs to memorize 12 specific noisy images; penalizing weight magnitude makes that memorization more costly relative to finding a simpler, smoother function — without adding a single extra training example. With weight_decay=0.05 : train accuracy stays at 100.0 % 100.0\% , validation accuracy rises to 84.0 % 84.0\% .
blocks.zh: 重量衰减将一个与平方重量分量成正比的分量直接加到损失中(相当于每次更新时会将每个重量略微缩入零). 巨大而高调的重量正是网络需要记住的12个具体吵闹的图像;惩罚重量级使得纪念比找到一个更简单更平滑的功能更昂贵——没有增加一个额外的训练实例. 以重量_decay=0.05:列车精度保持在100.0%-100.0%-%-%,验证精度提高到84.0%-84.0-%.

blocks.en: approach train acc val acc no fix 100.0% 72.7% augmentation 100.0% 95.3% weight decay 100.0% 84.0%
blocks.zh: 进取式列车 acc val cc 不固定 100.0% 72.7% 增强 100.0% 95.3% 重量衰减 100.0% 84.0%

blocks.en: Both fixes recover a large chunk of the lost validation accuracy, from two different angles: augmentation attacks the problem by giving the model more (synthetic) data to be right about; weight decay attacks it by making the model less willing to contort itself around a small dataset in the first place. In practice, both are normally used together, along with other regularizers like dropout , covered next, and batch normalization (Chapter 37 ), which incidentally also acts as a mild regularizer.
blocks.zh: 两个修饰都从两个不同的角度回收了一大块丢失的验证精度: 增强通过给模型更多的(合成)数据来正确处理来攻击问题; 重量衰减通过使模型一开始不太愿意围绕一个小数据集来自旋来攻击它. 在实践中,两者通常一起使用,与诸如辍学等其他常态剂一起使用,涵盖下一个常态剂,以及批量常态剂(第37章),该常态剂还起到轻度常态剂的作用。

blocks.en: 35.5 Fix 3: dropout
blocks.zh: 35.5 步骤3:辍学

blocks.en: Dropout ( Srivastava et al., 2014 ) randomly zeroes out a fraction p p of a layer’s activations on every training step, forcing the surviving units to not rely on any one specific other unit always being present. To keep the layer’s output at the same overall scale whether or not dropout is active, the surviving activations are rescaled by 1 / ( 1 − p ) 1/(1-p) — this is “inverted dropout,” what every framework’s Dropout layer actually implements. At evaluation time, dropout does nothing at all: the full, unmodified layer runs, which is why model.eval() matters — forgetting it would leave dropout randomly firing at test time. A from-scratch inverted-dropout implementation zeroes 30.0 % 30.0\% of activations against a target p = 0.3 p=0.3 (PyTorch’s F.dropout zeroes 30.3 % 30.3\% on the same seed), and eval-mode dropout is confirmed to be a true no-op.
blocks.zh: 退学(Srivastava等人,2014年)在每一个训练步骤上随机将一层活化的一分一分一分一分一分的p去除出,迫使幸存单位不依赖任何其他单位始终在场。 为了保持层的输出在整体尺度上保持相同,不管退出是否是活跃的,幸存的活化被重新调整为 1 / (1-p) 1/ (1-p)——这是每个框架的退出层实际执行的"倒出". 在评估时,退学完全无济于事:完全的,未经修改的地层运行,这就是为什么model.eval()很重要——忘记它会让退学者在测试时随意开火. 一个从倒数倒数退出的执行0=30.0%/30.0%/%/%/%/%/(目标p=0.3p=0.3(PyTorch的F.Dropout0=30.3%/30.3%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/%/

blocks.en: Applying it to this chapter’s overfitting problem needs some redundancy to work with — zeroing half of a 32-unit feature vector going straight into a 1-unit output leaves little room to help, so a wider hidden layer (32 → \to 64 → \to 1) is added, with dropout on the 64-unit layer. With only 12 training images, results are noisy from one random seed to the next, so mean validation accuracy over 8 seeds is compared rather than a single run: no dropout reaches 62.8 % ± 7.0 % 62.8\%\pm 7.0\% , dropout( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ) reaches 70.2 % ± 8.0 % 70.2\%\pm 8.0\% .

In a toy setting this tiny (just 12 training images), there isn’t much redundancy for dropout to exploit yet. Although only a modest improvement is shown here, dropout’s benefit is well established at the scale of real datasets and real networks (hundreds of redundant units, thousands of examples). In practice dropout is almost always combined with the other regularizers on this page, not used alone.
blocks.zh: 如此微小的玩具(只有12个训练画面), 虽然这里仅显示略有改善,但辍学福利在真实数据集和真实网络(上百个冗余单位,上千个例子)的规模上得到了很好的证实。 在实践中,辍学几乎总是与本页上的其他常客结合使用,而不是单独使用.

blocks.en: 35.6 Putting it together: real photos, real overfitting
blocks.zh: 35.6 拼凑起来:真实相片,真实的超合

blocks.en: Every fix so far has been tested one at a time, on a synthetic 12-image toy problem chosen specifically to make the failure mode unmistakable. This closing section repeats the experiment on real CIFAR-10 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) photographs: a small, deliberately data-scarce training set of cats and trucks (40 images per class), with augmentation, weight decay, and dropout combined together. Real photographs contain lighting, clutter, and genuine visual ambiguity between classes. Each configuration is averaged over 3 seeds, since 80 training images is still small enough for individual runs to vary:
blocks.zh: 目前为止,每个固定装置都经过一次一次的测试,在一个专门选择的合成的12像玩具问题上进行测试,以使故障模式变得不可混淆. 本收尾部分重复了真实的CIFAR-10(Krizhevsky,2009年)相片的实验: 一套小型的,刻意进行的数据隔离训练的猫和卡车(每班有40个图像),加在一起的增强,重量衰减和辍学. 真实的照片包含照明,杂乱无章,以及各班之间的真实视觉模糊. 每个配置平均有3个种子,因为80个训练图像仍然很小,可供个人跑步变化:

blocks.en: approach train acc val acc no fix 100.0% 78.8% augmentation 100.0% 80.6% weight decay 94.6% 75.9% dropout 100.0% 77.9% all combined 100.0% 82.3%

No single fix is a clear winner here. Weight decay alone actually lands below the unregularized baseline — with weight_decay=0.01 , training accuracy no longer even reaches 100%, meaning the penalty is strong enough to fight the objective without finding a better solution in its place. That’s a useful, humbling result: the weight_decay=0.05 value used earlier in this chapter was tuned for a much smaller network on 12 tiny synthetic images, and a regularization strength that works well in one setting doesn’t automatically transfer to a different architecture or real photographic data.
blocks.zh: 这里没有一条路是明确的赢家 光是体重衰减实际上就落在了未规范的基线以下——以重量_decay=0.01,训练精度甚至不再达到100%,这意味着惩罚的强度足以与目标相抗衡,而没有找到更好的替代方案. 在12个细小的合成图像上, 网络的重量_decay = 0.05 数值被调出, 在一个环境里正常运行的强度不会自动转移到不同的结构或真实的相片数据。

blocks.en: Augmentation and dropout each recover a modest amount of validation accuracy individually. “All combined” beats every single fix and the unregularized baseline, echoing the same lesson from the synthetic dataset: these three regularizers compound rather than substitute for each other. The gain over the unregularized baseline is real but modest (a few percentage points here), which is itself the honest takeaway: regularization narrows the gap between training and validation performance, it doesn’t manufacture data or model capacity that isn’t there.
blocks.zh: 增收和退学分别收回少量的验证精度. “所有组合”胜过每一个固定点和未规范化基线,与合成数据集的相同教训相呼应:这三个常态器复合体而不是相互取代。 比起非正规化的基线, 其收益是实实在在的,

blocks.en: Closing that gap further, on real images, takes what later chapters introduce — more training data, better architectures (Chapter 37 ), and eventually transfer learning (Chapter 38 ): starting from a network already trained on millions of images, instead of memorizing from scratch on a handful of them.
blocks.zh: 在真实的图像上进一步缩小这一差距,取而代之的是后来各章介绍的内容——更多的培训数据、更好的架构(第37章),并最终转移学习(第38章):从一个已经受过数百万个图像培训的网络开始,而不是从头到尾地纪念其中的一小部分。

blocks.en: Every cell of the confusion matrix above is a specific kind of correctness or mistake, but the standard vocabulary for talking about them is binary: pick one class and ask only “is it this, or not?” Collapsing the 4-class matrix down to “truck vs. everything else” gives exactly four outcomes: • True positive (TP) : actually a truck, predicted truck. A hit. • False negative (FN) : actually a truck, predicted something else. A miss — the model let it slip past. • False positive (FP) : actually not a truck, predicted truck anyway. A false alarm. • True negative (TN) : actually not a truck, correctly predicted not-truck. This is the same 2 × 2 2\times 2 table underlying every binary classifier’s evaluation (a medical test’s “positive/negative” result, a spam filter’s “spam/not spam” decision) — a multi-class confusion matrix is just this table computed once per class, with everything off that class’s row/column collapsed into “not this class.” For truck: TP = 13 \text{TP}=13 , FP = 5 \text{FP}=5 , FN = 137 \text{FN}=137 , TN = 445 \text{TN}=445 (total 600 600 , matching the test set size).

blocks.en: 36.4 Precision and recall
blocks.zh: 36.4 准确性和召回性

blocks.en: Two numbers per class, computed directly from TP/FP/FN: • Recall = TP / ( TP + FN ) =\text{TP}/(\text{TP}+\text{FN}) — of everything that really was class i i , what fraction did the model catch? Low recall means the model misses that class often. • Precision = TP / ( TP + FP ) =\text{TP}/(\text{TP}+\text{FP}) — of everything the model called class i i , what fraction actually was? Low precision means the model cries wolf on that class often. (A less commonly needed but related pair, built from the other two quadrants: specificity = TN / ( TN + FP ) =\text{TN}/(\text{TN}+\text{FP}) , how well the model avoids false alarms on the negative class, and its complement the false positive rate = FP / ( FP + TN ) = 1 − specificity =\text{FP}/(\text{FP}+\text{TN})=1-\text{specificity} .)

Truck — the class starved to 90 training images, versus 400 for each other class — has high precision but very low recall: when the model does say “truck,” it’s usually right, but it fails to recognize the overwhelming majority of actual trucks, defaulting instead to whichever classes it saw plenty of during training (mostly “automobile,” the visually closest well-represented class). That is the standard signature of class imbalance, and it is completely invisible in the single overall-accuracy number from before. Cat and dog, by contrast, are both well-represented in training but get confused with each other far more than with automobile or truck — a different failure mode entirely, caused by genuine visual similarity between the two animals rather than by a lack of data. Automobile ends up with unusually high recall but only middling precision, for the same reason truck’s recall suffered: it’s absorbing the starved truck class’s misclassifications, since “wheeled vehicle” is an easy fallback guess once the model can’t tell trucks apart from automobiles.
blocks.zh: 卡车(班级饿到90个训练画面,对相隔400个)的精度很高,但召回率很低:当车型确实说出"卡车"时,它通常是正确的,但它没有识别出绝大多数实际卡车,而是默认在训练期间所见到的很多班级(大多数是"自动",是视觉上最接近的有良好代表性班级)。 这是阶级不平衡的标准标志,从以前起,在单一的整体准确性数字中是完全看不见的。 相形之下,"猫"和"狗"在训练中都具有很好的代表性,但彼此相混淆的却远远多于"汽车"和"卡车"——这完全是一种不同的故障模式,由两种动物之间的真正视觉相似性所引起,而不是缺乏数据所造成. 汽车最后会得到异常高的召回,但只能忽略精确度,同样也是卡车召回受苦的原因:它吸收了被饿死的卡车类别错误的分类,因为“轮式车辆”一旦型号能分辨出卡车和汽车,就很容易回想。

blocks.en: 37.1 ImageNet and ILSVRC: the benchmark that drove this
blocks.zh: 37.1 ImageNet 和 ILSVRC: 驱动这项工作的基准

blocks.en: ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) is a dataset : over 14 million images, hand-labeled across more than 20,000 categories, built by crowdsourcing annotations onto WordNet’s existing noun hierarchy. A big labeled dataset alone doesn’t drive progress, though — a shared, standardized competition does. Starting in 2010, the ILSVRC (ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge, Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) turned a 1000-category, ∼ \sim 1.2-million-image subset of ImageNet into an annual benchmark: every group trained on the same data and was scored on the same held-out test set, making architectures directly, objectively comparable at a scale no one had managed before. The competition’s winning top-5 error rate by year is a fair proxy for the field’s progress across the decade this chapter covers:
blocks.zh: ImageNet(Deng et al.,2009年)是一个数据集:超过1400万张图片, 仅一个大标注的数据集并不能推动进步, 从2010年开始,ILSVRC(ImageNet大型视觉识别挑战,Russakovsky等,2015年)将"ImageNet"的1000个类别,\ sim 120-million-image子集变成了一个年度基准:每组接受相同数据培训并在相同的被搁置测试集上打出分数,使架构直接,客观上可以比对,其规模以前无人管理. 本届赛事每年的得分最高为5分,

blocks.en: Year Winner Top-5 error 2010 (pre-deep-learning features) 28.2% 2012 AlexNet 16.4% 2014 GoogLeNet (VGG close behind, at 7.3%) 6.7% 2015 ResNet 3.57% 2017 SENet 2.25%
blocks.zh: 2010年Winner Top-5出错(深处前学习功能) 28.2% 2012 AlexNet 16.4% 2014 GoogleNet(VGG贴近后方,7.3%) 6.7% 2015 ResNet 3.57% 2017 SENet 2.25%

blocks.en: On this same task, a trained human achieves ∼ 5 % \sim 5\% error rate. ResNet was the first to beat this number — sometimes referred to as “super-human” performance. By 2017, with the winning error under 2.5%, ILSVRC’s classification track was retired — its job as a benchmark essentially done.
blocks.zh: 在同一项任务上,受过训练的人实现了 \\\\\\\\\5%的误差率。 ResNet率先击败了这个数字——有时被称为"超人"的表现. 到2017年,随着2.5%以下的取胜出错,ILSVRC的分类轨迹已退役——它作为基准的工作基本完成.

blocks.en: 37.2 A brief historical tour
blocks.zh: 37.2 (中文(简体) ). 短暂的历史之旅

blocks.en: A handful of architectures were invented during this history, each solving a specific problem: • LeNet-5 ( LeCun et al., 1998 ) — the template Chapter 34 already implements: conv, pool, conv, pool, then fully-connected layers. Built for digit recognition on 32 × 32 32\times 32 images. • AlexNet ( Krizhevsky, Sutskever & Hinton, 2012 ) — the same template, just much bigger (5 conv layers, ∼ \sim 60M parameters), trained on ImageNet using GPUs and ReLU instead of tanh/sigmoid. Its 2012 ILSVRC win is the watershed event that began the deep learning revolution in computer vision — reviving mainstream interest in neural networks after a decade-long winter (akin to the “AI winter”). • VGG ( Simonyan & Zisserman, 2015 ) — replaced AlexNet’s large 11 × 11 11\times 11 / 5 × 5 5\times 5 filters with a deep stack of small 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions. Two stacked 3 × 3 3\times 3 convs have the same receptive field as one 5 × 5 5\times 5 conv (Chapter 11 ’s pyramid idea again) but fewer parameters and an extra nonlinearity in between. • GoogLeNet / Inception ( Szegedy et al., 2015 ) — went wider instead of just deeper: each “Inception module” runs several convolution sizes ( 1 × 1 1\times 1 , 3 × 3 3\times 3 , 5 × 5 5\times 5 ) side by side on the same input and concatenates their outputs, so the network doesn’t have to commit to one filter size per layer. 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutions are used first to cheaply shrink the channel count, keeping the wider module affordable. • ResNet ( He et al., 2016 ) — pushed depth from VGG’s ∼ \sim 19 layers to 50, 101, even 152, by solving the problem that had made naively stacking more layers worse , not better. • SENet ( Hu, Shen & Sun, 2018 ), the 2017 ILSVRC winner — not a new backbone shape, but a refinement: its “squeeze-and-excitation” block lets each layer learn per-channel weights (which feature channels matter most for this input) rather than treating every channel equally.
