blocks.en: 37.3 Building a ResNet block
blocks.zh: 37.3 建设ResNet区块

blocks.en: The vanishing-gradient problem
blocks.zh: 逐渐消失的问题

blocks.en: Why does stacking more layers make plain networks worse ? Backprop’s chain rule multiplies a gradient by every layer’s local Jacobian on its way back to the input. If those per-layer factors are consistently smaller than 1 — which happens easily with a saturating activation like sigmoid, whose derivative is at most 0.25 — a deep enough stack multiplies the gradient by a very small number many times over. The gradient reaching early layers shrinks toward zero, and those layers stop learning at all.
blocks.zh: 为什么堆放更多的地层 使得网络变得更糟? Backprop的连锁规则在返回输入的路上,通过每一层的当地雅各人乘以一个梯度。 如果这些每层因子始终小于1——这在饱和活化时很容易发生,比如Sigmoid,其衍生出物最多为0.25),那么一个足够深的堆栈会将梯度乘以极小的多倍. 到达早期地层的梯度缩小到零, 这些地层完全停止学习。

blocks.en: Build a 30-layer, sigmoid-activated network of Linear layers and track the gradient magnitude at every depth, for two versions: a plain stack x = sigmoid(layer(x)) , and a residual stack x = x + 0.3 * sigmoid(layer(x)) where each layer only has to learn a small correction added to its input, rather than replacing it outright.
blocks.zh: 构建30层,相克活化的线性地层网络,并跟踪每个深度的梯度级,用于两个版本:平面堆放 x =相克(层 (x));剩余堆放 x = x + 0.3 *相克(层 (x)),每层只需学习其输入所添加的小校正,而不是直接取而代之.

blocks.en: ⬇ class ResidualDeepNet ( nn . Module ): def forward ( self , x ): for layer in self . layers : x = x + 0.3 * torch . sigmoid ( layer ( x )) return x
blocks.zh: QQ类残存深网(nn. Module ): def向前(自,x):用于自成层. 层: x = x + 0.3 * 火炬. sigmoid (层 (x)) 返回 x

blocks.en: For a 30-layer stack: the plain network’s ratio of gradient norm at the input layer to the last layer is 2.07 × 10 − 19 2.07\times 10^{-19} ; the residual network’s ratio is 1.05 × 10 0 1.05\times 10^{0} — essentially flat (Figure 37.1 ).
blocks.zh: 对于一个30层的堆放:平板网络在输入层与上层的梯度规范比为2.07×10-19 2.07\times 10\19};剩余网络的比例为1.05×10 1.05\times 10\times 10\0}——基本平平 (图37.1).

blocks.en: Figure 37.1: Gradient magnitude vs. depth, plain sigmoid network vs. residual network, log scale.
blocks.zh: 图37.1:梯度相对深度,平地相克网相对余网相对,日志相对.

blocks.en: The plain network’s gradient shrinks by roughly nineteen orders of magnitude between the last layer and the first — for all practical purposes, the early layers receive no learning signal at all. The residual network’s (ResNet’s) gradient stays essentially flat across all 30 layers.
blocks.zh: 平地网络的梯度在上层和上层之间缩小了大约19个数量级——就所有实际目的而言,早期层完全得不到学习信号. 剩余网络(ResNet)的梯度在所有30个层次基本上保持不变。

blocks.en: The reason is structural, not a matter of tuning: with a residual connection, x l + 1 = x l + F ⁡ ( x l ) x_{l+1}=x_{l}+F(x_{l}) , so d ​ x l + 1 / d ​ x l = I + d ​ F / d ​ x l dx_{l+1}/dx_{l}=I+dF/dx_{l} . Backprop multiplies these Jacobians together across layers, but every one of them contains an identity matrix I I as a direct term. That gives the gradient a path straight back to the input that never gets multiplied by a small sigmoid derivative — an unobstructed shortcut, regardless of how deep the stack gets. The plain network has no such path: every layer’s Jacobian is purely d ​ F / d ​ x l dF/dx_{l} , so there’s nothing to stop repeated multiplication from driving the product toward zero.
Batch normalization
blocks.zh: 批量正常化

blocks.en: ResNets use one more ingredient: batch normalization ( Ioffe & Szegedy, 2015 ). The idea is simple — for each channel, subtract that channel’s mean and divide by its standard deviation, computed across the current mini-batch (over the batch, height, and width dimensions, separately per channel), so every channel’s activations always have mean 0 and standard deviation 1 going into the next layer. Two learnable parameters, a per-channel scale γ \gamma and shift β \beta , are then applied on top, so the layer can still recover a different mean/scale if that’s actually useful — normalization to 0/1 is a starting point the network can undo, not a hard constraint.
blocks.zh: ResNets又使用了一种成分:批量正常化(Ioffe & Szegedy,2015.). 这个想法很简单 — — 对于每个频道来说,减去该频道的平均值并按其标准偏差进行划分,在目前的小批量上计算(在批量、高度和宽度上,每个频道分别计算),因此每个频道的激活总是意味着0,标准偏差1会进入下一层。 两个可学习的参数,一个是每道相上下下相上相上相上相下相上相上相下相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相下相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上

blocks.en: Deep networks without batch norm are prone to a related but distinct problem from vanishing gradients: as training updates early layers, the distribution of activations feeding into later layers keeps shifting (sometimes called “internal covariate shift”), so later layers are constantly chasing a moving target. Renormalizing at every layer keeps that distribution stable, which in practice lets much higher learning rates be used and makes deep networks noticeably easier to train — one of the reasons ResNet could push to 50+ layers where earlier architectures struggled past ∼ \sim 20.
blocks.zh: 没有分批规范的深层网络容易从消失的梯度中产生一个相关而独特的问题:随着训练更新早期地层,活化到后层的活化物的分布会不断转移(有时被称为"内部同变移"),所以后层不断追逐移动的目标. 每一层的再规范化保持了这种分布的稳定,这实际上可以让许多更高的学习率被使用,并使深层网络明显更容易被训练——ResNet可以推向50+层的原因之一,早期的建筑在前所未有地挣扎于前所未有地 ~\ sim 20.

blocks.en: A from-scratch per-channel normalize-then-scale-and-shift matches nn.BatchNorm2d to 4.77 × 10 − 7 4.77\times 10^{-7} : per-channel means and standard deviations that started at, e.g., [ − 0.046 , 0.165 , − 0.061 , − 0.165 ] [-0.046,0.165,-0.061,-0.165] and [ 0.939 , 1.037 , 0.911 , 0.977 ] [0.939,1.037,0.911,0.977] come out at exactly [ 0 , 0 , 0 , 0 ] [0,0,0,0] and [ 1 , 1 , 1 , 1 ] [1,1,1,1] after normalization.
Putting it together: a convolutional residual block
blocks.zh: 把它拼凑起来:一个革命后遗症

blocks.en: In an actual ResNet, F F is a pair of small convolutions (with batch normalization and ReLU in between), and the shortcut — also called a skip connection , since it skips over F F entirely — adds the input feature map back onto their output, channel-for-channel and pixel-for-pixel:
blocks.zh: 在实际的ResNet中,F F是一对小回旋(在批量正常化和ReLU之间),快捷键——也叫跳过连接,因为它完全跳过F F——将输入功能映射回他们的输出上,通道换通道和像素换像素:

blocks.en: ⬇ class ResidualBlock ( nn . Module ): def __init__ ( self , channels ): super (). __init__ () self . conv1 = nn . Conv2d ( channels , channels , 3, padding =1) self . bn1 = nn . BatchNorm2d ( channels ) self . conv2 = nn . Conv2d ( channels , channels , 3, padding =1) self . bn2 = nn . BatchNorm2d ( channels ) def forward ( self , x ): out = torch . relu ( self . bn1 ( self . conv1 ( x ))) out = self . bn2 ( self . conv2 ( out )) return torch . relu ( x + out ) # the shortcut: add the block’s input back in

BatchNorm2d(频道)自取. conv2=nn. Conv2d(频道,频道,3,平板=1)自. bn2=nn. BatchNorm2d(频道)向前(自,x):出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出

blocks.en: Passing a ( 4 , 16 , 20 , 20 ) (4,16,20,20) tensor through the block produces an output of the identical shape ( 4 , 16 , 20 , 20 ) (4,16,20,20) — a residual block preserves shape, so blocks can be stacked freely.
blocks.zh: 穿过a (4,16,20,20) (4,16,20,20,20) 取出一个输出出一个相同的形状(4,16,20,20)——一个残余的块保存出形状,因此块可以自由堆放.

blocks.en: Exercises
blocks.zh: 练习

blocks.en: 1. In PlainDeepNet / ResidualDeepNet above, change the activation from torch.sigmoid to torch.relu (ReLU’s derivative is 1 for any positive input, not capped at 0.25 like sigmoid’s) and rerun the gradient-norm comparison. Does the plain network’s vanishing problem get better, worse, or stay about the same? 2. Change the residual net’s scale factor from 0.3 to 1.0 (i.e. x + torch.sigmoid(layer(x)) with no damping) and rerun. Does the gradient ratio change much? What does that suggest about why the residual connection works — is it the scale factor, or the + x shortcut itself? 3. ResidualBlock above requires the input and output to have the same number of channels, since they’re added directly. Real ResNets sometimes need to change channel count between blocks (e.g. 16 → \to 32). Sketch (in words, or in code) what the shortcut path would need to do in that case for the addition to still make sense.

blocks.en: 38.1 Source task and target task
blocks.zh: 第38.1条 源任务和目标任务

blocks.en: Set up two related but distinct tasks, both from CIFAR-10. The source task has plenty of data: distinguishing airplanes from automobiles, 300 training images each. The target task is the one we actually care about, and it’s deliberately starved: distinguishing cats from trucks — two classes the source task never saw at all — with only 15 training images per class (Figure 38.1 ).
blocks.zh: 确定了两项相关但截然不同的任务,均来自CIFAR-10. 源头任务有大量数据:区分飞机和汽车,每架300个训练图像. 目标任务是我们真正关心的任务,它故意饿死:区分猫和卡车——这是源头任务从未见过的两个班级——每个班只有15个训练图像(图38.1).

blocks.en: Figure 38.1: Sample target-task images: cats (top row) and trucks (bottom row).
blocks.zh: 图38.1:目标任务图像样本:猫(上行)和卡车(下行).

blocks.en: 38.2 Three strategies
blocks.zh: 38.2 联合国 三项战略

blocks.en: 1. From scratch — train a fresh CNN on only the 30 target images. This is the baseline: no transfer at all. 2. Frozen backbone (feature extraction) — pretrain a CNN backbone on the source task, then freeze its weights entirely and train only a new linear classifier on top of the features it produces for target images. 3. Fine-tuning — start from the same pretrained backbone, but keep updating it on the target data too, using a much smaller learning rate for the backbone than for the new classifier head (the backbone already encodes useful structure; large updates from just 30 examples would wreck it).
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 从零开始——只在30个目标图像上训练一款新鲜的CNN. 这是基线:完全没有转移。 2. 冷冻骨干(地层取出)——先将CNN的骨干用于源头任务,再将重量完全冻结,并只在它为目标图像制作的特性上再培训出一个新的线性分级器. 3. 精细调整——从同一个预先训练过的骨干开始,但也要在目标数据上不断更新,使用比新的分级头小得多的骨干学习率(骨干已经编码了有用的结构;仅30个例子的大量更新就会破坏它)。

blocks.en: From scratch — train a fresh CNN on only the 30 target images. This is the baseline: no transfer at all.
blocks.zh: 从零开始——只在30个目标图像上训练一款新鲜的CNN. 这是基线:完全没有转移。

blocks.en: Frozen backbone (feature extraction) — pretrain a CNN backbone on the source task, then freeze its weights entirely and train only a new linear classifier on top of the features it produces for target images.
blocks.zh: 被冻结的骨干(feature description)——在源头任务上预先训练出CNN的骨干,再将重量完全冻结,并在它为目标图像制作的特性上只训练出一个新的线性分级器.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning — start from the same pretrained backbone, but keep updating it on the target data too, using a much smaller learning rate for the backbone than for the new classifier head (the backbone already encodes useful structure; large updates from just 30 examples would wreck it).
blocks.zh: 微调——从同一个预先训练过的骨干开始,但也要在目标数据上不断更新,对骨干使用的学习率要小于对新分类器头的学习率(骨干已经编码了有用的结构;只有30个实例的大量更新会破坏它).

blocks.en: ⬇ def train_target ( backbone , freeze_backbone , seed , epochs =200, lr =0.01, backbone_lr = None ): model = Classifier ( backbone , freeze_backbone ) if freeze_backbone : opt = torch . optim . Adam ( model . fc . parameters (), lr = lr ) elif backbone_lr is not None : opt = torch . optim . Adam ([ { ’params’ : model . backbone . parameters (), ’lr’ : backbone_lr }, { ’params’ : model . fc . parameters (), ’lr’ : lr }, ]) else : opt = torch . optim . Adam ( model . parameters (), lr = lr )
Pretraining a small CNN backbone once on the source task, then evaluating all three strategies on the target task, averaged over 8 random seeds:
blocks.zh: 对CNN的小型主干网进行了一次关于源头任务的培训,然后对目标任务的所有三项战略进行评估,平均超过8个随机种子:

blocks.en: strategy mean test acc std from scratch 63.6% 6.8% frozen backbone 69.5% 1.0% fine-tuned 76.7% 1.2%

Both transfer strategies clearly beat training from scratch, and they’re also dramatically more consistent (lower standard deviation). Even though the source task never saw a cat or a truck, it learned generic low-level features (edges, color blobs, textures) that transferred to the new task.
blocks.zh: 两种转会策略显然都从零开始击败训练, 即使源任务从未见过猫或卡车,它也学会了通用的低等特性(尖端,颜色blobs,纹理等),这些特性被转移到了新的任务上.

blocks.en: Note that fine-tuning used a learning rate for the backbone roughly 30 × 30\times smaller than the classifier head’s. With just 30 target examples, a larger backbone update would overfit those 30 images, discarding everything useful it had learned from the 600-image source task. This is the same catastrophic-forgetting failure mode as Chapter 35 ’s overfitting curve, just applied to a network that started out already knowing something.
blocks.zh: 请注意,微调对骨干使用的学习率大约比分类头小30x30\次。 只要有30个目标例子,一个更大的主干线更新就会过度适应这30个图像,丢弃它从600个图像源任务中学到的所有有用的东西. 这与第35章的过度调整曲线一样,

blocks.en: 38.3 In practice: pretrained backbones in one line
blocks.zh: 38.3 联合国 在实际操作中:一行中预训骨干

blocks.en: The toy backbone above is trained from scratch on a toy task for illustrative purposes, but real transfer learning leverages existing networks available for reuse. torchvision ships architectures already pretrained on the full ImageNet dataset (Chapter 37 ) — 1.2 million images across 1,000 classes. Loading such a network, ready to use as a frozen feature extractor, is a single line of code:
blocks.zh: 上面的玩具骨干从头到尾都接受过关于玩具任务的培训,以说明问题,但真正的转移学习杠杆可以利用现有网络进行再利用。 火炬视船的架构已经预先在完整的ImageNet数据集(第37章)上进行了训练——超过1000个等级的120万个图像. 装入这样的网络,准备用作被冻结的特性提取器,是单行代码:

blocks.en: ⬇ resnet = torchvision . models . resnet18 ( weights = torchvision . models . ResNet18_Weights . IMAGENET1K_V1 ) resnet . fc = nn . Identity () # strip the original 1000-class ImageNet head, keep the 512-d features resnet . eval () for p in resnet . parameters (): p . requires_grad = False # frozen, feature-extraction style
blocks.zh: QQ resnet = 火炬视觉. models. resnet18 (重量=火炬视觉. models. ResNet18_Weights. IMAGENET1K_V1) resnet. fc=nn. 身份 () #剥去原来的1000级图像网头,在resnet参数 (:p. required_grad=)中保留512-d特性 resnet. eval () for p. 假 # 被冻结, 特征取出样式

blocks.en: Total ResNet-18 parameters: 11,689,512 11{,}689{,}512 , all pretrained on ImageNet, none of them touched here.
blocks.zh: ResNet-18总参数:11,689,512 11{,}689{,}512,全部在ImageNet上预训,没有一处触到这里.

blocks.en: ResNet-18 was trained on 224 × 224 224\times 224 images normalized by ImageNet’s per-channel mean and standard deviation — not the plain [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] pixel scaling used everywhere else in this chapter — so the target images need to be resized and renormalized before going through it. Extracting a 512-dimensional feature vector for every target image once (the backbone is frozen, so this only needs to happen once, not on every training step), then training a small linear head on top — exactly the frozen-backbone strategy above, just with a very different backbone — reaches 98.1 % ± 0.2 % 98.1\%\pm 0.2\% mean test accuracy over 8 seeds, versus 69.5 % 69.5\% for the toy frozen backbone above.
blocks.zh: ResNet-18接受了224×224/224\times 224图像的训练,通过ImageNet的每道平均与标准偏差——而不是本章其他处使用的平面[0, 1] [0,1]像素缩放——使目标图像需要调整大小并重新正常化后才能通过. 抽取每个目标图像的512维特性矢量一次(主干被冻结,所以这只需要一次,而不是在每一个训练步骤上),然后在上方训练一个小的线性头部——正好是上面的被冻结后骨策略,只有非常不同的主干——在8个种子上达到98.1%±0.2% 0.2% 0.2% 平均测试精度为8个种子,而上面的玩具被冻结后骨干为69.5%.

blocks.en: Frozen ImageNet features push accuracy well past either toy strategy above, using nothing but a new linear layer trained on the same 30 target images — no backbone training at all.
blocks.zh: 冻结图像 网络特性将精确度大大超过上面的玩具策略,只使用在同样的30个目标图像上训练的新线性图层——完全没有骨干训练。

blocks.en: A caveat on this comparison: some of that gap is an unfair advantage, not just richer pretraining. ImageNet’s 1,000 classes already include photos of cats and several vehicle types, unlike the toy source task, which only saw airplanes and automobiles — so this isn’t a perfectly controlled comparison of “big general pretraining” versus “tiny 2-class pretraining” in isolation; part of ResNet-18’s edge comes from having directly seen the target classes during pretraining.
blocks.zh: 关于这一比较的一个警告:某些差距是不公平的优势,而不仅仅是更丰富的预训。 ImageNet的1000个课目已经包括猫的照片和多款车辆类型, 与玩具源任务不同,

blocks.en: Nevertheless, the qualitative point holds, and it’s the actual reason ImageNet-pretrained backbones are the default starting point in practice: a network trained on 1.2 million images learns far richer, more broadly transferable features than one trained on a couple thousand images of two categories ever could — which is exactly what Chapter 37 ’s architectures, and the vastly larger datasets they were trained on, are built to produce.
blocks.zh: 然而,质量点仍然存在,而ImageNet预先训练的骨干是实际操作的默认起点:一个在120万张图像上训练的网络,比一个在几千张两类图像上训练的网络,学到了更丰富、更广泛的可转移的特性——这正是第37章的架构和它们所训练的庞大的数据集所建造的。

blocks.en: Exercises
blocks.zh: 练习

blocks.en: 1. Try backbone_lr=0.01 (i.e. no learning-rate difference between backbone and head) in the fine-tuning call. Does fine-tuned accuracy get better or worse, and does that match the catastrophic-forgetting explanation above? 2. Try freezing most of the backbone but fine-tuning only its last conv layer. Where does that land relative to fully-frozen and fully-fine-tuned? 3. Swap the target task’s classes from cat/truck to dog/automobile — a target pair that overlaps the source task’s domain (vehicles) even more closely than cat/truck did. Does frozen-backbone accuracy improve further, and does that match the intuition that transfer works best when source and target share more underlying visual structure? 4. Try unfreezing just ResNet-18’s last residual stage ( resnet.layer4 ) and fine-tuning it on the 30 target images at a small learning rate, the same way the toy backbone was fine-tuned above. Does it beat the fully-frozen ResNet-18 result, or is 30 images too few to safely update even a small fraction of 11 million parameters?

blocks.zh: 39.1 设置: 猫-vs-自动有线电视新闻网,专题地图曝光

blocks.en: A CIFAR-10 binary task: cat vs. automobile, 300 training images per class. The architecture is Chapter 34 ’s CNN pattern, except forward now also returns the last convolutional layer’s feature map (before global pooling), so both visualization methods have access to it. Trained for 300 epochs: test accuracy 86.5 % 86.5\% .

blocks.en: 39.2 Saliency maps
blocks.zh: 39.2 重要地图

blocks.en: The idea of saliency maps ( Simonyan et al., 2014 ): take the gradient of the predicted class score with respect to every input pixel. A pixel with a large-magnitude gradient is one where a small change would most change the prediction — i.e., a pixel the network is “looking at.”
blocks.zh: 显要地图的构思(Simonyan等,2014年):取每个输入像素的预测分数的梯度. 具有大宽梯度的像素是一个小变化最能改变预测的像素——即网络“看一看”的像素. “

blocks.en: 39.3 Grad-CAM
blocks.zh: 39.3 CAM级

blocks.en: Raw saliency maps (Figure 39.1 ) are pixel-level and tend to be noisy. Grad-CAM instead operates on the feature maps of a chosen convolutional layer, typically the last convolutional layer. Although these feature maps are lower-resolution than a pixel-level saliency map (downsampled by the pooling layers before them), they tend to carry more class-discriminative semantic information than individual raw-pixel gradients do. The method: 1. Compute the gradient of the target class score with respect to each feature-map channel. 2. Globally average each channel’s gradients over its spatial dimensions to obtain one importance weight per channel. 3. Take the weighted sum of the feature-map channels and apply ReLU, retaining the positive contributions to the target class. The resulting coarse heatmap has the spatial resolution of the selected convolutional layer; it can be upsampled to the input resolution for visualization (Figure 39.2 ).
blocks.zh: Raw saliency map (Figure 39.1 ) 为像素级并往往会出声. Grad-CAM则在所选择的演化地层的地物图上运作,一般是最后一个演化地层. 虽然这些地物地图的分辨率低于像素水平的显要地图(由之前的集合地层所下映出),但是它们往往比单个原始像素梯度所携带的分级语义信息要多. 该方法: 1. 计算每个地物图通道的目标类分数的梯度。 2. 每一信道在空间维度上的全球平均梯度,以获得每个信道一个重要重量。 3.取特征图通道的加权总和并应用ReLU,保留对目标类的积极贡献. 由此产生的粗热相图具有所选回旋分层的空间分辨率;可以被取为可视化的输入分辨率(图39.2.

blocks.en: Compute the gradient of the target class score with respect to each feature-map channel.
blocks.zh: 计算目标类分数相对于每个特征图通道的梯度。

blocks.en: Globally average each channel’s gradients over its spatial dimensions to obtain one importance weight per channel.
blocks.zh: 全球平均每个信道在空间维度上的梯度,以获得每个信道一个重要重量。

blocks.en: Take the weighted sum of the feature-map channels and apply ReLU, retaining the positive contributions to the target class.
blocks.zh: 取特征图通道的加权和并应用ReLU,保留对目标类的积极贡献.

blocks.zh: 39.4 国家 这些地图真的追踪模型的用途吗?

blocks.en: model_original (never trained on the marker) rarely lands either method’s peak in that exact corner. model_shortcut is a different story: on marked images both tools are nearly perfect (saliency 96%, Grad-CAM 100%), but on clean images — where the marker was never added, yet model_shortcut still relies on it internally — Grad-CAM’s peak still lands there 92% of the time versus only 56% for saliency. Grad-CAM pools gradients over an entire feature-map channel before localizing, which smooths out pixel-level noise and makes it the more trustworthy detector when the shortcut’s literal trigger isn’t visible in a given image; model_shortcut ’s internal machinery is anchored to that spot regardless of what’s actually there, exactly the failure mode described at the top of this chapter.
blocks.zh: 原创(从未在标记上受过训练) 很少将两种方法的峰值放在准确的一角。 model_shortcut是一个不同的故事:在有标记的图像上,两个工具几乎是完美的(96%的显著性,Grad-CAM 100%),但是在干净的图像上 — — 标记从未添加过,然而模型_shortcut仍然依赖它内部 — — Grad-CAM的峰值在92%的时间里仍然在那里着陆,而对于显著性来说只有56%的时间。 在本地化之前, Grad-CAM 池的梯度覆盖了整个地物图通道, 它能平滑出像素水平的噪音, 当快捷键的字面触发器在给定的图像中不可见时, 它就成为更值得信赖的探测器; 模型_短板的内部机械被固定在那个位置上, 不管实际存在什么, 正是本章顶部描述的故障模式。

blocks.en: The practical lesson: accuracy alone (Chapter 36 ) can’t distinguish whether the model has learned the real signal or a shortcut correlated with it in the training data. Visualization tools such as saliency and Grad-CAM can — but only if you know to check, if you pick a tool sturdy enough to trust, and if you interpret the results with some skepticism about what else in the image might be drawing gradient attention.
blocks.zh: 实事求是的教训:光是准确性(第36章)无法区分模型是否学到了真正的信号, 可视化工具,如显要和Grad-CAM可以——但前提是你知道检查,如果选择一个足够坚固的可以信任的工具,如果用对图像中其他内容可能吸引梯度关注的一些怀疑来解释结果.

blocks.en: 39.5 Feature-space visualization: t-SNE
blocks.zh: 39.5 地貌-空间可视化: t- SNE (韩语)

blocks.en: Saliency maps and Grad-CAM both answer a spatial question about one image at a time: where is the network looking? t-SNE ( van der Maaten & Hinton, 2008 ) asks a broader question across many images: does the network’s internal representation separate the classes it was trained to recognize? It takes each image’s 16-d feature vector — the representation fed directly to the classifier — and projects these vectors into 2D while preserving local neighborhoods. Unlike PCA (Chapter 6 ), which uses a linear projection, t-SNE emphasizes local structure, making it useful for checking whether images from the same class cluster together in feature space without using their labels during the projection.
blocks.zh: 显著地图和Grad-CAM都回答了一个空间问题,一个图像一次一个:网络在哪里看? t-SNE(van der Maaten & Hinton,2008年)在许多图像中提出一个更广泛的问题:网络的内部代表是否将训练出来的课程分开? 它利用每个图像的16-d的特性向量——直接提供给分类器的表示力——并将这些向量投射为2D,同时保护当地街区. 与使用线性投影的PCA(第6章)不同,t-SNE强调局部结构,使其在投影过程中不使用其标签的情况下,用于检查同一类组的图像是否在特征空间一起出现.

blocks.en: Figure 39.3: t-SNE of each test image’s 16-d pooled feature vector, colored by true class: untrained CNN features (left) vs. trained CNN features (right).
blocks.zh: 图39.3:每个测试图像的16 D 集合特性矢量的t-SNE,按真实的分类:未经训练的CNN特性(左)与训练的CNN特性(右).

blocks.en: The untrained network’s features scatter the two classes together with no visible structure (Figure 39.3 ) — unsurprising, since its convolutional weights are still random and have never seen a single labeled example. The trained network’s features form two visibly separated clumps, cat and automobile, even though t-SNE itself was never told which point belonged to which class; it only saw the 16-d feature vectors and their pairwise distances. (Quantitatively, a simple 1-nearest-neighbor check in the 2D embedding — does each point’s nearest neighbor share its true label? — reveals 78% for the trained features versus about 62% for the untrained ones.) This is evidence that training didn’t just adjust the final linear layer — it reshaped the whole feature space so that cats and automobiles genuinely live in different neighborhoods of it.
blocks.zh: 未受训练的网络的特征将两个等级相散开,没有明显的结构(图39.3)——并不出人意料,因为其革命分量仍然是随机的,从未见过一个被贴上标签的例子. 尽管T-SNE本身从未被告知哪个等级属于哪个等级;它只看到16-d特性向量及其双向相距。 (从数量上看,在2D嵌入中一个简单的1-近邻检查——每个点最近的邻居是否共享其真实的标签?) ——揭示78%的训练有素特征,而62%的训练有素特征。 ) 训练不仅调整了最后的线性层面,

blocks.en: 40.1 Step 1: a synthetic “face” and a window classifier
blocks.zh: 40.1 (中文(简体) ). 步骤1:合成“面”和窗口分类器

blocks.en: To demonstrate the mechanics, real data isn’t needed — only a class with consistent internal structure (a head outline, two eyes, a mouth, always in the same relative arrangement) versus clutter that lacks that structure (Figure 40.1 ). Train a small CNN as a pure window classifier: given a fixed-size crop, is there a face filling it, yes or no?

blocks.en: Build a larger scene containing two faces at unknown locations plus background clutter (true face centers at ( 29.0 , 19.0 ) (29.0,19.0) and ( 48.0 , 47.0 ) (48.0,47.0) ), then run the trained window classifier at every position on a dense grid (a sliding window ). Each position gets a raw confidence score, which is recorded at that window’s center. Since windows can’t be centered within win // 2 pixels of the border (a window close to the edge doesn’t fit inside the image), the score is not computed within a border strip, shown in gray in Figure 40.2 .

blocks.en: 40.3 Step 3: threshold, then merge duplicates
blocks.zh: 40.3 第3步:门槛,然后合并重复

blocks.en: The score map peaks near the true faces, but thresholding produces a cluster of detections around each face — every window that overlaps a face heavily enough scores above threshold. This is precisely the duplicate-detection problem Chapter 12 first raised for both Canny and the Hough transform: many near-identical hypotheses need to collapse into one. The fix is non-maximum suppression (NMS) : repeatedly keep the highest-scoring remaining detection and discard every other detection that overlaps it by more than an IoU (intersection-over-union) threshold.

blocks.en: 40.4 Handling scale: the image pyramid
blocks.zh: 第40.4条 处理尺度:图像金字塔

blocks.en: Everything above assumes faces are always exactly 16 × 16 16\times 16 , but real faces appear at unknown scales. The solution is Chapter 11 ’s Gaussian pyramid ( cv2.pyrDown ): build a stack of the image at multiple resolutions, and run the same fixed-size window classifier over every level. A face that’s too big for the window at full resolution will fit the window at some coarser pyramid level, since shrinking the image is equivalent to enlarging the effective window size relative to image content.
blocks.zh: 上面的一切假设面相总是16×16 16\时相16,但真实相相相出现在未知的尺度上. 解决方案是第11章高斯金字塔(cv2.pyrDown ):在多解析度下建立一叠图像,并在每个级别运行相同的固定大小窗口分级器. 视窗在完全解析度上太大的面孔, 将适合视窗的相近金字塔水平, 因为缩小图像相当于相对于图像内容,

blocks.en: 40.5 Viola-Jones
blocks.zh: 40.5 维奥拉-琼斯

blocks.en: The Rowley-Baluja-Kanade window classifier (what this chapter just built, in miniature) was computationally heavy at the time. In 1996 (pre-GPUs) evaluating a small neural network at every position and scale of every pyramid level was slow. Viola and Jones (2001) modified the same sliding-window idea to run in real time by replacing the neural network with a cascade of extremely cheap Haar-like features (the same local sum/difference idea as Chapter 16 ’s Haar wavelet, applied to 2D rectangular regions): a sequence of stages, each a simple threshold on a rectangular-region intensity difference, ordered so that the vast majority of non-face windows get rejected by the first stage or two, and only the rare promising windows pay for the full cascade of classifiers. As a result, the cascade’s average cost per window is tiny — which is why Viola-Jones is the algorithm that ended up running live on 2000s-era digital cameras.
blocks.zh: Rowley-Baluja-Kanade 窗口分类器(本章刚刚构建的,以微型为单位)在当时的计算重. 1996年(GPU前作),在每个金字塔级别每个位置和尺度上评价一个小神经网络是缓慢的. Viola和Jones(2001年)修改了同样的滑窗想法,实时运行,将神经网络替换为极廉价的Haar类似特征的级联(与第16章的"Haar"波浪相同的局部和/偏差想法被应用到2D长方形区域):一个阶段序列,每个阶段在长方形-区域强度差异上有一个简单的阈值,命令绝大多数非面窗被第一阶段或第二阶段所拒绝,只有罕见的有前途的窗口支付全部分级. 因此,级联每扇窗的平均成本很小——这就是为什么Viola-Jones是最终在2000年代数码相机上直播的算法.

blocks.en: OpenCV ships the Viola-Jones cascade as cv2.CascadeClassifier , pretrained on real faces. Just load an XML file of learned cascade stages and run it. On a real photo of the Apollo 11 crew (Figure 40.4 ): 4 detections.
blocks.zh: OpenCV将Viola-Jones级联作为Cv2. CascadeClassifier,在真实的面孔上预先训练. 只要装入一个学有级的XML文件并运行它. 在阿波罗11号机组的真实相片上(图40.4):4次探测.

blocks.en: All three astronauts’ faces (Armstrong, Collins, Aldrin) are found correctly, plus a small false positive on the fabric texture on Aldrin’s sleeve. minNeighbors (how many overlapping detections a region must have) and scaleFactor (how coarsely the image pyramid steps between scales) trade off false positives against missed faces, playing a role similar to this chapter’s NMS threshold.
blocks.zh: 所有三名宇航员(Armstrong, Collins, Aldrin)的相貌都被发现正确,加上奥尔德林袖子上织物纹理上有一个小假阳性. MinNearbors(一个区域必须有多多的重叠检测)和scaleFactor(天平之间的图像金字塔台阶多么粗糙)将假阳性与被错失的面相交换,起到类似于本章NMS阈值的作用.

Explain why in terms of how much overlap real duplicate detections around the same face actually have. 2. blocks.en: 41.1 One object per image: predict a box directly
blocks.zh: 第41.1条 每个图像一个对象: 直接预测一个框

blocks.en: The simplest possible regression problem: one circular blob per image, at an unknown location and size (Figure 41.1 ). Instead of a class label, the network’s target is now four numbers — ( c x , c y , w , h ) (c_{x},c_{y},w,h) indicating the bounding box, normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] by image size.
blocks.zh: 最简单的可能回归问题:每个图像一个圆块,位置和大小不明(图41.1)。 网络的目标现在不是分类标签,而是四个数字——(cx,cy,w,h) (c_{x},c_{y},w,h)表示边框,按图像大小归正为[0,1][0,1].

blocks.en: Figure 41.1: Sample training scenes, each with a single object and its ground-truth box.
blocks.zh: 图41.1:样本培训场景,每个场景都有一个单一的物体及其地上真人资料盒。

blocks.en: 41.2 The model and the IoU metric
blocks.zh: 41.2 (中文(简体) ). 模型和IoU度量衡

blocks.en: The network is a CNN backbone (Chapter 34 ’s pattern) followed by a 4-output regression head with a sigmoid, so every prediction lands in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] — a valid normalized box coordinate. It’s trained with plain MSE loss against the true box, and evaluated with IoU (Chapter 40 ’s intersection-over-union), the metric that actually matters for detection: how much the predicted and true boxes overlap, not how close the four numbers are in isolation.
blocks.zh: 网络是CNN的主干线(第34章的模式),然后是4个输出回归头并有相片,因此每个预测都以 [0, 1] [0, 1] —— 一个有效的正版框坐标. 并用IoU(第40章的交叉结合)来评价, 这一衡量标准实际上对检测很重要:预测的和真实的盒子有多少重叠,而不是四个数字相去甚远。

blocks.en: ⬇ class Detector ( nn . Module ): def __init__ ( self ): super (). __init__ () self . conv = nn . Sequential ( nn . Conv2d (1, 16, 5, padding =2), nn . ReLU (), nn . MaxPool2d (2), nn . Conv2d (16, 32, 5, padding =2), nn . ReLU (), nn . AdaptiveMaxPool2d (1), ) self . fc = nn . Linear (32, 4) # cx, cy, w, h, normalized def forward ( self , x ): return torch . sigmoid ( self . fc ( self . conv ( x ). flatten (1)))
Trained for 400 epochs with MSE loss: mean IoU on the test set is 0.758 0.758 , with 95.0 % 95.0\% of test boxes reaching IoU > 0.5 \text{IoU}>0.5 (Figure 41.2 ).
blocks.zh: 400个带MSE损失的时代的训练:测试组的IoU平均值为0.758 0.758,95.0\%的测试盒达到IoU > 0.5\text{IoU}>0.5 (图41.2).

blocks.en: Figure 41.2: Predicted boxes (red, dashed) vs. true boxes (green) on four test scenes, with per-example IoU.
blocks.zh: 图41.2:四个试验场景的预测箱(红色、破碎)对正箱(绿色),每例IoU。

blocks.en: 41.3 Scaling this up: two families of real detectors
blocks.zh: 41.3 扩大规模:两个真正的探测器家庭

blocks.en: This detector above only handles exactly one object per image, because a fixed-size output vector (4 numbers) can only describe one box. But real scenes have a variable, unknown number of objects. Two different families of detectors dominate the landscape:
blocks.zh: 这个上方的探测器每个图像只处理一个完全的物体,因为一个固定大小的输出向量(4个数字)只能描述一个框. 但真实的场景有可变,未知的物体数量. 两种不同的探测器家族占据了整个地貌:

blocks.en: Two-stage (R-CNN family): first generate a modest number of region proposals — candidate boxes likely to contain something, via a cheap, class-agnostic method (the original R-CNN used classical segmentation; Faster R-CNN ( Ren et al., 2015 ) learns a small “region proposal network” instead) — then run a classifier-plus-box-regressor (this chapter’s whole architecture) on each proposal independently, exactly like running the sliding-window classifier from Chapter 40 but only at a handful of promising locations instead of every window. Accurate, but only as fast as (proposals) × \times (one forward pass) allows.
blocks.zh: 两阶段(R-CNN家族):首先通过一种廉价的、阶级不可知的方法(最初的R-CNN采用古典分类法;更快的R-CNN(Ren等,2015年)学习一个小的"地区建议书网络")产生少量的区域建议书——然后在每项建议书上独立运行一个分级-+-box-递归器(本章的整个架构),就像运行第40章的滑动窗口分级器,但只在少数有希望的地点而不是每个窗口运行。 准确,但只允许最快的(提议)x\时间(一次前传).

blocks.en: Single-stage (YOLO, SSD): skip proposals entirely. YOLO (You Only Look Once, Redmon et al., 2016 ) divides the image into a coarse grid of cells, and has each grid cell directly predict (as this chapter’s network does) a fixed number of boxes plus a class label plus a confidence score, all in one forward pass. SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector, Liu et al., 2016 ) follows the same one-pass recipe but predicts boxes from several feature-map resolutions at once (not just one final grid), so coarser layers naturally catch larger objects and finer layers catch smaller ones. To let a single cell describe objects of different aspect ratios, single-stage detectors use anchor boxes : several predefined box shapes (tall, wide, square) per cell, with the network predicting an offset from each anchor rather than a box from scratch. Faster to run, historically somewhat less accurate than two-stage methods, though the gap has narrowed considerably.
blocks.zh: 单相(YOLO,SSD):完全跳过提案. YOLO(You Only Look Once,Redmon等,2016年)将图像分出为粗细的细胞网格,并且每个网格细胞都直接预测出(如本章的网络所言)一个固定的框数外加一个类标签外加一个信任分数,都是在一个前传. SSD 服务器 (Single Shot MultiBox Detectionor,Liu等,2016年)遵循相同的单行道配方,但一次从几个特征图分辨率(不只是一个最终的网格)中预测出框,因此相近地层自然会捕捉到更大的物体,更细地层会捕捉到较小的物体. 要让单个单元格描述不同侧面比的物体,单相探测器使用锚盒:每个单元格数个预定义的盒形(全,宽,平方),网络预测从每个锚上取出一个相抵而不是从头取出一个相克. 运行得更快,历史上略低于两阶段方法,尽管差距已大大缩小。

blocks.en: Both families end with the same postprocessing step: non-maximum suppression (NMS, Chapter 40 ) to merge the overlapping candidate boxes any real multi-object scene produces. (For simplicity, this chapter’s toy detector omitted NMS by only predicting a single bounding box.)
blocks.zh: 两个家庭最后都采取了同样的后处理步骤:非最大压制(NMS, 第40章),将相重叠的候选框合并任何真实的多对象场景产生. (简而言之,本章的玩具探测器仅通过预测单个的边框而省略了NMS.

blocks.en: 41.4 In practice: real detectors on real images
blocks.zh: 41.4 (中文(简体) ). 实务:真实图像上的真实探测器

blocks.en: OpenCV ships a single-stage detector, cv2.FaceDetectorYN ( YuNet , Wu et al., 2023 ), that follows the single-stage recipe above for faces specifically. Unlike Chapter 40 ’s Viola-Jones cascade, it’s a small single-shot CNN — the same family as SSD above, just specialized to one class — and it runs its own NMS internally before returning boxes. Run on the same Apollo 11 crew photo as Chapter 40 (Figure 41.3 ), YuNet finds all three astronauts correctly, with no false positive — an improvement over Viola-Jones’s spurious detection on fabric texture. This is the payoff of a learned single-shot CNN over a cascade of hand-designed Haar-like features: richer features, trained end-to-end on real face/non-face data rather than assembled stage by stage.
blocks.zh: OpenCV发射的单相探测器为cv2. Face DetectionorYN (YuNet, Wu等, 2023年),具体遵循以上单相相的配方. 与第40章的Viola-Jones级联不同,它是一个小型的单发CNN——和上面的SSD同一家人,专为一等——在回盒前内部运行自己的NMS. 运行在阿波罗11号机组照片上与第40章(图41.3)相同, YuNet发现所有三名宇航员都是正确的,没有假阳性——比起Viola-Jones在织物纹理上的虚伪检测有改进. 这是有学问的单发CNN通过一系列手工设计的类似Haar的功能:更丰富的功能,在真实的面相/非面相数据上训练有素的端到端,而不是按阶段组装.

blocks.en: Figure 41.3: cv2.FaceDetectorYN : 3 detections, each with a confidence score. Image source: NASA (public domain), via Wikimedia Commons.
blocks.zh: 图41.3:cv2. Face DetectionorYN:3个探测器,每个探测器都有置信分. 图片来源:NASA (公有领域),通过Wikimedia Communications.

blocks.en: But YuNet only answers “face or not” — one class. For general, multi-class detection, Faster R-CNN pretrained on COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 , about 330k real photos labeled across 80 object categories) is a few lines away via torchvision . This is the same “pretrained model in one line” pattern as Chapter 38 ’s ResNet-18. It natively handles a variable, unknown number of objects per image — the actual payoff of the region-proposal architecture described above.
blocks.zh: 但YuNet只回答“面子与否”, 对于一般的多级检测,更快的R-CNN预训于COCO上(Lin等,2014年,标有80个对象类别的约330克真实相片)是通过火炬视网的几行外. 这是与第38章ResNet-18相同的 " 一行预先训练的模式 " 。 它原生地处理一个可变,未知的每个图像对象数量——上述区域建议架构的实际回报.

blocks.en: ⬇ weights = torchvision . models . detection . FasterRCNN_ResNet50_FPN_Weights . COCO_V1 real_detector = torchvision . models . detection . fasterrcnn_resnet50_fpn ( weights = weights ) real_detector . eval () # frozen, no training at all -- Faster R-CNN exactly as released
blocks.zh: QQ重量=火炬视. 探测 更快的RCNN_ResNet50_FPN_重量. CO_V1 real_Datector = 火炬视觉. 型号. 探测更快的rcnn_resnet50_fpn(重量=重量) real_Datector. eval () #被冻结了,完全没有训练 -- 更快的R-CNN完全如出炉.

blocks.en: Figure 41.4: Faster R-CNN pretrained on COCO: 4 detections above score 0.7 0.7 . Image source: COCO dataset (val2017, image 000000039769).
blocks.zh: 图41.4:更快地对COCO进行R-CNN预训:4次检测比分0.7以上. 图片来源:COCO数据集 (val 2017,影像000039769).

blocks.en: Four confident, correct detections survive the score_thresh = 0.7 \text{score\_thresh}=0.7 cutoff (Figure 41.4 ) — two cats and two remote controls, each above 0.78 0.78 — despite this network using only pretrained weights. Lowering the threshold reveals what the cutoff was hiding: several overlapping, lower-confidence boxes (a “couch” and a “bed” guess both covering most of the image, around score 0.54 0.54 ).
blocks.zh: 有4个自信,正确的检测能活到分数_thresh = 0.7\text{ score_thresh}=0.7 截取(图41.4)——两只猫和两只遥控器,每只都高于0.78 0.78,尽管这个网络只使用预训重量. 降低阈值揭示了截取的隐蔽之处:几个重叠的、信心较低的盒子(一个“触摸”和一个“床”猜想,两者都覆盖了大部分图像,大约为0.54分(0.54分)。

blocks.en: 1. Change obj_size in make_scene from a fixed 8 8 to a random value (e.g. rng.integers(4, 12) ) so objects vary in size, and retrain. Does mean IoU hold up, get worse, or barely change — and why would variable object scale be harder for a single fixed-size regression head than variable position? 2. The loss function here is plain MSE on ( c x , c y , w , h ) (c_{x},c_{y},w,h) , but the metric that matters is IoU. Replace the loss with 1 - iou_batch(pred, target).mean() (directly optimizing IoU) and compare final mean test IoU to the MSE-trained version. Real detectors (e.g. Faster R-CNN, YOLO variants) do exactly this with generalized IoU losses — can you see why MSE loss and IoU metric might disagree on which of two similar predictions is “better”? 3. Sketch (in words) how you would modify the architecture’s output to handle up to 3 objects per image using a 3 × 3 3\times 3 grid where each grid cell predicts one box and a “there’s an object here” confidence — the core idea behind YOLO’s grid. 4. blocks.en: 42.1 A 3-class pixel labeling task
blocks.zh: 第42.1条 一个三等像素标签任务

blocks.en: Create an image with several small circles and squares scattered on a background. The target is a full per-pixel class map: 0 = background, 1 = circle, 2 = square. Class pixel fractions in the training set are heavily imbalanced: background 0.866 0.866 , circle 0.046 0.046 , square 0.088 0.088 (Figure 42.1 ).

blocks.en: 42.2 A minimal FCN-style network
blocks.zh: 42.2 (中文(简体) ). 最小的FCN型网络

blocks.en: A segmentation network outputs a class-probability vector for every pixel, so its output is the same spatial size as the input. The encoder is an ordinary CNN, downsampling twice via max pooling (Chapter 34 ) to build up semantically rich features with a wide receptive field (Chapter 11 ’s pyramid). The decoder then upsamples that coarse bottleneck straight back to full resolution. That’s the entire FCN recipe: just downsample then upsample.
blocks.zh: 一个分块网络为每个像素输出一个类概率向量,因此其输出与输入的空间大小相同. 编码器是一个普通的CNN,通过最大集合(第34章)进行两次下取样,以建立具有广泛可接受性的丰富特征(第11章金字塔)。 解码器将粗糙的瓶颈直接提升到完全解析度. 这就是整个FCN的配方:只是降低样本,然后提高样本。

blocks.en: ⬇ class FCNTiny ( nn . Module ): def forward ( self , x ): f1 = self . enc1 ( x ) # (B,16,H,W) f2 = self . enc2 ( self . pool ( f1 )) # (B,32,H/2,W/2) f3 = self . enc3 ( self . pool ( f2 )) # (B,64,H/4,W/4) -- the bottleneck d2 = self . dec2 ( self . up ( f3 )) # upsample only -- no fusion with f2 d1 = self . dec1 ( self . up ( d2 )) # upsample only -- no fusion with f1 return self . out ( d1 )
blocks.zh: QQ等 FCNTINY (nn. Module ): def向前 (self, x): f1 = self. enc1 (x) # (B,16,H,W) f2 = self. enc2(自池(f1)) # (B,32,H2,W/2) f3 = self. enc3(自池(f2)) # (B,64,H4,W/4) - 瓶颈 d2 = self Dec2(自上(f3)) #上方- 不与 f2 d1 =自上(d2)进行聚变.

blocks.en: Trained for 200 epochs with cross-entropy loss: pixel accuracy 98.1 % 98.1\% , per-class IoU of 0.984 0.984 (background), 0.736 0.736 (circle), 0.891 0.891 (square), giving a mean IoU of 0.870 0.870 .
42.3 In practice: FCN on a real photo
blocks.zh: 第42.3条 实际操作中:真实照片上的FCN

blocks.en: torchvision ships FCN ( Long et al., 2015 ), pretrained on COCO images (labeled with the 21 Pascal VOC categories — 20 object classes plus background). This is architecturally the same recipe as FCNTiny above: encoder, then upsampling.
blocks.zh: FCN号火炮舰 (Long等,2015年),在COCO图像上预训(有21个Pascal VOC类标签——20个对象类外加背景). 这在建筑上和上面的FCNTINY相同:编码器,然后进行上标.

blocks.en: Figure 42.2: Real FCN per-pixel labels on a street photo. Photo by Felix Hanspach on Unsplash.
blocks.zh: 图42.2:街道照片上真实的FCN每像素标签. 照片来自Felix Hanspach,

blocks.en: The cyclist is cleanly labeled person , with the bicycle’s wheels correctly labeled bicycle just below — both real, correctly-placed detections (Figure 42.2 ). The tram is where it gets interesting: the model splits it between train (the upper, windowed section) and bus (the lower body) rather than picking one label for the whole vehicle. That’s not really a mistake so much as an honest reflection of VOC’s limited vocabulary — a tram is a genuinely ambiguous case between “train” and “bus” for a model that was never given a “tram” class to choose from, and the two guesses roughly track a real visual seam in the vehicle (windows vs. body) rather than being random. A second, smaller person blob on the right edge catches the blurred pedestrian in the background.
blocks.zh: 自行车手的车轮正确贴上自行车的标签, 有轨电车是它变得有趣的地方:车型将它分为列车(上行,有窗的车段)和巴士(下行车体),而不是为整车挑取一个标签. 这其实并不像诚实地反映VOC的有限词汇那样错误——电车在“火车”和“巴士”之间是一个真正含糊不清的案例,因为“火车”和“巴士”对于一个从未被授予“火车”的型号来说是无法选择的,而这两个猜测则大致跟踪车辆中真实的视觉接合(窗口对身体)而不是随机的。 第二,右边的小人会抓住背景模糊的行人。

blocks.en: 42.4 Adding skip connections: U-Net
blocks.zh: 42.4 添加跳过连接: U-Net

blocks.en: FCNTiny ’s decoder only sees the pooled, upsampled bottleneck features. After two rounds of pooling, that bottleneck has just a quarter of the input’s spatial resolution, and small or closely-packed shapes can blur together or lose their boundaries entirely at that resolution. U-Net ( Ronneberger, Fischer & Brox, 2015 ) fixes this with skip connections : at each decoder stage, it concatenates the encoder’s feature map from the matching resolution , preserving the fine-grained details that would otherwise be lost during pooling. This is similar in spirit to Chapter 37 ’s residual connections, but the purpose and mechanism differ: U-Net concatenates features across the encoder-decoder boundary, rather than adding a residual update within a single network stack.
blocks.zh: FCNTINY的解码器只看到集合的,被提升的瓶颈特征. 经过两轮的集合,这个瓶颈只有输入空间分辨率的四分之一,小的或紧密的外形可以一起模糊或完全在分辨率上失去边界. U-Net(Ronneberger, Fischer & Brox, 2015)用跳过连接来修复它:在每个解码器阶段, 它从匹配的解析度中整理出编码器的特性映射, 保存在集合时丢失的精细细节 。 这在精神上与第37章的剩余连接相似,但目的和机制不同:U-Net会将连接功能跨过编码器-解码器边界,而不是在一个网络堆栈内添加剩余更新.

blocks.en: ⬇ class UNetTiny ( nn . Module ): def forward ( self , x ): f1 = self . enc1 ( x ) f2 = self . enc2 ( self . pool ( f1 )) f3 = self . enc3 ( self . pool ( f2 )) d2 = self . dec2 ( torch . cat ([ self . up ( f3 ), f2 ], dim =1)) # skip from f2 d1 = self . dec1 ( torch . cat ([ self . up ( d2 ), f1 ], dim =1)) # skip from f1 return self . out ( d1 )
blocks.zh: QQ类 UNetTiny (nn. Module ): def向前 (self, x): f1 = self. enc1 (x) f2 = self. enc2(self. pool (f1)) f3 = self. enc3(自. pool (f2)) d2 = self. Dec2(火炬猫 ([自上 (f3), f2], dim = 1) 从 f2 d1 =自上 (火炬猫 ([自上 (d2), f1], dim = 1) 从 f1 自行返回 (d1) 跳出.

blocks.en: Trained identically for 200 epochs:
blocks.zh: 对200个世纪进行相同的训练:

blocks.en: pixel acc mean IoU FCN (no skip) 98.1% 0.870 U-Net (skip) 99.5% 0.943
blocks.zh: 像素 acc 指 IoU FCN (无跳过) 98.1% 0.870 U-Net (skip) 99.5% 0.943

blocks.en: Figure 42.3: Input, ground truth, FCN prediction, and U-Net prediction, for four test scenes.
blocks.zh: 图42.3:四个试验场景的输入、地面真相、FCN预测和U-Net预测。

blocks.en: For small, tightly packed shapes, skip connections provide a substantial mean-IoU improvement over a plain FCN, visible directly in Figure 42.3 . An FCN cannot recover detail that was lost in the low-resolution bottleneck, because interpolation can only work on existing information. Skip connections fix this problem by giving the decoder a second, non-bottlenecked path to the encoder’s high-resolution features, so precise boundaries never have to survive the bottleneck in the first place.
blocks.zh: 对于小而紧凑的外形,跳过连接比平地FCN提供了实质性的正IoU改进,直接可见于图42.3. 一个FCN无法找回在低分辨率瓶颈中丢失的细节,因为插入只能对现有信息起作用. 跳过连接通过给解码器提供第二道非瓶颈路径来修复这个问题,以达到解码器的高分辨特性,因此精确的边界从不需要从一开始就活过瓶颈.

blocks.en: This helps explain why U-Net remains popular for tasks requiring precise boundaries, especially medical imaging. But skip connections are not universal: popular networks like plain FCN and DeepLabV3 have none, and even DeepLabV3+ adds only a single one, not a full U-Net-style connection at every resolution. So while skip connections are a useful tool, they are not a requirement — their value depends on how much fine spatial detail the task demands.
blocks.zh: 这有助于解释为什么U-Net仍然流行于需要精确界限的任务,特别是医疗成像. 但跳过连接并不普遍:平面FCN和DeepLabV3等通俗网络没有,甚至DeepLabV3+只添加了一款,而不是每个分辨率的全U-Net式连接. 因此,虽然跳过连接是一个有用的工具,但它们不是一个要求——它们的价值取决于任务需要多少细微的空间细节.

blocks.en: 43.1 Overlapping instances
blocks.zh: 第43.1条 重叠实例

blocks.en: Two circles per scene, deliberately placed close enough to touch or overlap. Ground truth includes both a semantic mask (0=background, 1=circle) and an instance mask (0=background, 1=first circle, 2=second circle), as shown in Figure 43.1 .
blocks.zh: 每个场景有两个圆圈,刻意放入足够相接或相接相接. 地面真理既包括一个语义口罩(0=背景,1=循环),也包括一个实例口罩(0=背景,1=一圈,2=二圈),如图43.1所示.

blocks.zh: 图43.1:输入图像(上行)及其地上真实实例口罩(下行)。

blocks.en: 43.2 Augmenting the network with an instance head
blocks.zh: 43.2 国家 用实例头增强网络

blocks.en: Take Chapter 42 ’s exact U-Net architecture and give it a second output head alongside the semantic head: for every foreground pixel, predict a ( d ​ x , d ​ y ) (dx,dy) offset pointing toward its own instance’s center. The semantic head still does the same job as Chapter 42 (background vs. circle); the new offset head is what turns plain segmentation into instance segmentation.
blocks.zh: 用42章准确的U-Net架构,并给它第二个输出头和语义头:对于每个前方像素,预测一个(dx,dy) (dx,dy) 相抵指向自身实例的中心. 语义头仍然与第42章(背景对圆)做同样的工作;新的相抵头就是将平面分化变成实例分化的.

blocks.en: ⬇ class InstanceNet ( nn . Module ): "" "U-Net, with a second head: per-pixel offset-to-center regression" "" def forward ( self , x ): f1 = self . enc1 ( x ) f2 = self . enc2 ( self . pool ( f1 )) d1 = self . dec1 ( torch . cat ([ self . up ( f2 ), f1 ], dim =1)) return self . sem_head ( d1 ), self . offset_head ( d1 )
Trained for 300 epochs with a weighted sum of cross-entropy (semantic head) and MSE (offset head, masked to foreground pixels only): semantic pixel accuracy 100.0 % 100.0\% .
blocks.zh: 为300个纪元进行训练,加权总和为交叉通体(语义头)和MSE(相位头,只被遮住到前方像素):语义像素精度为100.0%-100.0%-%.

blocks.en: 43.3 Recovering instances: vote for the center, then cluster (Hough, again)
blocks.zh: 43.3 国家 恢复实例:对中心投票,然后是集群(Hough,再次)

blocks.en: The offset head above was trained to predict, for every foreground pixel, an offset pointing toward its own instance’s center — supervised directly from the ground-truth instance masks. Each foreground pixel casts one vote (its predicted center location) into an accumulator, exactly like Chapter 12 ’s Hough line/circle voting. Because every pixel belonging to the same circle votes for approximately the same point, the accumulator forms one tight cluster of votes per instance, however tangled the pixels themselves are. Finding instances becomes: find the vote clusters, then assign each pixel to its nearest cluster.
blocks.zh: 上面的相抵头部受过训练,可以预测每个前方像素都有一个相抵角,指向它自己的实例中心——直接由地真相实例口罩监督。 每个前景像素将一票(它的预测中心位置)投入一个积分器中,这与第12章的Hough线/圈的投票完全相同. 由于每个属于同圆形的像素的票数大致相同,积分器每例形成一组紧凑的选票,无论像素本身是被纠缠的. 查找实例变为:查找选票集群,然后将每个像素分配给其最近的集群.

blocks.en: ⬇ # greedily take the highest-voted peak, suppress its neighborhood, repeat # (the same non-max-suppression idea as Chapter 40’s detection boxes) for _ in range (6): idx = np . unravel_index ( votes_work . argmax (), votes_work . shape ) if votes_work [ idx ] < vote_thresh : break peaks . append (( idx [1], idx [0])) votes_work [ y0 : y1 , x0 : x1 ] = 0 # suppress the neighborhood around this peak

blocks.en: 43.4 Mask R-CNN: Faster R-CNN plus a mask branch
blocks.zh: 43.4 面具R-CNN:更快的R-CNN外加口罩分支

blocks.en: The offset-voting approach above is one family of instance segmentation methods (related to techniques sometimes called “instance embedding” or center-voting). The other dominant approach, Mask R-CNN ( He et al., 2017 ), does not start from scratch — it is Faster R-CNN (Chapter 41 ) with one new piece bolted on. The region proposal network, the per-box classifier, and the per-box coordinate refinement are all unchanged. Mask R-CNN just adds a third, parallel branch on every detected box: alongside the existing class label and refined box coordinates, a small fully-convolutional head predicts a binary mask within that box . Detection already solves “how many objects, and roughly where” via region proposals and NMS; the mask branch adds “and here’s this one’s exact silhouette” — exactly the piece built and tested in isolation below.
blocks.zh: 上文的相抵表决权办法是一个实例分解方法(涉及有时称为“嵌入”或中间表决权的技术)。 另一种主导方法,即Mask R-CNN(He等,2017年),并非从零开始——它是更快的R-CNN(第41章),有一个新作品被栓上. 区域建议书网络,每盒分级器,每盒坐标的完善均保持不变. Mask R-CNN只是在每个检测到的盒子上添加了第三个平行的分支:除了现有的类标签和精细的盒子坐标之外,一个小的全演化头会预言盒子内有一个二进制的面具. 侦测已经通过区域提案和NMS解决了 " 多少物体,大致是哪里 " 的问题;面具分支也添加了 " 这里的这个是确切的圆形 " ——就是下面孤立地建造和测试的一块。

blocks.en: One more change was needed to make that mask branch actually work well. Faster R-CNN extracts a fixed-size feature grid for each proposed box by snapping (quantizing) the box’s coordinates to the nearest feature-map cell — a step called RoIPool. That rounding barely affects classifying a box or nudging its coordinates by a few pixels, but it visibly misaligns a per-pixel mask against the object it is supposed to outline. Mask R-CNN replaces RoIPool with RoIAlign , which reads features via bilinear interpolation instead of rounding to the nearest cell, so the extracted features — and therefore the predicted mask — stay aligned with the actual box coordinates. This is a small change to the detector, but it is the specific fix that makes pixel-accurate masks possible.
blocks.zh: 还需要做一个改变才能让这个面具分支真正运作良好。 更快的R-CNN通过将盒子的坐标分解(量化)到最近的特征图单元格——一个叫作RoIPool的步子——来提取每个拟议框的固定大小特性网格. 这种四舍五入几乎不影响对一个盒子进行分类或用几个像素来将它的坐标去裸出,但它明显地错误地将每个像素的口罩对准它应该概括的对象. Mask R-CNN用RoIAlign来取代RoIPool,它通过双线插值来读取特征,而不是四舍五入到最近的单元格,因此所提取的特征——并因此预想的口罩——保持与实际的箱形坐标一致. 这是对探测器的微小改变,但正是具体的固定使得像素精确口罩成为可能.

blocks.en: Putting Chapters 36 , 40 , 41 , and this chapter together: classification (Chapter 36 ) gives one label for the whole image, semantic segmentation (Chapter 42 ) gives one label per pixel with no notion of separate objects of the same class, and instance segmentation (this chapter) adds a distinct identity per object — “background,” “circle #1,” “circle #2,” not just “background,” “circle.” A fourth term, panoptic segmentation , unifies the last two: every pixel gets both a semantic class and, for countable “thing” classes like circles or cars, an instance ID — while uncountable “stuff” classes like sky or road are labeled semantically only, since instance identity doesn’t make sense for them.
blocks.zh: 将第36、40、41章和本章合并在一起:分类(第36章)给整个图像一个标签,语义分解(第42章)给每个像素一个标签,没有关于同一类物体的单独概念,实例分解(本章)给每个物体增加了一个不同的特性——“背景”,“一号圆”,“二号圆”,而不仅仅是“背景,”“圆”。 第4个术语是泛光分解(泛光学分解), 统一了最后两个词:每个像素都得到一个语义类,

blocks.en: 43.5 A mask head
blocks.zh: 第43.5条 面具头

blocks.en: Detection (Chapter 41 ) and per-instance masking are two separate, already-solved pieces at this point — the only genuinely new ingredient Mask R-CNN adds is the mask head : a small network that looks only inside one proposed box and predicts a binary mask for the single object that box was proposed for, ignoring anything else visible in the crop.
blocks.zh: 侦测(第41章)和per-Intance口罩是此时两个独立的,已经解决的片段——唯一真正新的成分Mask R-CNN所添加的就是口罩头:一个小网络,只看一个被提出的盒子内并预想出一个二进制口罩,用于对盒子所推荐的单个物体,而忽略了作物中其他可见的东西.

blocks.en: Build that piece in isolation. Take the ground-truth box around each instance’s true center (assume localization is already solved, so only the new mask-head idea is under test), crop a fixed 14 × 14 14\times 14 window there, and train a tiny fully-convolutional head to predict which pixels in that crop belong to this instance — not to any neighboring circle that happens to also be visible in the same crop. This produces 510 510 training crops and 90 90 test crops, each 14 × 14 14\times 14 .
blocks.zh: 把它隔离起来 使用每个实例的真实中心周围的地面真人盒(假设本地化已经解决,所以只有新的口罩头概念正在测试中),在那里裁剪一个固定的14×14 14\时的14个窗口,并训练一个小的全革命头来预测该作物中的哪一个像素属于这个实例——而不是偶然出现在同一个作物中的任何相邻圆圈。 这共生产了510 510个培训作物和90个试验作物,每个作物14×1414×14次14.

blocks.en: ⬇ class MaskHead ( nn . Module ): def __init__ ( self ): super (). __init__ () self . net = nn . Sequential ( nn . Conv2d (1, 16, 3, padding =1), nn . ReLU (), nn . Conv2d (16, 16, 3, padding =1), nn . ReLU (), nn . Conv2d (16, 1, 1), # per-pixel mask logit, full crop resolution throughout )
Trained for 300 epochs with binary cross-entropy: mask-head IoU (per-instance) 0.844 0.844 , versus a naive “everything foreground in the crop” baseline IoU of 0.687 0.687 (Figure 43.3 ).
blocks.zh: 为300个有二进制横琴的时代进行训练:口罩头IoU(每场)0.844 0.844,与0.687 0.687 (图43.3)这一天真“作物的所有前景”基线IoU(图43.3)。

blocks.en: Figure 43.3: Crops (with a neighboring circle visible), ground-truth per-instance masks, and predicted masks.
blocks.zh: 图43.3:作物(可看见相邻圆圈)、地面真实的每层口罩和预测的口罩。

blocks.en: Because this dataset’s circles are generated close enough to always touch or overlap, every single test crop contains visible pixels from the neighboring circle — there is no “easy” case here to inflate the numbers. The per-instance mask head still reaches a respectably high IoU against the true single-instance mask, clearly ahead of the naive baseline that just marks every foreground pixel in the crop as belonging to “the” object (which is systematically wrong whenever a neighbor intrudes — the same problem that motivated giving the network an instance-center head in the first place, just replayed at crop scale). The mask head doesn’t need to solve “where are the circles” — the box already answered that — it only has to learn “given that this box was proposed for one specific circle, which pixels are that circle’s, and not its neighbor’s.” That’s a strictly easier, more local question, which is exactly why Mask R-CNN’s mask branch can be small and fast: a good box already does most of the work.
blocks.zh: 由于这个数据集的圆圈产生得足够相近,总是能触摸或相重叠,因此每个测试作物都包含相邻圆的可见像素——这里没有"容易"的情况来放大数字. 单相口罩头仍能与真实的单相口罩相抗衡而达到可敬高的IoU,明显地超过了天真的基准,将作物中的每个前地像素都标为属于""对象"(这在邻居入侵时是系统性地错误的——同样的问题促使网络最初有一个实例中心头,刚刚在作物规模上重放). 面具头不需要解决“圆圈在哪里”问题 — — 盒子已经回答过这一点 — — 只要学会“因为这个盒子是针对一个特定圆圈提出的,而这个圆圈的像素是圆圈的,而不是其邻居的。 ” 这也是为什么Mask R-CNN的口罩分支可以小而快:一个好的盒子已经做了大部分工作。

blocks.en: This also clarifies why Mask R-CNN and this chapter’s offset-voting approach rarely fail the same way. Offset-voting can mis-cluster votes when two instances’ centers are close enough that their accumulator peaks blur together. Mask R-CNN instead depends on the upstream detector proposing a correct box for every instance in the first place — miss a box, and that instance’s mask is never even attempted, no matter how good the mask head is.
blocks.zh: 这也澄清了为什么Mask R-CNN和本章的抵消表决权办法很少以同样的方式失败。 当两个案例中心距离足够近, 以致其积分峰值模糊在一起时, 而面具R-CNN则依赖于上游探测器为最初的每一个实例提出正确的盒子——错过一个盒子,而无论面具头有多好,这个实例的面具甚至从未尝试过.

blocks.en: 43.6 In practice: Mask R-CNN on a real photo
blocks.zh: 第43.6条 实际操作中:真相相上的面具R-CNN

blocks.en: The mask head above proves the idea works once localization is solved for free (ground-truth box centers). Here is the same idea, fully assembled and pretrained: a real Mask R-CNN ( torchvision.models.detection.maskrcnn_resnet50_fpn , trained on COCO) run end to end — detection and mask head both included, nothing given away — on a photo with exactly the kind of touching, same-class instances this chapter has been building toward: the same Apollo 11 crew photo from Chapters 40 – 41 .
blocks.zh: 上面的口罩头证明,一旦本地化被免费解决(地面-真相盒中心),这个想法就起作用了. 这是同样的想法,完全组装和预先训练:一个真实的Mask R-CNN(火炬视觉.models.detection.maskrcnn_resnet50_fpn,训练有素的COCO) 跑到终点——探测和口罩头都包括在内,没有给任何东西——在一张照片上,上面刻有这一章所建立的那种触摸的同级事件:第40章第41章的同名阿波罗11号船员照片。

blocks.en: Above 80 % 80\% confidence: 4 instances — three person detections (each ≥ 99.8 % \geq 99.8\% ) and one spurious clock detection ( 83.6 % 83.6\% ), shown in Figure 43.4 .
blocks.zh: 超过80%的80分置信度:4起——3起人检出(每起99.8%\geq 99.8分)和1起假钟检出(83.6%83.6分),见图43.4。

blocks.en: Figure 43.4: Real Mask R-CNN per-instance masks. Image source: NASA (public domain), via Wikimedia Commons.
blocks.zh: 图43.4:真面罩R-CNN每口罩. 图片来源:NASA (公有领域),通过Wikimedia Communications.

blocks.en: The three astronauts are shoulder-to-shoulder, touching along multiple arm and torso boundaries, and belong to the exact same COCO class ( person ) — precisely the case where a semantic mask would merge them into one undifferentiated blob. Mask R-CNN separates them cleanly into three distinct instances anyway, because its detector proposes three separate boxes first (one per astronaut) and the mask head only looks inside a single box at a time, exactly like the mask head above. The fourth, spurious detection is a small clock mask on the left astronaut’s wrist — the round, mirrored cuff-mounted checklist on Armstrong’s arm, misread as a clock face.
blocks.zh: 三名宇航员是肩相接的,沿着多臂相接和躯干相接的边界相接而来,属于完全相同的COCO类(人)——这正是一个语义口罩会把它们合并成一个没有区别的blob的情况. 面具R-CNN无论怎样都把它们干净地分开成三个截然不同的情况,因为它的探测器首先提出三个独立的盒子(每个宇航员一个),而面具头一次只看着一个盒子内,与上面的面具头完全一样. 第四,虚伪的探测是左宇航员手腕上的一个小时钟口罩——圆形,阿姆斯特朗手臂上反射出袖口的核对表,误读为时钟相.

blocks.en: 44.1 Floating-point precision: fp32 vs. fp16
blocks.zh: 44.1 浮点精度:fp32 vs. fp16

blocks.en: A 32-bit float (fp32) and a 16-bit float (fp16) both use the same idea — sign, exponent, mantissa — but fp16 spends far fewer bits on the exponent, so it simply cannot represent very small or very large magnitudes. torch.finfo reports the smallest positive normal value each format can hold: about 1.2 × 10 − 38 1.2\times 10^{-38} for fp32, but only 6.1 × 10 − 5 6.1\times 10^{-5} for fp16 (fp16 subnormals stretch a little further, down to about 6 × 10 − 8 6\times 10^{-8} , at the cost of losing precision entirely). Below that floor, a value doesn’t round to something small — it rounds to exactly zero.
blocks.zh: 一个32位浮点数(fp32)和一个16位浮点数(fp16)都使用了同样的想法——符号,发音,mantissa——但是fp16在发音上花费的位数要少得多,所以它根本不能代表非常小或非常大的数量. Filler.finfo 报告每种格式可以持有的最小正正常值:fp32大约为1.2×10-38 1.2\times 10×38},而fp16(fp16子正常值稍再延伸一点,降至约6×10-8 6\times 10×8),代价是完全失去精度. 在下层,一个数值不会绕到一个小东西上——它绕到零。

blocks.en: Values down to 10 − 6 10^{-6} survive the cast intact; 10 − 7 10^{-7} survives but loses precision (rounds to 1.2 × 10 − 7 1.2\times 10^{-7} ); 10 − 8 10^{-8} and smaller vanish to exactly 0.0 0.0 . That’s not a rounding error in the usual sense — it’s total information loss, and it matters enormously for training because gradients routinely take on exactly these magnitudes, especially in deep networks. Chapters 33 and 37 built and studied the vanishing-gradient problem in fp32, where early-layer gradients shrink but stay nonzero. In fp16, “shrink” can mean “disappear.”
blocks.zh: 数值降到10 - 6 10 - 6] 完好无损地活了下来;10 - 7 10 - 7 = 存活了,但丧失了精度(圆形为 1.2 × 10 - 7 1.2\tims 10 - 7 });10 - 8 10 - 10 - 8 = 5),小到 0.0 。 这并非通常意义上的四舍五入错误,而是信息的全部损失,而且对于培训来说,这一点非常重要,因为梯度通常都具有精确的这些分量,特别是在深层网络中。 第33章和第37章在fp32中构建并研究了消失的渐变问题,早期的梯度收缩了但保持了非零. 在fp16中,“收缩”可以指“消失”。 “

blocks.en: A 12-layer sigmoid network (deliberately deep and derivative-shrinking, the same vanishing-gradient setup Chapter 37 diagnosed) produces first-layer gradients with mean magnitude 2.65 × 10 − 12 2.65\times 10^{-12} , max 2.33 × 10 − 11 2.33\times 10^{-11} — comfortably nonzero in fp32 ( 0.0 % 0.0\% exactly zero), but 100.0 % 100.0\% exactly zero the instant they’re cast to fp16. Train this network directly in fp16 and the first layer would never update at all; the optimizer would faithfully apply a learning rate to a gradient of exactly zero, forever. This is the actual problem mixed-precision training has to solve, not a hypothetical one.
blocks.zh: 一个12层的 sigmoid 网络(深层和衍生- srinking, 被诊断的同一种已消失-分级的设定 第37章)会产生第一层梯度, 其平均值为2.65×10 − 12 2.65\times 10\times 10\times 12\times ) , 最大值2.33× − 11 2.33\times 10\tims 11\tims 11\tims —— 舒适的在fp32中不为零(0.0% 0.0}完全为零), 但100.0% 100.0\tim 完全为 fp16。 直接在fp16中训练这个网络,第一层根本不会更新;优化者将忠实地将学习率应用到完全为零的梯度上,永远. 这是混合精度训练必须解决的实际问题,而不是假设的问题。

blocks.en: 44.2 Mixed-precision training: the recipe
blocks.zh: 44.2 混合精度培训: 食谱

blocks.en: Training entirely in fp16 hits the wall demonstrated above; training entirely in fp32 gives up the speed and memory savings that were the whole point. Mixed-precision training ( Micikevicius et al., 2018 ) keeps both: the forward and backward pass run in fp16 for speed, but two safeguards protect against exactly the failure shown above: 1. fp32 master weights : a full-precision copy of every weight is kept off to the side. Updates apply to the fp32 copy (where small updates don’t get rounded away), and an fp16 copy is re-derived from it before each forward pass. 2. Loss scaling : multiply the loss by a large constant before calling .backward() . Since gradients are linear in the loss, every gradient scales up by the same factor — pushing values that would have underflowed back into fp16’s representable range. The update step divides the gradient back down by that same factor before it’s applied, so the math is otherwise unaffected.
blocks.zh: 完全使用fp16的训练击中了上面所显示的墙;完全使用fp32的训练放弃了作为整体点的速度和内存节省. 混合精密训练(Micikevicius等,2018年)既能保持:前传又能以fp16为速度跑出后传,但有两种保障措施可以防止上述故障的准确性: 1. fp32 主重: 每个重量的全精度拷贝都放在一边 更新适用于 fp32 副本( 小更新不会被四舍五入), 并在每次前传前重取 fp16 副本 。 2. 损失缩放:在调用. backward()前将损失乘以一个大常数。 由于梯度在损失中是线性的,所以每个梯度都用相同的因子来上调——将本来会被压入fp16可代表范围的值推回. 更新步骤在应用前将梯度向下除去同样的因子,因此数学不会受到影响。

blocks.en: fp32 master weights : a full-precision copy of every weight is kept off to the side. Updates apply to the fp32 copy (where small updates don’t get rounded away), and an fp16 copy is re-derived from it before each forward pass.
blocks.zh: fp32 主重:每个重量的全精度拷贝被保存到一旁. 更新适用于 fp32 副本( 小更新不会被四舍五入), 在每次前传前都会从中重取 fp16 副本 。

blocks.en: Loss scaling : multiply the loss by a large constant before calling .backward() . Since gradients are linear in the loss, every gradient scales up by the same factor — pushing values that would have underflowed back into fp16’s representable range. The update step divides the gradient back down by that same factor before it’s applied, so the math is otherwise unaffected.
blocks.zh: 损失缩放 : 在调用. backward() 之前将损失乘以大常数 。 由于梯度在损失中是线性的,所以每个梯度都用相同的因子来上调——将原本会被压入fp16可代表范围的值推回. 更新步骤在应用前将梯度向下除去同样的因子,因此数学不会受到影响。

blocks.en: With no scaling ( scale = 1 \text{scale}=1 ), every first-layer gradient underflows, exactly as before. Scaling by 65,536 65{,}536 ( 2 16 2^{16} , a common real-world default) already rescues most of them, but over a third are still small enough to vanish. Only at 2 28 2^{28} does the last gradient clear fp16’s floor. This is precisely why real implementations (PyTorch’s torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler ) use dynamic loss scaling rather than a fixed constant: start with some scale, and increase it further whenever a step completes without producing an inf / NaN (a sign the scale could safely be larger), or back off whenever one appears (a sign the scale overflowed something). One more detail worth naming: bfloat16 (bf16), an increasingly common alternative to fp16, sidesteps loss scaling entirely — torch.finfo shows it has the same exponent range as fp32 ( smallest_normal around 1.2 × 10 − 38 1.2\times 10^{-38} for both), so it can’t underflow the way fp16 does. What it gives up instead is precision ( eps around 0.008 0.008 for bf16 versus 0.001 0.001 for fp16) — a different trade-off along the same speed-versus-representable-range axis, not a free lunch.
blocks.zh: 没有缩放( 缩放 = 1\ text{scale{% 1) , 每个一级梯度下行, 与以前完全相同 。 缩放65,536 65{,}536 (2, 16 2. 直到2 28 2 + 28 } 上个梯度才清除 fp16 的下限 。 正因为如此,真正的执行(PyTorch's hapt.cuda.amp.Grad Scaler)使用动态损失缩放而不是固定常数:从某种规模开始,每完成一步就进一步增加,而不产生inf / NaN(比例表可以安全地变大),或者每当出现(比例表会溢出某种东西)就退后。 一个更需要命名的细节: bfloat16 (bf16),一个越来越常见的fp16的替代品,边步损失缩放完全——火炬. finfo 显示它与 fp32 具有相同的 exporent 范围( 1.2 × 10 — 38 1.2\times 10 ×- 38 ) , 因此它不能像 fp16 那样下流 。 相反,它放弃的是精度(eps 0.008 0.008 for bf16 and 0.001 0.001 for fp16)——一个不同的取舍,沿着相同的速度与可代表距离轴进行,而不是免费的午餐.

blocks.en: 44.3 Data parallelism: correctness proven in miniature
blocks.zh: 44.3 国家 数据并行性:微小情况下证明的正确性

blocks.en: Precision controls how much work one device does per step; parallelism controls how many devices share that work. Data parallelism (the standard recipe behind large-batch training, e.g. Goyal et al., 2017 ) splits a batch into shards, runs an identical copy of the model on each shard on its own device, and averages the resulting gradients before the update step. On one CPU there’s no speedup to show, but the correctness of that recipe — that averaging per-shard gradients gives the same answer as computing the gradient on the whole batch at once — is exactly checkable, because MSE loss is itself an average, and the gradient of an average of per-shard averages is the average of the per-shard gradients.
blocks.zh: 精度控制一个设备每步能做多少活;并行性控制一个设备共享多少活. 数据并行主义(大批训练背后的标准配方,例如. blocks.en: Every parameter’s averaged-shard gradient matches the single-device gradient to within 1.49 × 10 − 8 1.49\times 10^{-8} — floating-point roundoff, not a real discrepancy. This is the whole correctness argument for data parallelism in one demonstration: splitting the batch and averaging afterward is mathematically the same computation as never splitting it at all. What this toy version doesn’t — can’t — show is the actual cost real data-parallel training pays: the all-reduce , the communication step that sums/averages gradients across every device before any of them can proceed to the update. At small scale that communication is nearly free; at hundreds of GPUs it can dominate the step time, which is why large-scale training spends real engineering effort on overlapping communication with computation rather than doing them one after another.
blocks.zh: 每个参数的平均硬度梯度将单分梯度相匹配到1.49×10-8.1.49\times 10×8}——浮点相接,而不是真正的相差. 这是一个演示中数据并行主义的完全正确性论证: 分批和分后平均数在数学上与绝对不分的计算相同. 这个玩具版本不能——不能——显示的是实际成本的实际数据平行训练的回报:全减,也就是在任何设备进行更新之前总和/平均梯度的通信步骤。 在小规模上,通信几乎是免费的;在数百个GPU中,它可以支配步入时间,这就是为什么大规模培训将真正的工程努力花在与计算重叠的通信上而不是一个接一个地进行。

blocks.en: 44.4 Model parallelism: shipping activations across a boundary
blocks.zh: 44.4 模式平行:跨界航运激活

blocks.en: Data parallelism copies the whole model onto every device and splits the data . Model parallelism ( Shoeybi et al., 2019 ) does the opposite: split the model itself across devices, because it’s too large to fit on one. In the simplest form (pipeline parallelism), each device holds a contiguous block of layers; the forward pass computes one block’s output, hands that activation across the device boundary, and the next device picks up from there. The backward pass runs the same handoff in reverse: each device needs only the gradient of the loss with respect to the activation it sent , not anything about what happens on the other side of the boundary.
blocks.zh: 数据并行主义将整个模型复制到每个设备上,并分割数据 。 模式并列主义(Shoeybi等,2019年)则相反:将模式本身分拆出各种设备,因为其体积太大,无法合一. 在最简单的形式(管线平行)中,每个设备都持有相接相接的地层;前传会计算出一个地块的输出,活出跨越设备边界的手,下一个设备会从那里取出. 后传则逆向运行相同的交接:每个设备只需其发送的活化时损失的梯度,而不是任何关于边界另一侧发生的事情.

blocks.en: Every gradient matches exactly — 0.0 0.0 difference, not just roundoff, because the split-and-reattach mechanism ( detach() at the boundary going forward, then manually resuming .backward() with the shipped-back gradient) is mathematically identical to autograd tracing straight through an unsplit model; it just makes the “device boundary” explicit as a place activations get detached and gradients get reattached by hand instead of automatically. Real pipeline parallelism adds one more concern this two-device, one-batch toy sidesteps entirely: while device B works on the tail of the pipeline for one batch, device A sits idle unless a second batch is already flowing in behind it — the “pipeline bubble” that real implementations fight with careful scheduling (splitting each batch into smaller microbatches so every stage stays busy). Data parallelism’s bottleneck is communication (the all-reduce above); model parallelism’s is idle time.

blocks.en: 44.5 Two more practical tricks
blocks.zh: 44.5 国家 再来两个实用的把戏

blocks.en: Two more techniques round out the practical picture without needing their own full demonstration, because both are natural extensions of mechanisms already built above: • Gradient accumulation simulates a larger batch than fits in memory by running several small forward/backward passes without an optimizer step in between, summing their gradients, and only then updating — mathematically the same averaging idea as the data-parallel shards above, just spread across time on one device instead of across devices at once. • Gradient checkpointing trades compute for memory: instead of storing every intermediate activation for the backward pass (what autograd normally does), it stores only a handful of checkpoints and recomputes the activations in between during the backward pass. More forward-pass compute, much less memory — useful when a model’s activations, not its weights, are what doesn’t fit.
blocks.zh: · 渐渐地积累模拟出比内存更能适应的批量,方法是在两者之间运行若干个小前后后行,不采取更优化的步骤,将其梯度相接相接,然后才进行更新——在数学上与上面的数据平行硬盘相同的平均想法,只是一次在某一个设备上而不是在设备上跨出。 · 渐入检查站交易计算内存:它不为后行通行证存储每一次中间激活(自动升级通常所做的),而只存储了少数检查站,并在后行通行证之间重新计算激活。 更多前传计算,更少的记忆——当一个模型的活化,而不是它的重量,是不适合的。
